Faustus barely hesitated.
This time, he had to hurt the God Realm.
He had to hurt them so badly that they would never again dare to harbor crooked thoughts.
And there was also Kelly!
She might be in the Bloodtide Sea of the God Realm.
Although he did not know where the Bloodtide Sea was, once he arrived in the God Realm, he would find it eventually.
He leaped into the spatial passage.
"God Realm, I’m coming."

chapters.title: Chapter 258 -258-Picking a Fight? So What?
paragraphs: Whoosh—!

Daniel’s figure descended upon the land of the God Realm. The aura around him erupted without the slightest attempt at concealment, his mind power surging outward like a flood that had burst through a dam, sweeping across heaven and earth.
Almost at the exact same instant, countless god-grade, supreme-grade, and Divine-grade powerhouses throughout the God Realm sensed his presence.
"Faustus—!"
Hiram, the master of the Hall of Divine Grace, was so furious his eyes nearly split open.
The enemy who had killed his offspring had actually dared to set foot in the God Realm so openly and arrogantly!
This time, he would make sure Faustus died without even a place to be buried.
"Faustus..."
A cold glint flashed through the eyes of Ankarach, master of the Temple of Holy Light. His figure vanished at once.
His offspring, Kahn, had also died at the hands of this human.
Meanwhile, in another magnificent palace, Brand, master of the God of Light Hall, darkened in expression.
For a Divine-grade powerhouse, life was measured in tens of millions of years. Even a casual period of seclusion could last hundreds of thousands of years.
Now, a hundred thousand years had passed, and he was still stuck at Low Divine-grade—though he was close to advancing.
But none of that mattered!
What mattered was that the human brat who, back then, could only survive inside his sage rank by self-destructing again and again, now dared to storm into the God Realm in broad daylight?!
"How insolent!"
"Where did this madman come from? How dare he trespass into the God Realm!"
"Surround him! Don’t let him escape!"
The guards of the God Realm surged in like a tide. Layer after layer, they surrounded Daniel so tightly that not even water could leak through.
In the blink of an eye, the guard legion had gathered no fewer than five million warriors.
At the same time, large numbers of Godkin powerhouses rushed over after hearing the commotion. All of them wanted to see which death-seeking fool had dared to run wild in the God Realm.
Within moments, more than ten million Godkin powerhouses had crowded around Daniel.
"I am Faustus, the current leader of the human race."
His voice rolled across the sky like thunder, spreading to every corner of the God Realm.
"Today, I have ascended to the God Realm—to demand judgment from the gods!"
Boom—!
The moment these words rang out, the entire crowd burst into uproar.
"A mere human insect dares to speak such arrogant words!"
"Chop this madman into mincemeat!"
"Kill him!"
"Too arrogant! You think you’re worthy of coming to the God Realm to demand judgment?"
"Attack! Crush this idiot!"
The God Realm’s guard legion instantly formed a battle array. Divine Domains spread out like a curtain covering the sky, blotting out the sun and threatening to grind Daniel into dust.
Boom—!
Daniel neither dodged nor retreated. He unleashed his own Divine Domain head-on.
Chaos Samsara!
In the void, a pair of enormous eyes abruptly opened.
They hovered between reality and illusion. The left eye was black as an abyss, while the right eye was white as bone.
The left eye represented death.
The right eye represented life.
The instant this supreme Divine Domain unfolded, it crushed the guard legion’s combined Divine Domain with the unstoppable force of a storm breaking rotten wood.
A Divine Domain formed by the combined strength of millions of supreme-grade warriors was as fragile as paper before him.
He had not even used the true Strength of his Divine Domain.
Merely unfolding it was already enough to suppress everything.
The faces of millions of Godkin warriors changed drastically.
The eyes of the ten million Godkin powerhouses filled with horror.
"This... this is a Divine Domain?"
"Even a sage rank is probably only about this powerful, right?"
"My heavens... how is this possible..."
That supreme Divine Domain was like a lion or tiger stepping into a flock of sheep, carrying an insurmountable suppression of rank.
"Chaos without end. Samsara without cease."
Buzz—!
The Divine Domain erupted violently!
The black and white eyes shot out two beams of light at the same time. One black, one white, they intertwined and coiled together, swallowing all ten million Godkin powerhouses in the area.
The black and white eyes slowly closed.
Then, they abruptly opened again.
In the next instant, an incomparably terrifying scene appeared in the world.
The ten million Godkin powerhouses melted away like lingering snow beneath a blazing sun—silently, soundlessly.
In the blink of an eye, ten million living beings were reduced to nothingness.
And at that very moment—
"Faustus, accept your death!"
A sage rank descended out of thin air, enveloping him within it.
Back then, when Daniel had faced this sage rank, he had been completely helpless. He could only survive by self-destructing again and again.
But now...
A faint sneer curled at the corner of his mouth.
The black and white eyes erupted with two dazzling pillars of light. With a thunderous crash, they forced that sage rank back, firmly protecting Daniel while domineeringly occupying half of the void.
A supreme Divine Domain clashed head-on against a sage rank!
Daniel lifted his gaze and saw Brand, master of the God of Light Hall.
Last time, within that sage rank, he had not even been able to find the other party’s figure.
Now, with a single glance, he saw him clearly.
"This... is a Divine Domain?"
Brand stared at those black and white eyes as if he were looking at a monster.
He had never seen such a tyrannical, heaven-defying Divine Domain before. He had not even heard of one.
Could a Divine Domain really be powerful to this extent?
Then what was his sage rank supposed to be?
Hiram, master of the Hall of Divine Grace, and Ankarach, master of the Temple of Holy Light, appeared at the same time. Each of them unfolded their sage rank.

The three Divine-grade powerhouses surrounded Faustus in a triangular formation. Their sage ranks pressed down from every direction like three colossal mountains, madly crushing against his Divine Domain.
Yet what was unbelievable was this—
Although the range of the Divine Domain was continuously compressed, it never collapsed!

Instead, the more it was compressed, the tighter it became. The more pressure it endured, the tougher it grew. It was like steel being hammered and forged, tempering an even sharper blade beneath overwhelming force.
"A mere Divine Domain... can actually withstand the crushing pressure of three overlapping sage ranks?"
Hiram’s pupils shrank violently, his voice filled with disbelief.
"Faustus... has actually become this strong?"
Cold sweat seeped from Ankarach’s forehead. His heart pounded like a war drum.
"Faustus!"
Brand, master of the God of Light Hall, raised a hand and pointed at him, shouting furiously.
"You are the leader of Aetheria’s human race. Why have you come to my God Realm to run wild and slaughter ten million of my people?"
"You have committed monstrous crimes. I have come to demand judgment."
Faustus stood proudly, his voice as cold as ice.
"If you do not give me an explanation today, I will overturn this God Realm from top to bottom!"
"Absurd! What crimes could my Godkin possibly have committed?"
Brand was so enraged that the muscles on his face twitched.
"And even if there truly were crimes, what right does Faustus have to judge us?"
"Heh."
Faustus gave a cold laugh.

"The Godkin care only for their own interests and disregard the lives of all beings across the myriad worlds. Don’t tell me you didn’t send powerhouses to the lower realm to destroy Aetheria’s Origin!"
The three Divine-grade powerhouses instantly fell silent.
This matter had indeed been planned by them.
Based on this alone, Faustus had every reason to storm the God Realm.
You wanted to take everything from him, yet you did not allow him to retaliate?
"The second crime of the Godkin is imprisoning the leader of my human race!"
Faustus’s gaze was like a blade, stabbing straight toward Brand.
"Queen Kelly was imprisoned by you in the depths of the Bloodtide Sea. Do you dare say otherwise?"
The three Divine-grade powerhouses looked at one another.
Kelly?
That human monarch from a hundred thousand years ago?
Had she not gone to the Bloodtide Sea of her own free will?
No—could that really be blamed on the God Realm too?
"The third crime of the Godkin!"
Faustus’s aura climbed higher and higher.
"You bullied and suppressed the human race. Therefore, if I say you are guilty, then you are guilty!"
"The human race was weak, so you toyed with us as you pleased. Now, the human race has me. Even if I want to slaughter the Godkin, what can you do to me?"
His words echoed across the four corners of the God Realm, surging back and forth like a tide.
"What can you do to me?"
Countless living beings trembled in their hearts.
"What can you do to me?"
The ten million powerhouses erupted into shocked uproar, and the weapons in their hands nearly slipped from their grasp!

chapters.title: Chapter 259 -259-Void Annihilation, Immortal Icon
paragraphs: The three Divine-grade powerhouses exchanged a glance.
How could they still fail to understand?
This Faustus had clearly come here to pick a fight. He was being utterly unreasonable.
"Does he truly think himself invincible?"
Ankarach secretly gathered energy. The light at his fingertips grew brighter and brighter.
"Too arrogant..."
Hiram was so furious that his chest felt tight, and he nearly spat out a mouthful of blood.
"I have lived for millions of years, yet I have never seen a human so arrogant."
Brand’s killing intent was already set. His voice was cold, as though drifting out from a tomb.
"Join forces and kill him. End this once and for all!"
"Kill!"
Brand was the first to strike.
Hiram and Ankarach followed closely behind.
"We were going to fight in the end anyway. Why waste words?"
Facing the siege of three Divine-grade powerhouses, Faustus showed no fear at all.
The Divine-grade powerhouses fully unleashed their sage ranks, and overwhelming pressure swept over like mountains collapsing and seas overturning.
All kinds of secret arts and divine arts poured down like a torrential storm, tearing the void apart and swallowing Faustus’s figure in an endless torrent of energy.
"Die—!"
Hiram went straight for the kill.
A Godkin secret art unfolded in his hands. Vast world power gathered madly, and in the blink of an eye, a million elemental spheres condensed around Faustus.
Those spheres greedily devoured everything around them—air, light, even space itself. They also continued to devour one another.
In the end, even space could no longer endure it. Amid tearing and collapse, the spheres transformed into enormous Elemental Black Holes.
From the depths of those black holes, a terrifying aura capable of destroying heaven and earth faintly spread out.
"You arrogant fool. Let’s see whether you die or not!"
A ferocious smile hung on Hiram’s face.
This secret art, Elemental Black Hole, was his proudest killing move. Its power was comparable to the full-force strike of a High Divine-grade powerhouse.
"Divine Grace Idol!"
Ankarach attacked at the same time.
His body suddenly expanded, transforming into a giant ten thousand meters tall. His shoulders and back propped up the firmament. With one step of his right foot, the entire God Realm trembled.
His right shoulder tilted slightly, bringing his entire right arm down like an overturning mountain range as he slammed his palm toward Faustus.
Wherever that giant palm passed, space collapsed like paper. Its power was absolutely terrifying.
What Brand unleashed, meanwhile, was an auxiliary secret art.
He condensed world power into countless weapons, packed together densely like surging ocean waves, covering the sky and earth as they rushed toward Faustus.
Faustus’s gaze sharpened.
The elemental energy around him gathered wildly, turning into a boundless sea of ice and fire. In an instant, it flooded this entire stretch of heaven and earth.
Unlike other powerhouses, Faustus himself was an amplifier!
His damage could be amplified countless times over. The quality and energy of his elements could likewise be amplified countless times over.
He had no secret art.
But this ability itself was the strongest secret art under heaven.
He also possessed Causal Power.
The corners of Faustus’s mouth lifted slightly.
With Causal Power in hand, the ending could be rewritten.
Among the countless interwoven threads of cause and effect, he had already seen the method to break through their attacks.
"Explode!"
Hiram detonated the Elemental Black Holes.
Boom!
Rumble—!
The explosions connected into one continuous blast, deafening to the ears. They actually blew apart the space of the God Realm.
"Go!"
Ankarach’s giant palm came crashing down, landing squarely on Faustus’s position.
Crash, crash, crash—!
The weapons condensed from world power surged like a tide, drowning Faustus completely.
At the same time, Faustus’s vast ocean of ice and fire elements swallowed the three Divine-grade powerhouses as well.
"Hmph—I am Divine-grade. You think this tiny bit of elemental damage can possibly hurt—"
Hiram’s face was filled with disdain, but halfway through his sentence, his expression changed drastically.
He discovered that every single cell in his body had become abnormal, as if something had drilled inside and taken root throughout him.
"Are you trying to tickle me?"
"Hahaha... All beneath Divine-grade are mere ant—"
Ankarach’s enormous ten-thousand-meter body suddenly trembled.
He had also sensed the abnormality within himself.
"What is going on? Inside my body... what is this thing?"
A hint of surprise flashed through Brand’s eyes.
However, he did not panic.
He still had a life-saving method.
"Life Condensation!"
The moment his voice fell, the vitality within his body suddenly vanished, as if it had been drawn away by an invisible hand.
The three Divine-grade powerhouses raised their heads at the same time and looked toward the place where Faustus stood.
Step!
Step—step—
Faustus slowly walked out from the smoke and dust filling the sky. He stepped through the air as though walking on flat ground.
His robes fluttered violently.
He was completely unharmed.
"Everyone, please personally witness the transformation of an era!"
Faustus’s voice was as cold and hard as iron.
"Today, I shall use the blood of Godkin sages to sacrifice to the sages of Aetheria’s human race."
Countless years ago, that greatsword powerhouse had crossed the Time River and returned to a battlefield of certain death for the sake of his race.
Countless years ago, the sages of the human race had willingly taken their own lives in exchange for a place where their people could survive.
Today, Faustus had come.
He had come to demand back everything the human race had lost!
The moment his words fell—
Boom!
Boom! Boom!
Three deafening explosions rang out. The bodies of the three Divine-grade powerhouses abruptly collapsed, turning into powder that scattered across the sky.
[Ding! You have killed Hiram, master of the Hall of Divine Grace. You have obtained the God Realm secret art: Elemental Black Hole — supreme-grade!]
[Ding! You have killed Ankarach, master of the Temple of Holy Light. You have obtained the God Realm secret art: Divine Grace Idol — supreme-grade!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
The trump-card secret arts of two sages were still extremely precious.
He immediately sold both secret arts.
[Ding! You have sold the God Realm secret art Elemental Black Hole — supreme-grade to the Doom Guild. Sale price: 1 copper coin. Millionfold Boost has been triggered!]
[The item sold is a skill book. Please choose quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"

[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained the Divine-grade secret art Void Annihilation — Divine-grade ×1! As the shackles of the world level shatter, the might of this secret art shall also break free of its restraints and climb to an even higher level.]
[Ding! You have sold the God Realm secret art Divine Grace Idol — supreme-grade to the Doom Guild. Sale price: 1 copper coin. Millionfold Boost has been triggered!]
[The item sold is a skill book. Please choose quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"

[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained the Divine-grade secret art Immortal Icon — Divine-grade ×1! As the shackles of the world level shatter, the might of this secret art shall also break free of its restraints and climb to an even higher level.]
[Void Annihilation — Divine-grade]
Requirement: supreme-grade
Effect: After learning this secret art, you may condense elemental power into abyssal black holes that devour all things. They may also be detonated at any time to inflict devastating damage.
Description: A secret art passed down through generations among the Godkin Oracle-grade...
Daniel learned it without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding! You have studied and mastered the secret art Void Annihilation!]
Daniel’s gaze then turned to the other secret art.
[Immortal Icon — peak demi-sage rank]
Requirement: supreme-grade
Effect: After activating this secret art, you may transform into a ten-thousand-meter giant and comprehensively increase all attributes.
Description: A secret art obtained by the Godkin from an ancient ruin somewhere...
Faustus immediately learned it.
[Ding! You have learned the secret art Immortal Icon!]
"Hm?"
Faustus’s gaze sharpened.
Something was wrong!
Of the three Divine-grade powerhouses, two were dead.
There was still one left!
Brand of the God of Light Hall had actually not died?
His eyes widened.
With the power of Endless Divine Power, killing a Low Divine-grade opponent above his level should not have been difficult at all. This had already been proven by the fall of the other two gods.
With his current strength, he was fully capable of instantly killing a Low Divine-grade.
But Brand...
Was actually still alive?

Ankarach’s enormous ten-thousand-meter body suddenly trembled.
He had also sensed the abnormality within himself.
"What is going on?
Inside my body... what is this thing?"
A hint of surprise flashed through Brand’s eyes.
However, he did not panic.
He still had a life-saving method.
"Life Condensation!"
The moment his voice fell, the vitality within his body suddenly vanished, as if it had been drawn away by an invisible hand.
The three Divine-grade powerhouses raised their heads at the same time and looked toward the place where Faustus stood.
Step!
Step—step—
Faustus slowly walked out from the smoke and dust filling the sky.
He stepped through the air as though walking on flat ground.
His robes fluttered violently.
He was completely unharmed.
"Everyone, please personally witness the transformation of an era!"
Faustus’s voice was as cold and hard as iron.
"Today, I shall use the blood of Godkin sages to sacrifice to the sages of Aetheria’s human race."
Countless years ago, that greatsword powerhouse had crossed the Time River and returned to a battlefield of certain death for the sake of his race.
Countless years ago, the sages of the human race had willingly taken their own lives in exchange for a place where their people could survive.
Today, Faustus had come.
He had come to demand back everything the human race had lost!
The moment his words fell—
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Three deafening explosions rang out.
The bodies of the three Divine-grade powerhouses abruptly collapsed, turning into powder that scattered across the sky.
[Ding!
You have killed Hiram, master of the Hall of Divine Grace.
You have obtained the God Realm secret art: Elemental Black Hole — supreme-grade!]
[Ding!
You have killed Ankarach, master of the Temple of Holy Light.
You have obtained the God Realm secret art: Divine Grace Idol — supreme-grade!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
The trump-card secret arts of two sages were still extremely precious.
He immediately sold both secret arts.
[Ding!
You have sold the God Realm secret art Elemental Black Hole — supreme-grade to the Doom Guild.
Sale price: 1 copper coin.
Millionfold Boost has been triggered!]
[The item sold is a skill book.
Please choose quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained the Divine-grade secret art Void Annihilation — Divine-grade ×1!
As the shackles of the world level shatter, the might of this secret art shall also break free of its restraints and climb to an even higher level.]
[Ding!
You have sold the God Realm secret art Divine Grace Idol — supreme-grade to the Doom Guild.
Sale price: 1 copper coin.
Millionfold Boost has been triggered!]
[The item sold is a skill book.
Please choose quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quality boost!"
[Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained the Divine-grade secret art Immortal Icon — Divine-grade ×1!
As the shackles of the world level shatter, the might of this secret art shall also break free of its restraints and climb to an even higher level.]
[Void Annihilation — Divine-grade]
Requirement: supreme-grade
Effect: After learning this secret art, you may condense elemental power into abyssal black holes that devour all things.
They may also be detonated at any time to inflict devastating damage.
Description: A secret art passed down through generations among the Godkin Oracle-grade...
Daniel learned it without the slightest hesitation.
[Ding!
You have studied and mastered the secret art Void Annihilation!]
Daniel’s gaze then turned to the other secret art.
[Immortal Icon — peak demi-sage rank]
Requirement: supreme-grade
Effect: After activating this secret art, you may transform into a ten-thousand-meter giant and comprehensively increase all attributes.
Description: A secret art obtained by the Godkin from an ancient ruin somewhere...
Faustus immediately learned it.
[Ding!
You have learned the secret art Immortal Icon!]
"Hm?"
Faustus’s gaze sharpened.
Something was wrong!
Of the three Divine-grade powerhouses, two were dead.
There was still one left!
Brand of the God of Light Hall had actually not died?
His eyes widened.
With the power of Endless Divine Power, killing a Low Divine-grade opponent above his level should not have been difficult at all.
This had already been proven by the fall of the other two gods.
With his current strength, he was fully capable of instantly killing a Low Divine-grade.
But Brand...
Was actually still alive?

chapters.title: Chapter 260 -260-Standing Above Pantheon Summit Hall
paragraphs: Faustus spread out his mind power and searched the surroundings. Sure enough, he detected something abnormal.
Whoosh—!
As if realizing he had been discovered, Brand no longer hid himself. He turned into a streak of light and fled at incredible speed.
His secret art allowed him to condense all the vitality in his body, abandon his original body, and escape with his life.
This secret art had practically made him an undying existence.
What Daniel had killed just now was nothing more than an empty shell.
The real Brand had hidden himself long ago, and now he was fleeing desperately.
Escape!
Run faster!
This Daniel was far too terrifying!
Three Divine-grade powerhouses together had failed to deal with him. Instead, two of them had been killed by his counterattack.
Fortunately, his own secret art specialized in escape...
"Where do you think you can run?"
Killing intent gathered in Daniel’s eyes, and his figure dispersed into the void.
Divine-grade powerhouses possessed the trait of Thoughtstep, so it was very difficult for him to catch up.
But he did not mind.
He only wanted to see what other tricks Brand could still pull.
"Today, I will completely overturn the God Realm."
Faustus’s voice echoed through the void.
"I will slaughter them until rivers of blood flow. I will kill until fear chills them to the bone. I will kill until merely hearing my name makes them tremble in terror."
The hunt had officially begun!
"Faster! Faster! Faster!"
"As long as I reach Pantheon Summit Hall, I’ll be saved!"
Brand’s eyes were filled with urgency, and veins bulged on his forehead.
Pantheon Summit Hall stood above all the divine halls. It was the sacred land of the God Realm’s Divine-grade powerhouses.

The master of that temple was even an Oracle-grade existence who spent most of the year traveling through the stars. However, the hall itself still housed Divine-grade powerhouses from past generations who were in closed-door seclusion.
As long as he awakened them, then no matter how strong Faustus was, he would not be able to stir up any waves.
Brand refused to believe that madman would dare chase him all the way to Pantheon Summit Hall.
At last, the towering outline of a majestic structure appeared at the end of his vision. It reached into the clouds, golden and resplendent, grand and imposing.
Brand’s eyes lit up sharply. He practically threw himself inside.
"Quick! Hurry and awaken all Divine-grade powerhouses!"
He took out a communication treasure, his voice so urgent it was as if he were on fire.
"Everyone, the Godkin have reached a moment of life and death! Two sages guarding the God Realm have already fallen. Please awaken immediately and face the enemy!"
Several voices soon came from the communication treasure. Some were deep, while others were filled with surprise and doubt.
"What are you panicking for? What sort of existence has come?"
"Someone dares to kill a sage of my Godkin? Are they tired of living?"
"I’ll come meet him right now."
"It is an Aetherian human—Faustus!"
Brand gritted his teeth as he spoke that name.
"An Aetherian human? Isn’t that race no different from ants?"
"Are you sure you’re not mistaken? Can a place like that even produce any decent powerhouse?"
"And he killed our sages?"
The Divine-grade powerhouses still in deep slumber were all stunned.
Each time they entered dormancy, it lasted at least over a hundred thousand years.
Before they had gone into slumber, the Aetherian human race had not even been worth a single glance from them.
But how much time had passed?
An Aetherian human now dared to storm into the God Realm and had even slaughtered two sages in a row?
Whoosh—!
Faustus had arrived!
He hovered above Pantheon Summit Hall, robes whipping in the air as he looked down upon the temple beneath his feet, the very symbol of the God Realm’s supreme dignity.
Pantheon Summit Hall was the face of the God Realm.
It was a sacred land.
It was the nest where countless Divine-grade powerhouses lay dormant.
It stood high above all things, overlooking every living being, like an eternal firmament that could never be crossed.
And today, Faustus had stepped on it.
"Brand—run. Go on. Run again if you have the ability."
The corner of his mouth curled into an icy arc. He raised his hand and condensed elemental power, forming a giant palm that blotted out the sky before slamming it down.
Under the lock of the Law of Causality, the ending was already determined.
Boom!
Rumble—rumble!
Wherever the giant palm passed, it crushed everything in its path, unstoppable.
"Human insect!"
Several furious shouts rang out from within Pantheon Summit Hall, their voices rolling like thunder.
"Stop!"
Several figures shot into the sky from the ruins. Their sage ranks unfolded, erupting with blinding radiance.
"A mere human dares come here seeking death!"
Boom!
Five sage ranks unfolded at the same time, pressing down like five colossal mountains. In an instant, they forced Faustus’s Divine Domain back.
That elemental giant palm sank into layer after layer of sage rank like falling into a swamp, before eventually disappearing without a trace.
"So many Divine-grade powerhouses?"
Faustus raised an eyebrow and swept his gaze over them.
There were not only Low Divine-grade powerhouses.
There were also several Mid Divine-grade existences.
Pantheon Summit Hall was the foremost of all the divine halls and the sacred land of the God Realm’s powerhouses.
Most Low Divine-grade and Mid Divine-grade powerhouses who were close to breaking through would choose to advance here.
As for higher-grade sages, the God Realm had no better place to offer them.
"You want to compete in numbers? I’m not afraid of you."
Faustus sneered. Around him, ninety-nine clones appeared out of thin air.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh—!
Ninety-nine clones appeared at the same time, each unleashing a supreme Divine Domain.
Every clone possessed power nearly identical to the original body.
"Abyssal Black Hole!"
The might of a secret art varied depending on the person who used it.
In Hiram’s hands, it had been nothing remarkable.
But in Faustus’s hands, its power was like heaven and earth in comparison.
Countless black holes emerged in an instant, merging into a vast ocean that devoured everything, enveloping the entire world.
"Immortal Icon!"
The ninety-nine clones expanded at the same time, transforming into giants ten thousand meters tall.
Some charged forward wildly.
Some raised enormous fists like falling meteors.
Some swung giant palms that covered the sky.
"That is a secret art of my God Realm... How does he know it too?"
The Divine-grade powerhouses of the God Realm were so shocked their eyes nearly popped out.
"Hiss—!"
"This power isn’t right... Not good! Dodge!"
"Is this person really a quasi-sage? I only slept for just over a hundred thousand years. Has the outside world already become like this?"
Some Divine-grade powerhouses began to wonder if they had fallen into an illusion.
Boom!
The ocean of black holes suddenly detonated.
Even the God Realm’s incomparably stable space could not withstand such terrifying power. It shattered one piece after another, revealing the chaos behind it.
The incomparably magnificent Pantheon Summit Hall was torn into dust. Countless shattered stones were swept into the chaotic void currents and vanished in the blink of an eye.
At the same time, the clones’ giant fists came smashing down like the collapse of the heavens, suppressing everything on the spot.
"My damage is empowered by the Law of Causality and Endless Divine Power..."
The corner of Faustus’s mouth lifted slightly.
This was equivalent to a curse that guaranteed both a hit and death.
Below Mid Divine-grade, one strike meant instant death!
The outcome held no suspense!
[Ding! You have killed the Divine-grade powerhouse Brand — Low Divine-grade!]
[Ding! You have obtained the God Realm secret art Vitality Draw — supreme-grade!]
[Ding! You have killed the Divine-grade powerhouse Brook — Divine-grade! You have obtained Primal Spirit ×10,000!]
[Ding! You have killed the Divine-grade powerhouse Walter — Low Divine-grade! You have obtained Primal Spirit ×10,000!]
System notifications exploded beside his ears like a torrential storm, densely packed and endless.
Faustus understood the situation clearly.
"There are still three Mid Divine-grade powerhouses alive."
His eyes turned cold.
For a Divine-grade powerhouse, every Rank breakthrough was as difficult as ascending to the heavens.
And once they broke through, their strength would undergo a tremendous leap.
Low-grade and Mid-grade were separated by only one step, but in essence, they were completely different.
"With my current strength, I can instantly kill a Low Divine-grade, but I still can’t instantly kill a Mid Divine-grade."
He pondered silently. That was because the grade of the secret arts in his hands was still not high enough.
If he could obtain even stronger secret arts, then things would be different.
"Although I can’t kill them instantly, I can... grind them to death."
His gaze landed on the few Divine-grade powerhouses who were still alive.

At this moment, they were already covered in wounds. The force of Endless Divine Power still lingered inside their bodies, stabbing into their flesh and blood like nails. It would not be so easy for them to recover.
The Mid Divine-grade powerhouses of the God Realm exchanged glances, and their eyes were filled with despair.
"What kind of joke is this... This human is absurdly strong."
"I’m already severely injured. If I take three more rounds, I won’t be able to hold on."
"To think that we, dignified sages, would be beaten into this state by a quasi-sage—and a human powerhouse at that. How laughable..."

chapters.title: Chapter 261 -261-A Mere Godkin Oracle-grade
paragraphs: Daniel was in no hurry to strike.
If a sage wanted to flee, he could not catch them. So first, he had to drive them into a dead end.
"Pantheon Summit Hall... With so many sages slumbering here, anyone could tell this must be an extraordinary place."
He tilted his head and looked toward the ruins.
The once magnificent and resplendent palace had now been reduced to nothing more than a heap of broken stones and shattered tiles.
A ten-thousand-meter-tall Immortal Sacred Idol split its mouth open, revealing a savage grin.
Then it raised its colossal foot and stomped down fiercely.
With a single step, it crushed the foundation of Pantheon Summit Hall.
And not only did it crush it—it even ground its foot over it twice, as though snuffing out an ant.
That step shattered more than mere stone.
It shattered the face God Realm had upheld for countless years.
The sages of God Realm were instantly enraged, their faces twisting with fury.
"This is blasphemy against the gods! This is an unforgivable offense!"
"I want that human dead!"
This was no longer a battle of blades and spells.
This was humiliation.
He was grinding the dignity of the Godkin into the mud.
What that human had crushed was not merely Pantheon Summit Hall, but the glory and faith the Godkin had taken pride in for tens of millions of years.
"I’ve already sent a secret message to the Main God! He is on His way back! Hold on!"
"This is unbearable!"
"Kill that human!"
The sages could no longer suppress the raging flames churning in their chests. Like beasts driven into a corner, they charged forward in a frenzy.
They ignited their Immortal Singularities to the absolute limit, and the might of their sage ranks surged wildly, as though they were about to force this entire world to collapse.
"You want to fight with your lives on the line? Then come!"
Daniel let out a thunderous roar, his blood boiling.
He pushed his secret art to its extreme, and his true body, along with his ninety-nine avatars, charged toward the three mid-grade sages at the same time.
"Chaotic Reincarnation—rise!"
In the void, that enormous pair of eyes, one black and one white, suddenly opened. Their radiance erupted like blazing suns.
The left eye was snow-white.
The right eye was pitch-black.
Black and white light intertwined and coiled together, transforming into a pillar of light that pierced heaven and earth, firmly enveloping the three sages within it.
However, the sage rank of a mid-grade sage was incomparably stable and solid.
It was like an immortal fortress, firmly protecting its master’s body. The pillar of light failed to pierce through it.
Rumble—!
Heaven and earth collapsed.
Boom—!
The spatial barrier of God Realm shattered.
At that very moment, the void of God Realm suddenly trembled, like the surface of a lake struck by a massive boulder. Ripples spread outward, layer upon layer.
A figure had yet to appear, but a furious roar had already exploded like thunder, shaking the entirety of God Realm.
"Human ant—you are playing with fire!"
"Die!"
An Oracle-grade had arrived.
The furious roar of God Realm’s Oracle-grade rolled across the heavens like thunder, echoing throughout the entire world.

Countless beings of God Realm heard that voice and instantly burst into tears. One after another, they fell to their knees, clasped their hands together, and with trembling lips, chanted the Oracle-grade’s name again and again.
"It’s the Main God! Our Godkin Oracle-grade has returned!"
"God Realm is saved!"
"We can finally watch that human be judged with our own eyes!"
The beings of God Realm were not unaware that a powerful human had slaughtered his way into their home.
That man had massacred countless lives on their land, crushed Pantheon Summit Hall, and was nearly unstoppable.
What kind of humiliation was this?

But the powerful beings of God Realm knew exactly what they were capable of. They did not dare throw their lives away. All they could do was pray silently in their hearts, praying that the Godkin Oracle-grades traveling through the Endless Starsea would return soon and save God Realm.
And now, at this moment, an Oracle-grade had truly returned.
Whoosh—!
The instant the three mid-grade sages heard that voice, wild joy erupted across their faces. They immediately pulled away from Daniel at top speed.
If the battle continued, they would sooner or later be worn down by this human until the last drop of their blood was drained dry.
"The one who has returned is the strongest Oracle-grade of our Godkin—Oracle-grade T3, Main God Trell!"
"With Main God Trell here, that human is dead for sure!"
"A mere human from Aetheria! A race of ants! Aside from this one human, they don’t even have a single decent powerhouse. What could they possibly use to contend against our Godkin?"
Daniel’s expression remained calm, without the slightest trace of panic.
"Heh... Oracle-grade."
The corner of his mouth slowly curved into an icy smile.
But in that very instant—
"Die—!"
A furious shout exploded inside his mind.
Before Daniel could react at all, he felt a fatal threat surge toward him from every direction at once, as though he would be crushed into dust in the very next moment.
Yet that suffocating pressure suddenly lightened.
It was as though some unseen Strength in the dark had blocked this certain-kill strike for him.
Daniel remained completely unharmed.
Swish!
A towering, muscular figure appeared out of thin air above the ruins.
It was none other than Oracle-grade Trell, the Oracle-grade of the Godkin.
"You... what are you hiding on you?"
Trell’s face showed suspicion, while rage churned violently in his chest.
That attack just now should have easily crushed this ant to death.
Yet a sudden ripple had emerged and effortlessly canceled out his Strength.
"What happened?"
The sages of God Realm were utterly bewildered.
"Main God Trell..."
They froze in place.
"Hmph."
Daniel lifted his head and sneered.
"I am a contestant of the Starlight Rankings. How could a tiny Oracle-grade T3 like you possibly kill me?"
"Hahahaha..."
Trell laughed from sheer fury, while the sages looked at one another in disbelief.
Had this human lost his mind?
How dared he say something like that?
A tiny Oracle-grade?
A contestant of the Starlight Rankings.
Trell quickly came to a realization.
So that was it. It seemed Angel had given him something to rely on.
Trell clenched his fist tightly. Veins bulged across it, twisting like writhing snakes.
He sneered inwardly.
"So what? Gold-grade Mountain may be able to protect you once, but can it protect you forever?"
"You dare touch me?"
Not only did Daniel show no fear whatsoever, he even poured oil onto the fire.
"If you touch a single hair on my head, Gold-grade Mountain will uproot both you and the entire Godkin."
This year’s Starlight Rankings was completely different from previous years.
In the past, it had merely been an internal affair of the Canaan Starfield.
But this time, several starfields had joined forces to host it together.
Only the prodigies ranked in the top thirty of the Starlight Rankings could make it onto the list.
They no longer represented only themselves.
They represented the face and interests of the entire Canaan Starfield.
Right now, in the eyes of Gold-grade Mountain, Daniel’s weight was absolutely no less than that of an Oracle-grade.
The Godkin—
Did they dare touch him?
"Hahahaha—"
Trell suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly. His laughter was filled with madness, and his eyes were bloodshot.
"I am an Oracle-grade!"
"You think I don’t dare kill you?"
He grinned viciously, his voice like a sinister wind scraping up from hell.
"How many of my Godkin subjects have you slaughtered? You crushed my Pantheon Summit Hall into dust! And now you ask me whether I dare?"
"Today, I will use your blood to pay tribute to the people of my Godkin!"
Trell’s entire body trembled, and an invisible, terrifying aura spread outward like a tide, instantly enveloping Daniel.
He sneered.
"The aura on that invitation was deliberately left behind by Angel, wasn’t it? If you want to survive, then call him here!"
"I’d like to see which is faster—you, or me! Hahahaha—"
"Ant... die!"
Boom—!
At that critical moment, Daniel’s body suddenly erupted with dazzling light.
An illusory figure appeared out of thin air, standing in front of him!

If a sage wanted to flee, he could not catch them.
So first, he had to drive them into a dead end.
"Pantheon Summit Hall...
With so many sages slumbering here, anyone could tell this must be an extraordinary place."
He tilted his head and looked toward the ruins.
The once magnificent and resplendent palace had now been reduced to nothing more than a heap of broken stones and shattered tiles.
A ten-thousand-meter-tall Immortal Sacred Idol split its mouth open, revealing a savage grin.
Then it raised its colossal foot and stomped down fiercely.
With a single step, it crushed the foundation of Pantheon Summit Hall.
And not only did it crush it—it even ground its foot over it twice, as though snuffing out an ant.
That step shattered more than mere stone.
It shattered the face God Realm had upheld for countless years.
The sages of God Realm were instantly enraged, their faces twisting with fury.
"This is blasphemy against the gods!
This is an unforgivable offense!"
"I want that human dead!"
This was no longer a battle of blades and spells.
This was humiliation.
He was grinding the dignity of the Godkin into the mud.
What that human had crushed was not merely Pantheon Summit Hall, but the glory and faith the Godkin had taken pride in for tens of millions of years.
"I’ve already sent a secret message to the Main God!
He is on His way back!
Hold on!"
"This is unbearable!"
"Kill that human!"
The sages could no longer suppress the raging flames churning in their chests.
Like beasts driven into a corner, they charged forward in a frenzy.
They ignited their Immortal Singularities to the absolute limit, and the might of their sage ranks surged wildly, as though they were about to force this entire world to collapse.
"You want to fight with your lives on the line?
Then come!"
Daniel let out a thunderous roar, his blood boiling.
He pushed his secret art to its extreme, and his true body, along with his ninety-nine avatars, charged toward the three mid-grade sages at the same time.
"Chaotic Reincarnation—rise!"
In the void, that enormous pair of eyes, one black and one white, suddenly opened.
Their radiance erupted like blazing suns.
The left eye was snow-white.
The right eye was pitch-black.
Black and white light intertwined and coiled together, transforming into a pillar of light that pierced heaven and earth, firmly enveloping the three sages within it.
However, the sage rank of a mid-grade sage was incomparably stable and solid.
It was like an immortal fortress, firmly protecting its master’s body.
The pillar of light failed to pierce through it.
Rumble—!
Heaven and earth collapsed.
Boom—!
The spatial barrier of God Realm shattered.
At that very moment, the void of God Realm suddenly trembled, like the surface of a lake struck by a massive boulder.
Ripples spread outward, layer upon layer.
A figure had yet to appear, but a furious roar had already exploded like thunder, shaking the entirety of God Realm.
"Human ant—you are playing with fire!"
"Die!"
An Oracle-grade had arrived.
The furious roar of God Realm’s Oracle-grade rolled across the heavens like thunder, echoing throughout the entire world.
Countless beings of God Realm heard that voice and instantly burst into tears.
One after another, they fell to their knees, clasped their hands together, and with trembling lips, chanted the Oracle-grade’s name again and again.
"It’s the Main God!
Our Godkin Oracle-grade has returned!"
"God Realm is saved!"
"We can finally watch that human be judged with our own eyes!"
The beings of God Realm were not unaware that a powerful human had slaughtered his way into their home.
That man had massacred countless lives on their land, crushed Pantheon Summit Hall, and was nearly unstoppable.
What kind of humiliation was this?
But the powerful beings of God Realm knew exactly what they were capable of.
They did not dare throw their lives away.
All they could do was pray silently in their hearts, praying that the Godkin Oracle-grades traveling through the Endless Starsea would return soon and save God Realm.
And now, at this moment, an Oracle-grade had truly returned.
Whoosh—!
The instant the three mid-grade sages heard that voice, wild joy erupted across their faces.
They immediately pulled away from Daniel at top speed.
If the battle continued, they would sooner or later be worn down by this human until the last drop of their blood was drained dry.
"The one who has returned is the strongest Oracle-grade of our Godkin—Oracle-grade T3, Main God Trell!"
"With Main God Trell here, that human is dead for sure!"
"A mere human from Aetheria!
A race of ants!
Aside from this one human, they don’t even have a single decent powerhouse.
What could they possibly use to contend against our Godkin?"
Daniel’s expression remained calm, without the slightest trace of panic.
"Heh...
Oracle-grade."
The corner of his mouth slowly curved into an icy smile.
But in that very instant—
"Die—!"
A furious shout exploded inside his mind.
Before Daniel could react at all, he felt a fatal threat surge toward him from every direction at once, as though he would be crushed into dust in the very next moment.
Yet that suffocating pressure suddenly lightened.
It was as though some unseen Strength in the dark had blocked this certain-kill strike for him.
Daniel remained completely unharmed.
Swish!
A towering, muscular figure appeared out of thin air above the ruins.
It was none other than Oracle-grade Trell, the Oracle-grade of the Godkin.
"You... what are you hiding on you?"
Trell’s face showed suspicion, while rage churned violently in his chest.
That attack just now should have easily crushed this ant to death.
Yet a sudden ripple had emerged and effortlessly canceled out his Strength.
"What happened?"
The sages of God Realm were utterly bewildered.
"Main God Trell..."
They froze in place.
"Hmph."
Daniel lifted his head and sneered.

"Hahahaha..."

Had this human lost his mind?
How dared he say something like that?
A tiny Oracle-grade?
A contestant of the Starlight Rankings.
Trell quickly came to a realization.
So that was it.
It seemed Angel had given him something to rely on.
Trell clenched his fist tightly.
Veins bulged across it, twisting like writhing snakes.

chapters.title: Chapter 262 -262-Using the Godkin’s People as Bargaining Chips Again
paragraphs: The moment that illusory figure appeared, it casually dissolved Trell’s Oracle-grade power as though it were nothing.
Immediately afterward, he rushed forward, kicked Trell flying, then caught up to him in an instant and planted one foot firmly on Trell’s face.
Boom—!
The phantom and Trell crashed to the ground together.
That foot was pressed squarely against Trell’s face.
"As you requested, I have come."
The illusory figure was none other than Angel, the emissary of Gold-grade Mountain—
A T6 Oracle-grade!
"Main God Trell!"
The sages of God Realm gaped, their jaws nearly dropping to the ground.
"Main God Trell... was actually trampled underfoot!"
In that instant, the worldview of the Godkin sages shattered into dust.
"Our Godkin... how have we fallen to such a... such a humiliating state?"
One sage shed tears in disbelief.
Daniel could not help but let out a breath of relief.
"Justin really didn’t lie to me."
A smile surfaced on Daniel’s face.
"The stronger an Oracle-grade is, the sharper their perception becomes."
Justin had once said that those who truly stood at the peak could capture you along the threads of karma even if you merely formed a thought about them.
"Lord Angel really did come."
Daniel laughed inwardly.
"I’m a contestant representing the Canaan Starfield, and the impression I left on Angel wasn’t bad either. Besides, I have a trump card. Even if Angel hadn’t come, I wouldn’t have died."
After all, the one staying here right now was merely a puppet avatar.

Not to mention, Daniel still had Immortal Revival protecting him. Even if he recklessly courted death without limit, as long as he did not provoke a supreme-grade existence, he would suffer no real loss.
"Now, state your demand."
Angel’s voice was as cold as frost, with none of the previous warmth left in it.
Trell was still pinned to the ground, his mind dazed and foggy.
"Your Excellency, I refuse to accept this!"
He spoke through gritted teeth.
"The blood feud between Faustus and my Godkin cannot be washed away! You are blatantly favoring him. I cannot accept it!"
"You cannot accept it?"
Angel did not withdraw the foot pressed against Trell’s face. His tone was calm, as though he were speaking of something utterly insignificant.
"I do not care how deep the grudge between you is. The issue now is that Faustus cannot die."
"After he finishes participating in the Starlight Rankings Tournament, what you want to do then is none of my concern."
"Do you... understand?"
Angel’s voice suddenly turned colder.
Trell’s eyes were bloodshot, and his chest rose and fell violently. Clearly, he was unconvinced.
"What?"
A layer of frost seemed to settle over Angel’s face.
"Trell, do you want your Godkin to vanish completely from this star sea?"
Vanish completely!
The words of a T6 Oracle-grade were not a threat.
They were a statement of fact.
With his strength, forget annihilating one Godkin race. Even ten thousand Godkin races would be nothing more than the lift of a finger.
Trell clenched his teeth and forced out the words one by one.
"I... understand."
Only then did Angel remove his foot from Trell’s face. His tone was as indifferent as a passing breeze.
"Before the Starlight Rankings begin, not a single Oracle-grade of your Godkin is allowed to step into the starry skies of the myriad races. Otherwise—you know the consequences."
"Now get lost."
Trell climbed to his feet and glared fiercely at Daniel. His gaze looked as though he wanted to carve this human into his very bones.
Then he turned into a streak of light and vanished at the far end of the sky.
"Faustus."
Angel turned his head. His brows furrowed slightly, and there was a trace of warning in his voice.
"Take care of yourself."
"Thank you for intervening, Your Excellency."
Daniel nodded.
Swish—!
A faint smile appeared on Angel’s face, but it vanished in an instant. Along with it, his phantom also dispersed into the void.
The Godkin’s Oracle-grade had arrived with a chest full of fury, yet departed with a belly full of humiliation.
Daniel’s eyes were like two blades as he looked toward the three sages who had long since lost their will to fight.
That gaze scraped across their backs, making their spines turn cold and their hearts tremble.
"It’s over... Main God Trell has left. We’re injured this badly. We’re no match for him at all."
"Looks like... we have to run as well."
"If we want to escape, he can’t catch us."
Daniel seemed to have heard their muttering. The corners of his mouth lifted slightly.
"Of course you can run. But—I don’t believe every living being of your Godkin can run with you."
"Now, I’ll use the lives of everyone in God Realm as bargaining chips to exchange for a few things... That’s reasonable, isn’t it?"
Using the countless billions of lives in God Realm as bargaining chips—
This was outright robbery.
And not only that, it was one man robbing an entire world.
A supreme-grade extorting a group of sages!
The faces of the three sages turned deathly pale, as though an invisible hand had seized them by the throat.
"Faustus! You actually dare threaten the entire God Realm!"
"You’re recklessly bold! Far too arrogant!"
"You’re only one man... How dare you..."
"But... we really can’t do anything to him!"
One sage’s voice was filled with agony.
"Damn bastard!"
The final roar sounded as though it had been squeezed out from between clenched teeth.
Above the ruins of Pantheon Summit Hall, Daniel stood high above them, overlooking the entire God Realm.
Those sages who had once stood loftily above all others could only lower their heads now.
"Faustus... what do you want?"
One sage gritted his teeth.
"Use your Godkin’s Fortune Points to sign a contract."
Daniel’s voice did not fluctuate in the slightest.

"The contents of the contract are simple. For ten thousand years, the Godkin are forbidden from entering any territory of mine. You are also forbidden from doing anything that harms the living beings under my rule. Otherwise, the Godkin’s Fortune Points will fall to zero."
Hiss—!
The three sages sucked in a sharp breath at the same time, as though something icy had drilled into the cracks of their bones.
Using their race’s Fortune Points as collateral—
This contract was as poisonous as it could possibly be.
Once the Godkin’s Fortune Points dropped to zero, heavenly punishment would completely annihilate the Godkin.
"No!"
That was the first thought that flashed through their minds, and it almost came out of their mouths at once.
"But if we don’t agree..."
Another sage said in a low voice.

"Today, God Realm will become a river of blood... His Majesty the God Emperor’s advancement is still at a critical moment and cannot be disturbed. Main God Trell can’t be relied on either. What else can we do?"
"To agree just like this... I can’t stomach it!"
"Forget it. It’s only ten thousand years..."
Ten thousand years!
To sages who had lived for tens of millions of years, it was no more than the blink of an eye.
"Faustus, this matter... we agree."
The leading sage nodded with great difficulty.
"What is the second matter?"
"The second matter."
Daniel’s gaze stabbed toward them like a blade.
"I want to enter the deepest part of your God Realm’s Bloodtide Sea to search for someone. Give me the highest authority over Bloodtide Sea."
He had never forgotten Kelly.
He wanted to know—
Was she still alive?
Was she still there?
The three sages exchanged glances. The muscles on their faces twitched a few times.
"Fine."
Canaan Starfield, Gold-grade Star System, Golden Realm.
Angel, the Oracle-grade of Gold-grade Mountain, slowly opened his eyes. Deep within his pupils, the light of laws flowed like a turning galaxy.
He was a T6 Oracle-grade.
His true body had always remained hidden within the secret realm of headquarters. The one running around outside was nothing more than an avatar.
"Faustus... interesting."
The corner of his mouth lifted slightly.
"He even dared to use me. He certainly has some nerve."
Though he said that, there was not the slightest hint of anger on his face.
Angel smiled, then closed his eyes once again, sinking back into meditation.
The path of an Oracle-grade was a road walked along the edge of a cliff.
The higher the rank, the closer one was to death.
They had to climb upward without stopping for even a moment. Only then could they seize that one faint chance of stepping past death from an almost impossibly slim probability.
That was also why T9 Oracle-grades almost never showed themselves.
The tribulations they had to face were hundreds of millions of times greater than those of a T6 Oracle-grade.
Very few survived.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 -263-A Great Upheaval, Ascending to the Third Seat
paragraphs: At the same time.
At Gold-grade Mountain headquarters, the powerhouse responsible for preparing the Starlight Rankings suddenly received a secret message.
"Change the rules of the Starlight Rankings?"
The command that appeared in his mind left him greatly surprised.
"Since this is Lord Angel’s will, then so be it."
Before him stood an ancient stone stele.
Engraved upon its surface was a ranking list—
The Canaan Starfield Starlight Rankings.
[Canaan Starfield Starlight Rankings]
On the Starlight Rankings stele, light flowed like water. Ancient runes lit up one after another, revealing names engraved deep within the star sea.
First Seat: James, Frostfall Galaxy.
Strength: Peak demi-sage rank.
Battle Record: Swept through several galaxies. Among his generation, none could withstand even a single exchange against him. He has slain Divine-grade powerhouses before.

Starlight Rankings Evaluation: His strength lies hidden beneath layers of deep ice, and no one can glimpse its full extent. Every step he takes is like walking on thin ice, cautious to the point of near obsession. The "peak" others see is far from his final destination!
Second Seat: Mosi, Misty Rain Galaxy.
Strength: Peak demi-sage rank.
Battle Record: Walks within the shadows. Has assassinated Divine-grade powerhouses multiple times, never once failing, never once tasting defeat.

Starlight Rankings Evaluation: This child has an exceptional grasp of the laws of space. He comes and goes without a trace, killing with a single strike. Whenever he makes a move, blood must be spilled. He is the blade in the dark night, rational as iron and cold as frost.
Third Seat: Raylor, Silverlight Galaxy.
Strength Rating: Peak demi-sage rank.

Starlight Rankings Evaluation: The Godkin genius with the greatest hope of stepping into the Oracle-grade realm in countless years. Obsessed with battle, training day and night without pause, possessing tyrannical combat power!
Twenty-seventh Seat: Faustus, Silverlight Galaxy.
Strength Rating: Quasi-sage.
Battle Record: The prodigy of this generation who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak, renowned across countless worlds.
Starlight Rankings Evaluation: ...
Following the command that had appeared deep in his mind, the person in charge erased Faustus’s old records one by one, then added brand-new content.
With a gentle wave of his hand, the ranking list erupted with brilliant light, and the words were reforged.
Faustus’s ranking leapt directly over Raylor and landed firmly in the Third Seat!
[Canaan Starfield Starlight Rankings]
Third Seat: Faustus, Silverlight Galaxy.
Strength: Quasi-sage.
Main Battle Record: The prodigy of this generation who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak. During the battle in God Realm, he single-handedly killed six Low Divine-grade powerhouses in an instant.
Starlight Rankings Evaluation: Among his generation, few can rival him. His path is a stairway to the throne, paved upon the spines of gods!
"To make Lord Angel personally speak up on his behalf... This fellow Faustus truly has good fortune."
The person in charge smiled faintly. His gaze fell upon the completely renewed ranking list as he murmured to himself.
"Once this ranking list is released, the entire starfield is probably going to be turned upside down."
Some major force in the Elysian Starfield.
"There’s been a huge change in the Starlight Rankings!"
Throughout the starfield, all the major forces had subsidiary steles connected to the Starlight Rankings, updating in real time.
The moment there was even the slightest movement on the rankings, they would know immediately.
But this change was simply too massive.
"The Third Seat has changed..."
"Faustus? Is that the Starchosen who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak in this generation?"
"His ranking shot straight from twenty-seventh place to the Third Seat!"
"Hurry, look at his battle record... He instantly killed six sages! Hiss—!"
"Peak demi-sage rank combat power. Another peak powerhouse!"
"...Hiss, what a high evaluation! If the first two weren’t still supported by their past achievements, Faustus might seriously threaten their positions!"
The news seemed to grow wings, instantly spreading throughout the entire starfield and even flying into other starfields.

"Right now, the tournament comes first. After the tournament ends, we’ll settle accounts with Faustus."
Raylor’s voice turned cold.
"The blood debt of countless kin must be repaid."
A cold light flashed in Aldor’s eyes.
In the shadows of other starfields, whispers surged like the tide.
"Another peak demi-sage rank has appeared in the Canaan Starfield? And he stepped straight into the Third Seat? Something about this doesn’t feel right."
"The Canaan Starfield’s luck has always been good. Hmph, but that’s all there is to it."
"The tournament is about to begin. Is the Canaan Starfield deliberately pushing this Faustus too high, or is he truly hiding some unknown ability?"
"This fellow... is worth watching carefully."
God Realm.
The conditions Faustus had proposed were like a blade pressed against their necks. God Realm did not dare refuse.
"The times have changed..."
A sage felt bitter in his heart, his voice filled with helplessness.
Who could have imagined that the Aetheria humans, who had once been no different from refugees of the starry sky years ago, would now ride above God Realm’s head?
"Why does my Godkin only have one Raylor? If the Godkin also had a powerhouse like Faustus, how wonderful would that be?"
They could not help but envy the Fortune Points of the Aetheria humans.
Such a barren land had actually given birth to a heaven-defying prodigy like Faustus.
"Aldor can barely be considered presentable as well, though he’s still somewhat inferior to Raylor. Right now, only Raylor can compare with Faustus."
Someone thought of the few geniuses among the younger generation of the Godkin.
"I just wonder, between Raylor and Faustus... who is stronger?"
Although they said that, after experiencing the battle against Faustus, their hearts had long since leaned toward that human.
That guy was too strong!
So strong it made them despair!
Bloodtide Sea.
Faustus’s figure abruptly appeared beneath this inverted sea.
Bloodtide Sea was not on the ground.
It was in the sky.
The seawater was not azure blue, but purple-red, like stagnant blood that had congealed for tens of millions of years.
The entire sea hung upside down upon the dome of heaven, yet not a single drop of seawater fell.
This was Bloodtide Sea—
The number one forbidden land of God Realm, a place even Divine-grade powerhouses did not dare set foot in lightly.
At this moment, beneath Bloodtide Sea, a figure was waiting for Faustus.

He was the existence who had been entrusted with great expectations from the moment he was born, only to eventually become the laughingstock of the entire God Realm.
"Faustus... you came!"
Simon wore a smile as he slowly spoke.
Faustus saw him at once, then frowned slightly.
"It’s you?"

chapters.title: Chapter 264 -264-Worthless Simon? Kelly’s Departure!
paragraphs: Daniel frowned deeply.
For some reason, the aura emanating from this God Realm powerhouse before him felt strangely familiar.
"The aura on you... it’s exactly the same as the one from that message that day!"
"You guessed right. It was me."
Simon seemed lost in thought.
"Do you think what I did was right... or wrong?"
"I warned you, and as a result, you stormed into the God Realm, slaughtered countless Godkin, and trampled the Pantheon Summit Hall beneath your feet."
"Would you say I brought disaster upon myself?"
Daniel’s gaze sharpened, and his voice sank.
"Only the weak obsess over right and wrong. You are not one of them."
"Then tell me this. What I did—was it foolish, or was it madness?"
Simon pressed him again.
"What do other people’s opinions have to do with you? Just follow your own heart."
The corner of Daniel’s mouth lifted, his smile proud and domineering.

"I, Faustus, have lived my entire life asking only what my own heart demands. I do not need anyone’s approval, nor do I care to explain myself to anyone. No one is worthy of judging me—not even the Creator."
"As expected of the man she could never forget."
Simon suddenly sighed and shook his head, his tone carrying an emotion that was hard to describe.
"You and Kelly... you’re alike, yet not alike."
"But the things you say always have a way of making people restless inside."
Kelly?
A faint glimmer flashed deep within Daniel’s pupils.
"Tell me about her."
"She was the one who changed me."
Simon smiled faintly, though there was something indescribable hidden within that smile.
"Who would have thought that a human, someone less than an ant in the eyes of those gods, could change the fate of a worthless Godkin?"

"She was the one who dragged me out of the mire where everyone mocked me. She made me become what I am today. She was also the one who made me feel that, in this world, there were still things worth doing."
"Back then, in the deepest part of the Bloodtide Sea, she was tormented by pain day and night, yet she still refused to open the Door of Truth."
Simon continued, "Because the price of opening that door was forgetting everything."

"She said there was someone in this world more important to her than her own life. That was why she would rather endure all that suffering, hesitating and struggling all that time over whether she should push open that door."
"I couldn’t understand it. Someone like Kelly, someone with such immense willpower, could still have moments when she could not let go."
Simon sighed.
"I wonder if she has... pushed open that door by now."
"Take me there."
Daniel’s voice was calm.
"Fine."
Simon smiled.
"But first, you have to fight me. Defeat me, and I’ll take you."
Boom—!
Simon’s entire body trembled. An unparalleled aura erupted from him.

That aura swept upward like a violent gale, surging into the Bloodtide Sea above them. The purple-black waves churned violently, as though some colossal beast that had slumbered for countless ages was slowly opening its eyes beneath the sea.
"What’s going on? Did something happen at the Bloodtide Sea?"
"What kind of enemy did Faustus encounter? That doesn’t make sense. What powerhouse could possibly exist in the Bloodtide Sea?"
"This... this is Simon’s aura! Since when did he have such terrifying strength?"
The sages of the God Realm were so shocked that they could barely speak properly.
"Wait... it really does seem to be Simon!"
"That fellow Simon... he hid himself far too deeply..."
"A fight?"
The corner of Daniel’s mouth lifted slightly.
"I’m afraid I might accidentally beat you to death."
"Hahaha!"
Simon threw his head back and laughed.
"Come, Faustus! Let me know just how strong I truly am! Let me see how high the heavens really are!"
Boom—!
The space around Simon cracked open with countless dense fissures, like glass that had been smashed by a heavy hammer.
"He is indeed not weak."
Daniel was inwardly startled.
"That is... the God Realm secret art, the Great God of Light Body!"
The sages of the God Realm sensed the distant fluctuations in aura and instantly recognized Simon’s foundation.
"Unbelievable. So many Godkin powerhouses have tried to master this secret art. But aside from those two Oracle-grade beings from long ago, no one else has ever succeeded."

"It isn’t merely difficult to master. This secret art requires one to draw endless blazing suns into the body. Every advancement is like being burned by the sun itself, like bathing in fire. Without an iron will, even if one barely manages to begin, the backlash will reduce them to nothing but bones."
"Everyone who attempted to master this secret art in the past eventually could not endure the agony and chose to end their own lives!"
"I never expected Simon to have already reached this rank!"
"Battle—!"
Simon roared and charged forward in an instant.
His figure was as fast as a streak of light, leaving behind a long chain of afterimages.
With every step he took, the space around him shattered.
Boom! Boom—!
Above Daniel’s head, ice and fire elements condensed into a vast ocean. With a thunderous crash, it came down like a colossal wave, smashing straight toward Simon and swallowing him in an instant.
"Even without using Endless Divine Power, this strike should be more than enough to make a Divine-grade powerhouse suffer."
Daniel did not unfold his Divine Domain, nor did he use any secret art. He had used less than ten percent of his strength.
Boom—!
Simon burst out from the ocean of elements.
Light coiled around his entire body. Blood hung at the corner of his mouth, and his face was as pale as paper.
"I’m done!"
He panted heavily, his voice weak.
"Although I didn’t use my full strength either, I can tell now. I’m completely no match for you."
"You are already very strong."
Daniel said calmly.
"Much stronger than that Nubat."
"I have no interest in comparing myself to those people. Come on, I’ll take you to the Bloodtide Sea now."
Simon asked, "Do you have the authority?"
"I possess the highest authority."
Daniel smiled.
"Then let’s go straight to the deepest part."
The deepest part of the Bloodtide Sea.
The Door of Truth hovered there, half real and half illusory, like a rift frozen in the void.
There was no one here anymore.
"Kelly... still left after all."
Simon shook his head and sighed.
"I wonder if there will ever be a chance to see her again."
Daniel’s gaze swept across the silent surface of the sea before suddenly stopping at one place.
There was a massive stone there.
On the stone, a line of words had been carved. The seawater had already eroded it until it was somewhat blurred.
"Let the self sink into the abyss of oblivion. Let emotion recede with the tides. I am no longer myself. Only emptiness remains eternal..."
"So she did push open that door after all."
Daniel’s voice was very calm.
"The price of opening the Door of Truth is forgetting all memories. But what lies on the other side of the door?"
"Simon, what exactly is on the other side of the Door of Truth?"
"In the legends of the Godkin... the other side of the door is another universe."
There was uncertainty in Simon’s tone.
"But it is only a legend. No powerhouse in the God Realm has ever opened that door before. Kelly was the first."
"In other words, no one can say for certain what she will encounter after pushing it open."
Daniel fell silent.
He did not know how to judge Kelly.
To call her foolish—she had dared to risk her life on an illusory legend in order to find a path of survival for the human race.
To say she was not foolish—after all, it was only a legend, and she had entered that door alone.
No one knew what awaited her ahead.
He shook his head helplessly.
Just then—
[Ding! You have received a new quest: Starlight Rankings Tournament!]
[Hint: Your main body is about to be forcibly teleported. Destination unknown. Please prepare yourself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 265 -265-Raylor, Thrown Out
paragraphs: This is... the gathering before the tournament?
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
Then his gaze shifted toward Simon, whose expression was equally complicated.
"Simon, I’ll be leaving first. Until we meet again!"
"Hm?"
Before Simon could even react, Daniel’s figure had already vanished completely from the spot.
[Ding! You have discovered Greatflow World. Contribution Points +3,000,000!]
Whoosh—!
Daniel appeared in a brand-new world.
[Ding! You have activated a new quest. A new quest has been added to your quest log. Please check it.]
He spread out his mind power.
Boom—!
His mind power swept outward like a tide, instantly covering two-thirds of the entire plane.
"This is... Great World-level."
His eyes narrowed.
Worlds were divided into World Fragments, Small Worlds, Medium Worlds, Great Worlds...
Only a Great World could prevent his mind power from covering it completely.
The God Realm was a Great World.
Unexpectedly, Greatflow World was actually on the same level as the God Realm!
"But something is wrong with this place... It’s far too barren."
Under the probing of his mind power, this world seemed to have suffered irreversible devastation.
Rivers had dried up. The land was cracked and hardened. MP was so thin that it resembled a dying patient on its last breath.
"So this is the gathering place for the Starlight Rankings?"
He also sensed the auras of dozens of powerful beings within the range of his mind power.
Those people reacted differently to his act of probing with mind power.
"In the name of the Lord... whose mind power is this? Isn’t this far too arrogant?"
One powerhouse’s face turned livid.
In an unfamiliar land, who would dare release their mind power so brazenly?
Were they not afraid of provoking some terrifying hidden existence?
And yet, there really was such a reckless madman, one who did not care in the slightest as he planted his mind power in everyone’s faces like a banner.
"Who exactly is this sacred figure? How can they be so confident?"
"Heh... Is this a provocation?"
Another powerhouse spoke in a low voice.
In certain ancient customs of the star rivers, such behavior was equivalent to declaring war face-to-face!
"Is it James? Or Mosi? Or could it be... Faustus?"
Someone’s lips curled into an amused smile as they began to guess.
That mind power showed no intention of restraining itself at all.
It was like a sharp blade, carving invisible marks through the void.
Perhaps provoked by that domineering aura, several powerhouses could no longer hold themselves back and released their own mind power one after another.
Then, like a plague spreading, one after another, everyone extended the feelers of their mind power.
As though if they did not do so, they would lose in terms of momentum.
However, these rampaging strands of mind power all carefully withdrew their hostility. They merely probed and collided with one another.
Rumble—!
Just then, a thunderclap suddenly exploded across the firmament. Purple-white lightning tore through the heavy, stagnant air.
The attention of all the powerhouses was instantly drawn over.
A vast, ancient voice descended from above the heavens, deep and distant.
"The thirty participants of the Canaan Starfield have all arrived."
"An Oracle-grade!"
Someone cried out softly.
"An Oracle-grade... I wonder which one from Gold-grade Mountain it is?"
"The top thirty powerhouses of the Starlight Rankings are all here."
The vast voice continued, "This world is named Greatflow. It shall serve as your gathering place."
"There is still some time before the tournament begins. For now, you will make preparations here and await further instructions from Gold-grade Mountain."
The voice abruptly turned stern, like an iron hammer striking an anvil.
"There are two rules in this place..."
All the powerhouses held their breaths and listened intently.
"First, killing any participant is strictly forbidden. Violators shall be imprisoned in the Forbidden Land for one million years!"
"Second, leaving this world without permission is strictly forbidden. Violators shall be imprisoned in the Forbidden Land for one million years!"
As the voice faded, the sky returned to normal.
That terrifying Oracle-grade aura receded like the tide and vanished in the blink of an eye.
Only then did Daniel open his quest log.
Ever since the game and reality had merged, the position of the quest log had not changed. It had merely transformed from a virtual interface into a translucent screen within his field of vision.
[Participate in the Starlight Rankings Tournament (I)]
Quest Type: Special
Quest Requirement: Full participation
Quest Objective: Remain at the gathering point and await the next instruction from Gold-grade Mountain.

Quest Description: Within the Endless Starsea, every major starfield has its own Starlight Rankings. Starlight shines upon the prodigies below Divine-grade. Now, for the first time, the major starfields have jointly organized a cross-starfield Starlight Rankings Tournament. Rankings will be used to allocate benefits, with the goal of avoiding endless slaughter between starfields and concentrating Strength against threats from the outer universe.
This universe-level tournament is of utmost importance. As a participant from the Canaan Starfield, please await the next instruction.
Quest Duration: Long-term
Quest Reward: [Mental State] ×10,000; [Next-stage Quest]
Daniel casually closed the quest log.
"Mental State... That’s good stuff."
A smile appeared on his lips.
"Without Mental State, my strength would never have risen this quickly."
Although leveling up required comprehension and breakthroughs, Daniel could directly use Mental State.
Why suffer through bitter cultivation when there was a shortcut available?
Wouldn’t that be stupid?
Most other powerhouses at the peak of demi-sage rank had already comprehended the Divine-grade trait of Thoughtstep, or possessed the bodily traits of a sage. He, however, had none of those.
People like Conrad and Camille already had some Divine-grade characteristics.
"Mental State has both advantages and disadvantages."
Daniel blinked.
"The disadvantage is—it’s far too scarce."
Last time, he had used up all his Mental State, and it had only been enough to push his Divine Domain to the threshold. He had yet to truly touch the quasi-sage Rank.
A reward of ten thousand Mental State would become ten billion after the Millionfold Boost.
That should be enough for him to awaken one of the two great Divine-grade traits.
Seen that way, the quest reward was rather decent.
"Right now, I’m actually only supreme-grade. It’s just that... I’m a tiny bit stronger than ordinary supreme-grade beings."
"Mm! There’s still plenty of room for improvement!"
Daniel’s mind power swept in every direction without the slightest restraint.
The entire Greatflow World only contained thirty living beings. Logically speaking, it should not feel crowded at all.
And yet, somehow, it did feel crowded!
"Hm? There’s a building over there."
His mind power detected an area where MP was abnormally abundant.
In this Great World, which was so barren that it had nearly died, that place was practically an oasis in the desert.
MP was dense there. Grass and trees flourished, and even divine beasts could be seen roaming.
At the center of that oasis stood a building, backed by mountains and facing the sea. Its style was extremely similar to that of a countryside manor.
"What a fine place."
Daniel could not help but sigh in admiration.
However, his mind power also sensed that quite a few powerhouses were converging in that direction.
Westmoor Manor.
Boom! Boom—!
Several loud explosions rang out.
A group of powerhouses of various shapes and sizes flew out of the manor gate like cannonballs, crashing heavily into the ground and smashing open several large craters.
"Hahaha... What are these idiots doing?"
"Shh—are you tired of living? Didn’t you see that Raylor is among the people who got thrown out?"
"Ahem. Even Raylor of the Godkin is there? Fine, I take back what I said."
"Even Raylor was driven out? Could it be that one of the top three rankers has occupied the place inside?"
"I went in there too and got blasted out. James and Mosi are inside!"
"Hiss—so it’s the First Seat and Second Seat. No wonder even Raylor got thrown out."
