chapters.title: Chapter 272 -272-Mid-Grade Law of Fate
paragraphs: A smile tugged at the corner of Daniel’s mouth as he continued pouring Mental State into his advancement.
[Ding! You have consumed Mental State. Your current Rank has been raised to—Peak Demi-Sage!]
[Ding! You have comprehended the Sage Physique!]
The Sage Physique!
A sharp gleam flickered through Daniel’s eyes.

He still remembered his journey to the God Realm during that Instance. Back then, he had hurled attacks dealing tens of billions, even hundreds of billions, of damage at the God of Light. He had indeed managed to wound the deity.
But in the blink of an eye, those wounds had healed as though they had never existed.
That alone was enough to reveal just how terrifying the Sage Physique truly was.

Had Daniel not possessed a secret art like Endless Divine Power, which specifically countered the Sage Physique, he would have had no confidence whatsoever in completely destroying a sage’s body right now, much less killing one in a single strike. At best, he would have been forced to grind the sage down little by little.
"And now, I have this ability in my hands as well."

Daniel sensed the earth-shaking transformation taking place within his body. An explosive surge of Strength coursed through his bloodline. His speed of absorbing elemental energy had increased by tens of millions of times, while the production rate of his Immortal Singularity had risen by several tens of thousands of times.
The Sage Physique was indeed tyrannical!
No wonder ordinary legendary-grade and supreme-grade beings appeared so powerless before a sage.
With the crushing advantage granted by the Immortal Singularity alone, a sage could beat a legendary-grade powerhouse so badly that they would not even know which way was up.
A sage possessed three signature abilities: Thoughtstep, the Sage Physique, and the power of the sage rank!
At present, Daniel had already mastered the first two.
If he could obtain the power of the sage rank as well, then he would become a true Divine-grade powerhouse in every sense of the word!
[Ding! You have consumed Mental State...]
[Ding! Your current Mental State points have been completely exhausted!]
"Hm?! I didn’t break through?"
Daniel froze for a moment.
He had poured every remaining point of Mental State into the advancement, yet he was still stuck at the threshold.
But after thinking about it, that made perfect sense. If becoming a sage were really so easy, sages would not be so rare in the first place.

It was probably for the best that he had failed to break through. After all, if he truly advanced into the Divine-grade right now, he would instead lose his eligibility to participate in the tournament.
"Next, let’s raise my level."
He clicked manually.
[Ding! You have consumed experience points. Your current level has increased to Level 520!]
[Ding! You have consumed experience points. Your current level has increased to Level 540!]
[Ding! You have consumed experience points. Your current level has increased to Level 599!]
[Ding! You have yet to break through your current Rank. You must complete your breakthrough before you can continue leveling up.]
Only after his Rank advanced to the Divine-grade would he gain access to Level 600 and beyond.
For now, his level had reached a complete dead end.
"In that case... the cooldown on Essence of Elemental Laws should be over by now. I can continue deducing a new Law."
Daniel took out the sacred tome glowing with divine radiance.
The cooldown period of Essence of Elemental Laws was thirty days, and each deduction required ten billion points of Primal Spirit.
The amount of Primal Spirit he had accumulated was more than enough for another deduction.
[Ding! You have consumed Primal Spirit. Deducing a Law...]
[Ding! Deduction through Essence of Elemental Laws has been completed—you have obtained the Law of Fate!]
[Ding! The Law obtained through the current deduction is identical to a Law you already possess. Would you like to fuse them? After fusion, the level of the Law will be increased.]
"It’s actually the Law of Fate again!"
Daniel’s heart skipped a beat.
The Law of Fate he had obtained from the previous deduction had only been low-grade, yet it had already increased his strength by a tremendous margin.
If he fused another one into it...
"Fuse them!"
He did not hesitate in the slightest.
[Ding! Fusion successful.]
[Ding! The level of your current Law of Fate has been raised to—Mid-Grade!]
Daniel immediately opened the details of the evolved Law.
[Law of Fate — Mid-Grade]
Effects:

Alter [Outcome], while also gaining a minor degree of protection against fate and causality. Damage received from fate- and causality-type attacks is reduced. [Causal Reversal] — You may reverse the causal thread connecting you and your target, exchanging "effect" and "cause," forcing the target to suffer damage and special effects identical to its current attack output. Your protection against fate and causality has been greatly enhanced. Damage received from Laws is significantly reduced.
Note: The power of a Law may be counteracted or strengthened by other Laws. Exact results depend on the strength of the target.
"Mid-grade Law of Fate."
The corners of Daniel’s lips curved upward.
There was no need to say more about how powerful the Law of Fate was. Now that it had advanced in grade, its might had become even more formidable.
"Turning cause into effect..."
After pondering briefly, he immediately grasped the secret behind this ability.
For example, suppose there was a causal thread connecting Person A and Person B.
Person A slashed down with a blade, dealing a fatal wound to Person B.

If Person B activated Causal Reversal, then the lethal damage caused by that slash would be reflected back onto Person A without the slightest reduction, while Person B would remain completely unharmed.
He had to admit—
This ability was absolutely unbelievable!
"It’s basically like giving myself an absurdly overpowered damage-reflection buff."
Daniel fell into thought.
Just then—
[Ding! You have received a new quest: Starlight Tournament II. Please check the details.]
[Ding! Your quest log has been updated. Please view it for further information.]
Daniel opened his quest log.
[Starlight Tournament II] — Special
Restriction: Faustus
Quest Requirement: Participate throughout the entire event
Quest Objective: Obtain [Advancement Round Qualification]
Quest Introduction:

The Starlight Rankings Tournament is of utmost importance. You must devote your full strength to it. Your universe is filled with countless powerful individuals. Only by defeating every obstacle in your path can you obtain the greatest and most abundant rewards.

At the same time, your victory or defeat concerns the fate of the Aetheria human race, including all players. It concerns the Fortune Points of this starfield, and more importantly, the destiny of the Myriad-Star Cosmos itself.
Therefore—make absolutely certain that you obtain qualification for the advancement round!
Quest Reward: [Mysterious Reward — Divine-Grade]
Daniel closed the quest log.
"A mysterious reward... and it’s Divine-grade, too."
He could not help feeling a trace of anticipation.
The rewards granted by system quests had always been top-tier. Their practicality went without saying.
"I hope it’s a skill-type reward. Though another secret art involving a Law would be perfectly acceptable as well."
"As for the difficulty of the quest, it isn’t particularly high."
He smiled faintly.
"It only asks me to obtain qualification for the advancement round."
Compared to the quest reward, this level of difficulty was practically the same as handing the reward to him for free.
"With my current strength, there’s no possible way I’ll fail to make it through the elimination round."
This was not arrogance.
It was confidence backed by overwhelming strength!
At that moment, a glowing object on the table before him suddenly lit up, drawing his attention.
"What is this...?"
Daniel’s gaze landed on a small jade token.
"What kind of item is this?"
Puzzled, he picked up the jade token and attempted to activate it.
Whoosh—!
A roster instantly appeared before his eyes.
[Canaan Starfield Battle Roster]

[Rank 30: Faustus; Combat Power Evaluation: Nine Stars — Highest Rating. Battle Record: Starchosen of the current generation; has slain a Divine-grade powerhouse. Overall Assessment: One of the three Nine-Star powerhouses of the Canaan Starfield.]
"Nine stars."
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
On the roster, James was ranked twenty-ninth, and his danger rating was also nine stars.
Mosi was ranked twenty-eighth, likewise possessing a nine-star rating.
"The entire Canaan Starfield only has three Nine-Star powerhouses? Then how many Nine-Star contenders do the other starfields have?"
He was rather curious.
Daniel immediately began studying every major starfield in the current universe, committing them all to memory, along with the top powerhouses representing each of those starfields.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 -273-The Five Premier Starfields—Nine Stars!
paragraphs: "There are actually more than three hundred starfields participating in this tournament!"
Daniel was somewhat surprised. That number had already exceeded his initial expectations.
"In other words, there must be at least nine thousand contestants. And among them, the Canaan Starfield is considered a premier-tier starfield!"
The Samuel Starfield, the Aurora Starfield, the Kopper Starfield, the Canaan Starfield, and the Vesta Starfield.
Of the more than three hundred participating starfields, these five possessed the greatest overall strength. They stood at the very pinnacle of all first-rate starfields!
"Each of the five premier starfields has at least two Nine-Star powerhouses."
Daniel frowned slightly as he studied the unfamiliar names on the roster.
Nine Stars was the highest possible rating.
Using James and Mosi as points of reference, Daniel realized that the number of terrifyingly powerful individuals in the Endless Starfield far surpassed his imagination.
"Harris is here as well."
Daniel was rather surprised when he saw that name.
He had already taken notice of the man back at Heavenscar.
At the time, the prodigies from both camps had said that Harris possessed an extraordinary background. He was a descendant of the Starlight Folk, the foremost race of the Endless Starfield.
Back then, Harris had only been legendary-grade!
"So much for being descended from the greatest race beneath the stars..."
Daniel shook his head.
"Harris is certainly an opponent who cannot be ignored."
He continued scrolling through the roster.
"Besides the five premier starfields, there are five other starfields that are only slightly inferior, each of which has a single Nine-Star powerhouse standing guard."
These five starfields were the Lumina Starfield, the Aeterno Starfield, the Maritima Starfield, the Alba Starfield, and the Viridis Starfield.
"The Endless Starfield is boundless and vast. Far too many beings here seem to have been born with the makings of protagonists."
Daniel smiled faintly.
"What an exciting universe!"
Having to face so many Nine-Star powerhouses made even him feel a hint of pressure.
Just then, a soft halo of light suddenly spread across the surface of the table.
The radiance grew brighter and brighter, resembling moonlight spilling across the surface of a still lake.
"What’s going on?"
Daniel looked down in confusion.
Rows of words gradually appeared upon the tabletop, recording the competition format for the upcoming tournament.
"Oh? The rules for the Starlight Rankings have been finalized."
He began reading carefully.
[Starlight Rankings Tournament Format]
Rewards:
First Place: Divine-grade Skill Book, Secret Treasure.
Second Place: Divine-grade Secret Treasure.
Third Place: Divine-grade Skill Book.
Before the actual tournament format had even appeared, the rewards had already been displayed first.
"A Divine-grade Skill Book!"
Daniel’s eyes instantly grew heated.
Even if a supreme-grade skill underwent Millionfold Boost and reached the Divine-grade, there were certain intrinsic properties of a true Divine-grade skill that it simply would not possess.

It was just like taking a piece of ordinary blank equipment and enhancing it through Millionfold Boost until it became legendary-grade, compared to taking a piece of epic-grade equipment and enhancing it into legendary-grade. Although both items would ultimately be classified as legendary-grade, their characteristics and effects would be worlds apart!
A genuine Divine-grade Skill Book, however, possessed every defining trait of a true Divine-grade skill in its entirety!
Once a secret art created by a demi-sage successfully broke through into the Divine-grade, its creator would be able to step directly into the peak of the Divine-grade.
Even a monster like Mosi, a bitter cultivator who had devoted himself entirely to his path, had only managed to create supreme-grade secret arts of his own.
From this alone, the value of a Divine-grade Skill Book was obvious.
Both the first-place and third-place finishers would obtain a Divine-grade Skill Book!
"A Divine-grade Secret Treasure..."

Although Daniel did not yet know what exactly such a thing was, the fact that it was listed as the reward for second place, even above a Divine-grade Skill Book, meant that it had to be even more precious!
The words Divine-grade alone were already the best explanation.
As long as he took first place, both the Divine-grade Skill Book and the Divine-grade Secret Treasure would become his!
"Champion..."
The fighting spirit in Daniel’s heart burned hotter and hotter.
There was an unquestionable resolve in his voice as he spoke.
"I must take first place."
The rewards had clearly been placed at the very beginning of the announcement in order to ignite the competitive spirit of every contestant.
And evidently, the tournament organizers had struck precisely at the deepest desires of every participant!
The actual rules of the tournament were listed below.
Daniel continued reading.
First Round: [Warm-Up Match].

The top five powerhouses on the battle roster of every starfield would participate in this round and be randomly assigned opponents. Those who lost would fall into the elimination round, while the victors would directly obtain qualification for the advancement round, without needing to pass through the elimination round.
Second Round: [Elimination Round].
All participants who had not yet qualified for advancement would enter this round. Those who lost would be eliminated, while those who won would obtain qualification for the advancement round.
Third Round: [Advancement Round]...
"Oh? There’s actually a warm-up phase?"
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
The participants in this warm-up round were none other than the top five powerhouses listed on the battle roster of each starfield, with the matchups determined through random draws.
"It all comes down to luck."
He summarized it bluntly.
"Whoever you draw is whoever you face. In other words, I might be selected to go up as well."
"The warm-up matches begin tomorrow."
He glanced at the scheduled date.
"But what exactly determines who gets chosen as the top five?"
Aurora Starfield Encampment
Harris’s gaze was fixed firmly upon a particular name on the battle roster, as though he wanted to burn it into his eyes forever.
"Faustus... Back at Heavenscar, I already had a vague premonition."
He murmured under his breath, a trace of unwillingness hidden in his voice.
"That you and I would eventually meet again. I simply never imagined that day would come so soon."
Back then, at Heavenscar, Harris had already been a legendary-grade powerhouse, while Faustus had not even touched the threshold of the legendary-grade.
And yet, the supreme glory belonging to the greatest prodigy of the current age—the glory of reaching the summit of Cloudcrest Peak—had been forcibly seized by Faustus!
Every prodigy’s gaze had followed the dazzling light surrounding the one who had claimed first place.
No one knew that on that very day, another prodigy who had once carried boundless expectations, a genius hailed as the "uncrowned king," had also been standing there.
That person was him!
Yet even he had been forced to remain helplessly halfway up the mountain, watching with his own eyes as Faustus stood proudly at the summit above the clouds!
"Then let me see how much you have improved during this time."
A fierce desire for battle rose at the corner of Harris’s mouth as he spoke coldly.
"If you fall to my hands, then you will no longer be worthy of possessing the glory of the prodigy who reached the summit. I will prove that I am still the strongest one!"
Viridis Starfield Encampment
A neat row of participating powerhouses stood before an Oracle-grade being, each one holding their breath and concentrating intently.
"Silas."
The Oracle-grade’s gaze swept past the gathered contestants and fell upon a somewhat pale-faced young man standing in the middle of the group.
"Mentor."
Silas bowed slightly, his posture respectful.
"There is one human powerhouse in particular whom you must pay close attention to. His name is Faustus."
The Oracle-grade’s tone grew serious as he emphasized each word.

"Our starfield has always maintained close relations with the Canaan Starfield. I have carefully examined the intelligence regarding every one of their contestants. Faustus is very likely to be the strongest enemy you will encounter in this tournament!"
A confused expression appeared on Silas’s face.
"Mentor, neither James nor Mosi is an ordinary opponent. Why are you specifically warning me about Faustus alone?"
"Because the speed of this man’s growth is so astonishing that it defies all reason."
The Oracle-grade’s gaze softened slightly before he suddenly asked, "How many years has it been since you first began advancing along your path?"
"Mentor, this student has been exploring this path for more than fifty thousand years."
Silas answered truthfully, a nearly imperceptible trace of pride in his voice.
Among certain powerful races, fifty thousand years could not even be considered young adulthood!
"This human named Faustus..."
The Oracle-grade spoke slowly.
"Less than three years have passed since the day he first stepped into the extraordinary realm."
Boom—!
The Oracle-grade’s words crashed into the minds of the many powerhouses like a meteor plunging into the depths of the sea, instantly stirring up towering waves.
"He became a Nine-Star powerhouse of an entire starfield in less than three years? You have to be joking!"
"An existence like that actually exists in this universe?! How is anyone else supposed to live?"
"Compared to Faustus, I feel as though I’ve spent my entire life living like a dog..."

chapters.title: Chapter 274 -274-The Strongest of the Three—Faustus!
paragraphs: Silas’s face was also filled with shock.
It took him a long while to recover from his daze. Only then did he suck in a sharp breath of cold air.
"Faustus’s talent is truly terrifying."
"Mentor, this student will remember your warning."
Silas’s expression turned solemn, and a deep sense of vigilance gleamed in his eyes.
"Good."
The Oracle-grade nodded in satisfaction, a faint smile appearing at the corner of his lips.
"There is no need for you to worry excessively. You are both Nine-Star powerhouses. You may not necessarily be inferior to him. I am merely telling you that caution comes first!"
"Your foundation is far deeper than his. As long as you do not underestimate your opponent, you should be able to defeat him."
"This student understands. Even a lion uses its full strength when hunting a rabbit!"
Silas replied respectfully.
A new day dawned, and the first rays of morning light had just spread across the peaks of the surrounding mountains.
The Canaan Starfield’s Oracle-grade, Chanelle, appeared in the void.
His voice clearly reached the ears of every single participating contestant.
"All of you, follow me to the arena."
There were two major highlights today.
The first was the Warm-Up Match—the victor would directly obtain qualification for the Advancement Round, securing their place ahead of schedule.
The second was the Elimination Round—the defeated would be eliminated, while the victors would continue onward.
The Warm-Up Match would be held first, followed by the Elimination Round.
"The tournament is finally about to begin."
Along the way, Daniel met up with James and Mosi.
"Boss Faustus, there are far too many hidden powerhouses in this year’s tournament."
For once, James had put away his usual carefree, mischievous expression. His face now carried a rare trace of solemnity.
"Many years ago, I fought Silas of the Viridis Starfield. That battle ended without either of us emerging victorious."
"Silas?"
Daniel had some impression of that name.
He was the Viridis Starfield’s only Nine-Star powerhouse.
James proceeded to explain Silas’s fighting style and unique traits in detail, holding nothing back.
"He is indeed a formidable opponent. We will have to be especially careful if we encounter him."
Daniel nodded.
"Strong."
Mosi uttered a single word, which counted as his agreement.
The venue for the Warm-Up Match was located at the very center of the secret realm world.
There stood an enormous magic array, its intricate patterns interwoven together as streams of faint light flowed continuously through them.

Inside the magic array was the battle arena itself. From the outside, it appeared no larger than an ordinary arena, but with the enhancement of the magic array, the space within had been stretched into an infinitely vast battlefield!
At the same time, the magic array reinforced layer upon layer of surrounding space. Even an Oracle-grade being would find it difficult to tear it apart with ease.
Surrounding the magic array were countless tiers of spectator stands.

They extended from the ground into midair, then rose even higher into the sky in orderly layers, ensuring that every participating contestant could clearly witness every battle taking place in the arena.
The spectator seats reserved for the five premier starfields were all situated on the ground level.
They were also the most important factions to make their entrance last.
Oracle-grade Chanelle led the thirty contestants behind him as they slowly flew into the Warm-Up Match venue.
At this moment, the contestants from the remaining hundreds of starfields had already arrived in full. The spectator stands were densely packed with figures as far as the eye could see.

As the only starfield among the more than three hundred participating starfields to possess three Nine-Star contestants, the Canaan Starfield immediately became the focus of everyone’s attention the moment it appeared.
Countless gazes surged toward them like a tide, filled with curiosity, scrutiny, wariness...
"Look, that’s James! I heard he once fought his way through an entire galaxy alone and never met an opponent who could defeat him."
The powerhouses from the other starfields looked toward James and whispered among themselves.
"A Nine-Star powerhouse is definitely no ordinary existence."
"That one is Mosi, the strongest demi-sage in the Frostfall Galaxy. He created his own supreme-grade secret art, and beneath the Divine-grade, he is practically without equal."
A powerhouse who recognized Mosi introduced him to the companions beside him.
"Mosi is also a Nine-Star powerhouse."
"Who is that person walking between James and Mosi? Anyone capable of standing between those two definitely cannot be some nameless figure, right?"
"Judging by his appearance, he should be a human. Someone capable of standing above both James and Mosi... that has to be Faustus."
"Faustus? You mean the Starchosen who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak?"
"That’s right. Speaking of which... he seems to be from a generation even younger than ours!"
"Indeed. Who could have imagined that the powerhouses of the next generation would grow so quickly? Our generation never produced a prodigy capable of reaching the summit."
"Has anyone else noticed? The strength of the Canaan Starfield this time is almost absurdly overwhelming."
One powerhouse frowned deeply, a worried expression on his face.
"They have three Nine-Star powerhouses in total. That is more than any other starfield."
"Don’t panic. Perhaps one or two of them will fall during the Elimination Round."
"There is still the Advancement Round afterward. They may very well suffer losses there."
"The more people who advance, the greater the risk of being deliberately targeted. That has been an unchanging principle since ancient times."
"Faustus..."
From afar, Harris looked toward Daniel, his gaze calm and still as water.
After an entire night of reflection, he had already buried the raging battle intent in his heart, concealing every trace of its edge.
"So that is Faustus... Judging by the looks of things, the three great prodigies seem to regard him as their leader!"
Silas studied the distant figure with considerable interest, murmuring inwardly.
"Even James willingly acknowledges his superiority?"
"Then I truly would like the chance to face you in a fair and open battle!"
"So he is Faustus!"
Countless gazes fell upon Daniel in unison, like innumerable invisible blades.
Daniel raised his eyebrows slightly.
He could clearly sense that more and more eyes were landing upon him, each gaze growing heavier than the last.
Some carried undisguised provocation. Some were filled with hidden curiosity. Others contained reverence, as though their owners were looking up at a brilliant star suspended high above the heavens!
Chanelle led the younger generation of the Canaan Starfield to their designated spectator seats, then raised a hand in instruction.
"Take your seats."
Daniel sat down and discovered that a faint layer of radiance had also appeared on the surface of the table before him.
The transparent tabletop was like crystal, clearly reflecting a real-time image of everything taking place inside the magic array.
"A personal viewing screen."
Daniel immediately understood.
Before long, an Oracle-grade being from the Budelica Starfield appeared upon the elevated platform.
This year’s Starlight Rankings Tournament was being held in the Budelica Starfield. Naturally, the authority to host and oversee the competition lay in their hands.
After offering a brief opening speech, the Budelica Oracle-grade announced the detailed rules of the Warm-Up Match.
"Each starfield may choose one representative from among the top five powerhouses on its battle roster to step forward and blindly draw a contestant from another starfield."
"The seat number assigned to each contestant will serve as the basis for the blind draw. Whoever is selected must enter the battle."

"Wagers may be placed on every round of competition. Any powerhouse wishing to place a wager need only deposit their treasure into the storage magic array located at the upper-left corner of their table... Once each match concludes, the rewards from the wagers will be distributed immediately."
The instant Daniel heard this, his eyes lit up sharply.
"You can place wagers as well?"
"And the rewards are issued immediately..."
He blinked, his thoughts racing rapidly.
"My Millionfold Boost is already trembling with impatience!"
His heart was filled with anticipation.
The voice of the Budelica Oracle-grade continued echoing throughout the venue.
"Now then, may the Canaan Starfield send a powerhouse forward to carry out the first blind draw."
"Excellent. We’re the very first."
A smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
"Now, what should I wager...?"

Others contained reverence, as though their owners were looking up at a brilliant star suspended high above the heavens!
Chanelle led the younger generation of the Canaan Starfield to their designated spectator seats, then raised a hand in instruction.
"Take your seats."
Daniel sat down and discovered that a faint layer of radiance had also appeared on the surface of the table before him.
The transparent tabletop was like crystal, clearly reflecting a real-time image of everything taking place inside the magic array.
"A personal viewing screen."
Daniel immediately understood.
Before long, an Oracle-grade being from the Budelica Starfield appeared upon the elevated platform.
This year’s Starlight Rankings Tournament was being held in the Budelica Starfield.
Naturally, the authority to host and oversee the competition lay in their hands.
After offering a brief opening speech, the Budelica Oracle-grade announced the detailed rules of the Warm-Up Match.
"Each starfield may choose one representative from among the top five powerhouses on its battle roster to step forward and blindly draw a contestant from another starfield."
"The seat number assigned to each contestant will serve as the basis for the blind draw.
Whoever is selected must enter the battle."
"Wagers may be placed on every round of competition.
Any powerhouse wishing to place a wager need only deposit their treasure into the storage magic array located at the upper-left corner of their table...
Once each match concludes, the rewards from the wagers will be distributed immediately."
The instant Daniel heard this, his eyes lit up sharply.
"You can place wagers as well?"
"And the rewards are issued immediately..."
He blinked, his thoughts racing rapidly.
"My Millionfold Boost is already trembling with impatience!"
His heart was filled with anticipation.
The voice of the Budelica Oracle-grade continued echoing throughout the venue.
"Now then, may the Canaan Starfield send a powerhouse forward to carry out the first blind draw."
"Excellent.
We’re the very first."
A smile appeared at the corner of Daniel’s mouth.
"Now, what should I wager...?"

chapters.title: Chapter 275 -275-The Terrifying Julian—An Instant Kill!
paragraphs: "Now then, may the Canaan Starfield send a powerhouse forward to conduct the blind draw."
The moment the Oracle-grade from the Budelica Starfield finished speaking, countless gazes immediately fell upon the Canaan Starfield’s seats.
"Don’t draw me. Don’t draw me..."
The powerhouses from the other starfields silently prayed in their hearts. Some clasped their hands together, some bit their lips, and some even closed their eyes.
"Draw me! That way, I won’t need to fight in the Elimination Round. I can advance directly."
There were also powerhouses who thought this way, their eyes flashing with scorching light as they eagerly hoped to be the first one selected.
"It would be best if they draw a Nine-Star powerhouse. That would make wagering much easier."
Those who had their sights set on the betting opportunity were already calculating the odds in their minds.
At the Canaan Starfield’s seats, Chanelle gave a slight nod to one of the powerhouses beside him.
The expression of that powerhouse stiffened. Left with no choice, he rose to his feet and flew over to the Oracle-grade from the Budelica Starfield.
Daniel recognized him.
As fellow contestants representing the Canaan Starfield, they had naturally taken note of one another’s information to some extent.
Hosek.
Combat Power Rating: Eight Stars.
He was an elite personally cultivated by the Gold-Grade Sacred Mountain.
Daniel pondered inwardly.
Eight Stars. He isn’t weak at all!
As long as his luck was not atrocious enough for him to run into one of the Nine-Star powerhouses from another starfield, his chances of victory were still quite high.
"What a pity."
James suddenly sighed.
Daniel and Mosi both turned to look at him.
"If only I knew Grand Prophecy, or if I had mastered the Law of Fate..."
A dreamy expression appeared on James’s face as he sighed wistfully.
"Then I would be able to foresee the outcome of every match in advance. Betting would be nothing more than a casual wave of my hand."
"Foolish fantasy."
Mosi spoke coldly.
Daniel secretly laughed in his heart.
With Millionfold Boost in his possession, he could simply place wagers on both sides. No matter who won or lost, he would ultimately receive rewards amplified a millionfold.
That was far more practical than any Law of Fate.
After Hosek finished drawing a number, he froze in place as though he had just been struck by lightning.
At the same time, a burst of laughter erupted throughout the arena.
Hosek’s face turned as black as the bottom of a pot.
"My Fortune Points are absolutely rotten today."
He wished he could chop off his own hand.
"Of all people, I had to draw a Nine-Star powerhouse—Julian..."
"It’s over."
His limbs turned ice-cold.
The Samuel Starfield possessed two great Nine-Star powerhouses: Flora Winter and Julian.
Hosek’s luck was truly remarkable. On the very first blind draw, he had managed to run headfirst into a Nine-Star powerhouse.
"Julian’s throwing knives never miss."
Some powerhouses began whispering among themselves.
"It is said that every enemy who has witnessed him make a move is already dead."
"Julian is definitely among the most terrifying of all Nine-Star powerhouses."
"Hahahaha... Look at that guy from the Canaan Starfield. He looks like he’s about to cry."
"Sigh. Such is the fate of the weak!"
The powerhouses who had been waiting for an opportunity to place wagers became even more excited.
"Hahaha! That unlucky bastard from the Canaan Starfield actually drew a Nine-Star powerhouse!"
"Bet on Julian. This is guaranteed profit!"
"Tsk, tsk. There is practically no suspense in this match."
"Unfortunately, the odds are too low. There isn’t much profit to be made."
Daniel was also hesitating.
Placing wagers on both sides would certainly bring him tremendous profit, but Hosek’s luck was simply too terrible.
Facing a Nine-Star powerhouse in the very first match meant that his chances of winning were nearly zero.
Daniel did not believe Hosek had any possibility of turning the tables either.
A Nine-Star powerhouse was an existence on the same level as James and Mosi.
When one considered the gap between Hosek and the likes of James and Mosi, it was far greater than a mere star or two.
"I’ll just bet on Julian, then."
Daniel reached into his personal space and withdrew all the Source Crystals he had on him.
Source Crystals were the hard currency of the Endless Starsea, standing at the absolute summit of its monetary system.
[Ding! You have wagered one unit of Source Crystals.]
All of Daniel’s equipment, skill books, Light Crystals, Star Crystals, and other miscellaneous possessions combined were worth no more than a single unit of Source Crystals.
"I’m placing the bet."
He did not hesitate at all.
If he won this wager, taking the odds into account and then applying Millionfold Boost on top of that...
Tsk, tsk, tsk...
Samuel Starfield
With a flash, Julian appeared inside the magic array, standing face-to-face with Hosek.
Daniel carefully studied Julian.
Only a few brief lines regarding him had been recorded on the battle roster.
Of the Samuel Starfield’s two Nine-Star powerhouses, Flora was female, while Julian was male.
Julian had shoulder-length hair and sharply defined facial features, as though his face had been carved with a blade and chisel.
However, his face was covered in unkempt stubble, while his eyes were dull and lifeless, as though his soul had wandered far beyond his body.
There was an indescribably gloomy air surrounding him.
"Canaan Starfield, Hosek!"
Hosek drew in a deep breath.
Boom!
His aura erupted violently. At the same time, he activated his defensive skills, wrapping himself tightly in layers of protection.
Facing a Nine-Star powerhouse, he did not dare show the slightest negligence.
All he asked was to devote his full strength to defense, steadily make it through the battle, and then allow the match to come to an end.
"Samuel..."
Julian spoke very slowly.
"Julian..."
Whoosh—!
The gray, lifeless eyes of Julian suddenly erupted with astonishing brilliance, like a spring of living water surging forth from a stagnant, dead pool.
Whoosh—!
A streak of light flashed.
It seemed to descend from the heavens, yet at the same time, it seemed to erupt from the earth itself.
Pfft!
The light flickered.
Julian had made his move.
A tiny red dot, no larger than the tip of a needle, suddenly appeared on Hosek’s throat!
The red dot rapidly spread at a speed visible to the naked eye, stretching into a thin red line.
Gradually, the red line split open.
Blood seeped out from the fissure, flowing down Hosek’s neck.
Julian did not even spare Hosek a glance.
In the blink of an eye, his body vanished from inside the magic array.
The seemingly absent-minded and dazed Julian had casually claimed a life as though it meant nothing at all.
Boom—!
In the next moment, Hosek’s body collapsed heavily onto the ground.
The vitality in his eyes vanished like a candle extinguished by a gust of wind, disappearing in an instant.
Hosek was dead.
"Samuel Starfield, Julian wins."
The Oracle-grade presiding over the match loudly announced the victor.
Yet even at this moment, not a single contestant had managed to clearly see how Julian had attacked.
The might of his throwing knife was actually this terrifying!
Hosek’s defensive equipment and defensive skills, despite belonging to an Eight-Star powerhouse, had been cut through as easily as a sharp blade passing through a thin sheet of paper.
No.
It had been even more effortless than that!
The speed of his attack was beyond anything words could describe. It had been so fast that their gazes had not even had time to shift, so fast that even their thoughts could not catch up!
A bone-chilling coldness swept across the backs of every contestant like an invisible tide.
"If we were the ones facing him... we would not be able to dodge that knife either."
Someone spoke in a trembling voice, a trace of despair hidden within it.
"Julian... is far too unfathomable."
The powerhouses from the other starfields stared in shock, their pupils reflecting the pool of blood inside the magic array that had yet to dry.
"Hosek was an Eight-Star powerhouse! An Eight-Star powerhouse! Yet he was killed without the slightest ability to fight back!"
The gathered contestants stared blankly at the place where Hosek had fallen.
"As expected of one of the most terrifying existences among them. Julian is truly horrifying!"
Someone murmured, his voice filled with reverence.
The various starfields had battled one another for countless ages. No one knew how many powerhouses had died beneath one another’s blades.
Everyone present had already prepared themselves for the possibility of dying in battle.
Thus, no one found Hosek’s death unexpected.
The Endless Starsea did not believe in tears.
It believed only in blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 276 -276-Two Nine-Star Powerhouses, A Clash of Titans
paragraphs: The seating area of the Canaan starfield had fallen completely silent.
Even the few powerhouses who had been on relatively good terms with Hosek merely let out soft sighs.
Not even Chanelle, an Oracle-grade expert, seemed particularly concerned about Hosek’s death. Her face remained as calm and indifferent as ever, without the slightest ripple of emotion.
Daniel’s gaze remained fixed on the spot where Hosek had fallen.
In that split second just now, he had clearly sensed the fluctuations of multiple laws surging from Julian’s body.
With a single slash, he had simultaneously unleashed several different laws!
"If I sensed it correctly, there were at least two or three different law powers involved."
Daniel pondered silently, "One of them felt extremely familiar—it was the Law of Fate!"
"I wonder what level his mastery of the Law of Fate has reached."
The aura of another law had been exceptionally clear. It contained a destructive presence so terrifying that it made one’s heart tremble.

"As for the final one, it was extremely faint and only appeared for an instant. It seemed to be related to space... but that wasn’t a law Julian himself had comprehended. It felt more like... a law attached to his weapon?"
A flash of insight suddenly crossed Daniel’s mind.
Could it be... a Divine-grade secret treasure?
"What is a Divine-grade secret treasure?" Daniel turned his head and asked James.

"A Divine-grade secret treasure is an ultimate treasure. Even ordinary Divine-grade powerhouses aren’t qualified to lay their hands on one. Treasures of that level contain the power of laws within them," James explained.
Daniel immediately understood.
"Then there’s no mistake. Julian’s weapon really is a Divine-grade secret treasure. It comes with its own spatial law power."
"Julian and Flora are evenly matched," James suddenly said. "In the Samuel starfield, Flora has always been ranked one place above Julian. She has held the number one position the entire time."
"They’re both terrifyingly strong." Mosi’s expression grew solemn.
Daniel nodded.
Julian was already ridiculously powerful. If Flora could still suppress him by a rank, then she was naturally someone who could not be underestimated.
Just then—
[Ding! Your wager has been settled. You have obtained 1.1 cubic units of Origin Crystal!]
[Ding! You have sold [Origin Crystal] ×1.1 cubic units to the Doom Guild for 1 copper coin. Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[The item sold is a currency-type item. Please select quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Ding! Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained [Origin Crystal] ×1,100,000 cubic units!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up the moment he heard the system notifications.
"More than a million cubic units of Origin Crystal!"
The warm-up matches continued in full swing.
This time, it was the Samuel starfield’s turn to blindly draw an opponent.
"For the second warm-up match, please have the Samuel starfield send out a contender to randomly select an opponent," Oracle-grade Budelica announced.
"The Samuel starfield will send out Flora Winter."
The clear voice of the Samuel starfield’s Oracle-grade expert rang throughout the arena.
"Student Flora accepts the match!"
A crisp, melodious voice followed.
Boom—!
It was like a thunderclap from a clear sky.
Many of the contestants present were instantly stunned.
The Samuel starfield had actually sent out Flora this time!
The woman who had always stood one place above Julian!
At this moment, the gazes of every powerhouse in the arena converged upon that graceful figure.
Flora flew out from the Samuel starfield’s seating area and landed upon the supreme-grade platform, her movements light and elegant, like a butterfly in flight.

This participant with a nine-star combat rating possessed the face of a young maiden. Her cascading silver hair flowed like a waterfall, while her aura was as cold and secluded as an orchid blooming in the depths of winter.
"Flora... nine-star... Holy shit!"
"Whoever she draws is going to be unbelievably unlucky... Please, don’t let it be me."
"I just want to know one thing. Are we allowed to surrender immediately?"
Nearly ninety percent of the contestants wore miserable expressions, looking as though someone had dumped an entire bucket of icy water over their heads.
"Flora is one of the absolute strongest people in this arena. Fight her? How is that any different from courting death?"
"The Samuel starfield is playing dirty. They actually sent out their number one contender right away."
"It would be best if she draws someone from the Canaan starfield. Let their powerhouses fight among themselves and both suffer heavy losses."
"Exactly! The Canaan starfield has three nine-star contenders. Let them wear each other down first."
Flora began the selection process.
Just who would be the fortunate victim drawn by her?
"The responding contender shall be... Nox of the Aurora starfield."
Oracle-grade Budelica’s voice resounded throughout the entire arena.
Swish! Swish!
The gazes of all ten thousand contestants instantly turned toward the Aurora starfield’s seating area.
Every one of those gazes was filled with shock and disbelief!
Nox was also a nine-star-rated powerhouse!
A nine-star powerhouse of the Aurora starfield whose fame rivaled even that of Harris!

"Nox is known as the ’Harbinger of Calamity.’ I heard that he once challenged the powerhouses of an entire starfield by himself and never suffered a single defeat. His Law of Thunder is unparalleled, and people even call him the ’Son of Thunder.’"
"Hiss—his law power has already reached such a terrifying level?"
"Incredible... Flora’s luck with this draw is simply unbelievable."
All the contestants who knew anything about Nox could not help sucking in a sharp breath.
Nox was terrifyingly powerful, and Flora was equally monstrous. Both of them possessed nine-star ratings.
And now, these two nine-star powerhouses were about to fight to the death during a mere warm-up match.
This was supposed to be nothing more than a preliminary warm-up round, yet the current situation was already a showdown between ultimate trump cards right from the opening!
The sheer tension and excitement were in no way inferior to that of the finals.
Most of the powerhouses had originally been nervous, afraid that they themselves might be selected.
But now, the two participants in the match were both standing at the absolute pinnacle of combat strength.
A battle at the summit was about to erupt!
In the Aurora starfield’s seating area, the Oracle-grade expert’s expression darkened the moment the opponent was announced.
Had Nox not been selected, he would absolutely have had an excellent chance of making it into the advancement rounds. With a little luck, he might even have competed for a very high ranking.
Yet of all people, Flora had drawn him directly.
"Nox, go and accept the challenge," the Oracle-grade expert instructed helplessly. "Be extremely careful."
"Understood, Your Excellency."
Within the Aurora starfield’s spectator area, a powerhouse rose to his feet, instantly attracting every gaze in the arena.
A flash of lightning burst forth.
His figure transformed into a streak of lightning and, in the blink of an eye, appeared upon the magic formation platform, standing directly opposite Flora.
"The betting period is now open," Oracle-grade Budelica announced. "You have one minute."
The moment those words fell, all the powerhouses were dumbfounded.
"How are we supposed to bet on this? Can anyone tell me who I should bet on if I don’t want to lose?"
"I’m completely lost. Betting on either of them feels unreliable. There’s no way to compare them at all."
"I’m not betting. Forget it. I’ll just enjoy watching the fight."
"Coward! Sometimes you’ve got to take a gamble. Who knows? You might strike it rich!"
"Nine-star against nine-star—I hereby declare that the finals have begun ahead of schedule!"
"This development is simply unimaginable. We’ve been hit with the ultimate showdown right at the start!"
"The Law of Thunder... Nox."
This was Daniel’s first time encountering a powerhouse who had comprehended an elemental law.
The sudden clash between two nine-star powerhouses had also taken him quite by surprise.
A battle between two true elites was exactly the kind of fight worth watching.
"As for betting, it doesn’t really matter..."
Daniel divided all of his assets evenly into two portions and placed half of them on each contender.
"Five hundred and fifty thousand cubic units on Flora, and the same amount on Nox."
The corners of his lips curved into a faint smile.
No matter who won or lost, he would still receive a final reward and trigger his Millionfold Boost afterward.
"Boss Faustus, aren’t you betting a little too much?" James noticed Daniel’s wagers and stared in disbelief.
You could actually play it that way?
He scratched his head anxiously, genuinely unable to decide which side to bet on.
"Mosi really is the safest one here."
James glanced at Mosi again.
Mosi had not placed a single wager. He had not bet in the previous match, and he had not bet in this one either. He was as steady as a mountain.
Indeed, there was no risk if you did not bet at all.
That was truly the safest possible choice!
"Forget it. I won’t bet either."
James simply gave up on placing a wager.
The one-minute betting period passed in the blink of an eye.
"The match—begins!"
At Oracle-grade Budelica’s command, the gazes of every powerhouse in the arena became firmly locked onto the platform.
"Flora... just how strong is she?"
Daniel stared intently at Flora’s figure, silently contemplating.
"What ability does she possess that allows her to suppress even Julian?"

You have sold [Origin Crystal] ×1.1 cubic units to the Doom Guild for 1 copper coin.
Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[The item sold is a currency-type item.
Please select quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Ding!
Congratulations!
You have obtained 1 gold coin!
You have obtained [Origin Crystal] ×1,100,000 cubic units!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up the moment he heard the system notifications.
"More than a million cubic units of Origin Crystal!"
The warm-up matches continued in full swing.
This time, it was the Samuel starfield’s turn to blindly draw an opponent.
"For the second warm-up match, please have the Samuel starfield send out a contender to randomly select an opponent," Oracle-grade Budelica announced.
"The Samuel starfield will send out Flora Winter."
The clear voice of the Samuel starfield’s Oracle-grade expert rang throughout the arena.
"Student Flora accepts the match!"
A crisp, melodious voice followed.
Boom—!
It was like a thunderclap from a clear sky.
Many of the contestants present were instantly stunned.
The Samuel starfield had actually sent out Flora this time!
The woman who had always stood one place above Julian!
At this moment, the gazes of every powerhouse in the arena converged upon that graceful figure.
Flora flew out from the Samuel starfield’s seating area and landed upon the supreme-grade platform, her movements light and elegant, like a butterfly in flight.
This participant with a nine-star combat rating possessed the face of a young maiden.
Her cascading silver hair flowed like a waterfall, while her aura was as cold and secluded as an orchid blooming in the depths of winter.
"Flora... nine-star...
Holy shit!"
"Whoever she draws is going to be unbelievably unlucky...
Please, don’t let it be me."
"I just want to know one thing.
Are we allowed to surrender immediately?"
Nearly ninety percent of the contestants wore miserable expressions, looking as though someone had dumped an entire bucket of icy water over their heads.
"Flora is one of the absolute strongest people in this arena.
Fight her?
How is that any different from courting death?"
"The Samuel starfield is playing dirty.
They actually sent out their number one contender right away."
"It would be best if she draws someone from the Canaan starfield.
Let their powerhouses fight among themselves and both suffer heavy losses."
"Exactly!
The Canaan starfield has three nine-star contenders.
Let them wear each other down first."
Flora began the selection process.
Just who would be the fortunate victim drawn by her?
"The responding contender shall be...
Nox of the Aurora starfield."
Oracle-grade Budelica’s voice resounded throughout the entire arena.
Swish!
Swish!
The gazes of all ten thousand contestants instantly turned toward the Aurora starfield’s seating area.
Every one of those gazes was filled with shock and disbelief!
Nox was also a nine-star-rated powerhouse!
A nine-star powerhouse of the Aurora starfield whose fame rivaled even that of Harris!
"Nox is known as the ’Harbinger of Calamity.’ I heard that he once challenged the powerhouses of an entire starfield by himself and never suffered a single defeat.
His Law of Thunder is unparalleled, and people even call him the ’Son of Thunder.’"
"Hiss—his law power has already reached such a terrifying level?"
"Incredible...
Flora’s luck with this draw is simply unbelievable."
All the contestants who knew anything about Nox could not help sucking in a sharp breath.
Nox was terrifyingly powerful, and Flora was equally monstrous.
Both of them possessed nine-star ratings.
And now, these two nine-star powerhouses were about to fight to the death during a mere warm-up match.
This was supposed to be nothing more than a preliminary warm-up round, yet the current situation was already a showdown between ultimate trump cards right from the opening!
The sheer tension and excitement were in no way inferior to that of the finals.
Most of the powerhouses had originally been nervous, afraid that they themselves might be selected.
But now, the two participants in the match were both standing at the absolute pinnacle of combat strength.
A battle at the summit was about to erupt!
In the Aurora starfield’s seating area, the Oracle-grade expert’s expression darkened the moment the opponent was announced.
Had Nox not been selected, he would absolutely have had an excellent chance of making it into the advancement rounds.
With a little luck, he might even have competed for a very high ranking.
Yet of all people, Flora had drawn him directly.
"Nox, go and accept the challenge," the Oracle-grade expert instructed helplessly.
"Be extremely careful."
"Understood, Your Excellency."
Within the Aurora starfield’s spectator area, a powerhouse rose to his feet, instantly attracting every gaze in the arena.
A flash of lightning burst forth.
His figure transformed into a streak of lightning and, in the blink of an eye, appeared upon the magic formation platform, standing directly opposite Flora.
"The betting period is now open," Oracle-grade Budelica announced.
"You have one minute."
The moment those words fell, all the powerhouses were dumbfounded.
"How are we supposed to bet on this?
Can anyone tell me who I should bet on if I don’t want to lose?"
"I’m completely lost.
Betting on either of them feels unreliable.
There’s no way to compare them at all."
"I’m not betting.
Forget it.
I’ll just enjoy watching the fight."
"Coward!
Sometimes you’ve got to take a gamble.
Who knows?
You might strike it rich!"
"Nine-star against nine-star—I hereby declare that the finals have begun ahead of schedule!"
"This development is simply unimaginable.
We’ve been hit with the ultimate showdown right at the start!"
"The Law of Thunder...
Nox."
This was Daniel’s first time encountering a powerhouse who had comprehended an elemental law.
The sudden clash between two nine-star powerhouses had also taken him quite by surprise.
A battle between two true elites was exactly the kind of fight worth watching.
"As for betting, it doesn’t really matter..."
Daniel divided all of his assets evenly into two portions and placed half of them on each contender.
"Five hundred and fifty thousand cubic units on Flora, and the same amount on Nox."
The corners of his lips curved into a faint smile.
No matter who won or lost, he would still receive a final reward and trigger his Millionfold Boost afterward.
"Boss Faustus, aren’t you betting a little too much?" James noticed Daniel’s wagers and stared in disbelief.
You could actually play it that way?
He scratched his head anxiously, genuinely unable to decide which side to bet on.
"Mosi really is the safest one here."
James glanced at Mosi again.
Mosi had not placed a single wager.
He had not bet in the previous match, and he had not bet in this one either.
He was as steady as a mountain.
Indeed, there was no risk if you did not bet at all.
That was truly the safest possible choice!
"Forget it.
I won’t bet either."
James simply gave up on placing a wager.
The one-minute betting period passed in the blink of an eye.
"The match—begins!"
At Oracle-grade Budelica’s command, the gazes of every powerhouse in the arena became firmly locked onto the platform.
"Flora... just how strong is she?"
Daniel stared intently at Flora’s figure, silently contemplating.
"What ability does she possess that allows her to suppress even Julian?"

chapters.title: Chapter 277 -277-Grand Judgment, Word of Law
paragraphs: Crack—BOOM!
Countless bolts of lightning exploded from Nox’s body, electric arcs flying in every direction.
Nox had studied the Law of Thunder intensively for many years. With a mere thought, he turned the surrounding world into a realm of thunder and lightning.
Boom!
Rumble—!
The heavens erupted with deafening thunder as countless thick bolts of lightning crashed down from the clouds, like divine whips descending from the hand of a god.
"Speed has always been my specialty, and my destructive power is exceptionally strong as well."
Lightning flickered within Nox’s eyes as he calculated silently.
"Since we’re both nine-star powerhouses, there can be no harm in making the first move."
Nox moved.
Like a bolt of lightning, he shot toward Flora at astonishing speed.
The violent wind lifted Flora’s waist-length silver hair.
Suddenly, a burst of light erupted from Flora’s eyes.
"Lightning is forbidden in this place!"
Whoosh—!
The lightning power surrounding Nox instantly vanished.
He was forcibly stripped out of his lightning state, revealing his true body once more.
"Hm... How is that possible?"
Nox froze slightly, standing rooted to the spot in shock.
His lightning domain collapsed in an instant.
Flora’s voice was crisp and melodious like a silver bell, but every word she uttered carried fatal power.
"Flight is forbidden in this place."
Rumble—!
Nox’s body plummeted heavily to the ground, smashing into it with tremendous force.
A sudden feeling of despair surged within his heart.
"You’ve got to be kidding me..."
He cried out inwardly, "No!"
Flora suddenly extended a finger, pointing distantly at Nox with its tip.
"Welcome the arrival of death."
Nox’s body trembled faintly.
The vitality in his eyes faded in an instant, like a candle flame extinguished by the wind.
And just like that, a peerless prodigy of his generation perished.
Flora actually possessed the power of Word of Law!
She took a deep breath before slowly exhaling, a trace of exhaustion finally appearing on her face.
She cast a faint glance at Nox’s corpse, then transformed into a streak of light and returned to the Samuel starfield’s seating area.
"The winner of the second match is Flora Winter of the Samuel starfield!"
Oracle-grade Budelica announced the victor.
"Well done."
The Oracle-grade expert of the Samuel starfield nodded with a smile.
"Congratulations."
For once, a faint glimmer appeared in Julian’s clouded eyes.
Flora nodded and calmly took her seat.
However, the shock she had left upon the spectators had only just begun to erupt.
With a single finger, she had effortlessly killed Nox on the spot.
Despite possessing the same nine-star danger rating as her, he had died so cleanly, so abruptly, and in such an eerie and inexplicable manner.
A tidal wave of shock swept across the entire arena.
"Grand Judgment."
Harris stared warily in Flora’s direction, his entire body trembling faintly.
What a terrifying Law of Judgment!
Flora was undoubtedly the strangest and most unfathomable opponent he had encountered in his entire life.
"The Law of Judgment... Grand Judgment truly is terrifying."
Silas drew in a deep breath, his expression extremely solemn.
As expected of a cosmic-level competition. Powerful contenders from all sides took turns entering the stage, bringing shock after shock with them.

"Julian is already practically impossible to counter, yet Flora is even stronger than him. Then there’s Starchosen Faustus, who has risen to the summit of the current generation, not to mention all the nine-star powerhouses who have yet to make a move..."
Silas clenched his fists tightly and questioned himself inwardly.
"Can I really make it all the way to the end...?"
"That is Grand Judgment."
James sighed, his voice filled with bitterness.
"This world really is far too dangerous. You could lose your life at any moment."
"Judgment Execution."
Mosi coldly uttered two words.
"Judgment Execution is the most lethal secret art within Grand Judgment," James added.
"How is anyone supposed to counter that?"
Daniel frowned.
From what he could currently tell, this secret art was practically impossible to deal with.

However, Daniel possessed Immortal Revival, as well as the Earthmount Dragon’s passive ability that made him immortal while on the ground. Therefore, he was not particularly afraid of this secret art.
"The real problem is that Grand Judgment is impossible to guard against. I’m afraid her other methods will be just as troublesome."
As he thought back on what had just happened, the law power Flora had invoked with a mere declaration was practically equivalent to Word of Law. It was anything but ordinary.
"The only way is to overwhelm all techniques with absolute power."
Daniel’s furrowed brows slowly relaxed.
He already had a rough idea of how to handle it.
The spectator stands were first plunged into deathly silence, only to erupt into thunderous uproar moments later.
Flora was simply invincible!
"How are we supposed to fight against something like that? The moment Flora opens her mouth, she passes judgment over life and death and enacts divine punishment herself!"
"The Law of Judgment... Has this kind of forbidden power comprehended the threads of fate itself, or has it stolen authority from the gods? It’s simply unbelievable."
"At least Nox died peacefully. He didn’t struggle, didn’t scream, and didn’t even have time to close his eyes. Perhaps that was the last bit of dignity he had left in this life."
"I would rather be reduced to ashes by thunder than face that casual, effortless sentence of judgment."
"Exactly! Death itself isn’t terrifying. What’s terrifying is dying without even understanding how it happened!"
"From this day onward, Flora has only one title in my heart—the Unbeatable One! Anyone who has to stand on the same stage as her already has one foot hanging over the edge of a cliff."
Flora’s single finger had not only shattered Nox’s life.
It had also destroyed the last lingering trace of hope in the hearts of the nine thousand powerhouses throughout the arena!
At the same time, the wager settlement began.
[Ding! Your wager has been settled...]
[Ding! You have sold [Origin Crystal] ×550,000 cubic units to the Doom Guild for 1 copper coin. Millionfold Boost triggered!]
[The item sold is a currency-type item. Please select quality boost or quantity boost!]
"Quantity boost!"
[Congratulations! You have obtained 1 gold coin! You have obtained [Origin Crystal] ×550,000,000,000 cubic units!]
As Daniel listened to the notification ringing beside his ear, a broad smile appeared on his face.
He had wagered 550,000 cubic units just now, and with the betting odds included, he had earned 550 billion cubic units!
With the Millionfold Boost System in his possession, as long as the two nine-star powerhouses on the stage did not perish together, he was guaranteed to make an enormous fortune!
"Five hundred billion cubic units..."
Origin Crystal was the most stable and valuable currency throughout this entire star sea.
This amount of wealth was simply unimaginable!
Next came the third warm-up match.
There were five warm-up matches in total, but the remaining three had nothing particularly noteworthy about them.
"Boring."
Daniel shook his head and waited for the knockout stage to begin.
The warm-up matches soon came to an end.
He continued placing bets during the following three matches and once again harvested a massive amount of Origin Crystal.
"With my current wealth, I’m afraid even an ordinary Oracle-grade powerhouse can’t compare to me."
Daniel smiled faintly.
He had other uses for this wealth.

He had heard that the starry skies were filled with all kinds of strange and wondrous items. When the opportunity arose, he would have to purchase some of them and see whether they could help the players level up faster.
He calculated silently, "Those players are still far too weak. There isn’t much profit to squeeze out of them right now. I’ll need to fatten them up first."
The knockout stage was about to begin.
The Oracle-grade expert from the Budelica starfield immediately announced,
"The next phase—the knockout stage!"
Daniel focused his attention.
"My mission objective is to obtain qualification for the advancement round."
His expression grew solemn.
"Only by participating in the knockout stage can I automatically obtain the qualification to advance."
And once he completed his mission, he would receive a reward—
A mysterious Divine-grade treasure!
"Everyone, please check the rules of the knockout stage on the display in front of you," Oracle-grade Budelica said.
Daniel immediately looked toward the screen on his table.
A series of rules entered his sight...
