chapters.title: Chapter 278 -278-The Ten Great Warzones, the Illusion of Death
paragraphs: [Knockout Stage Rules]
Competition Venue: [Realm of the Holy Spirit]
Competition Zones: The battlefield is divided into ten great Warzones. Participants will be randomly assigned to a Warzone.
Competition Duration: 5 hours
Competition Structure: Three stages
Stage One:
Mission Objective: Slay magical beasts and obtain qualification for the second stage.

Mission Details: The organizers will release tens of thousands of Divine-grade magical beasts into the Realm of the Holy Spirit. These magical beasts are inherently ferocious and will indiscriminately slaughter every living creature they encounter. All participants must personally hunt and kill magical beasts, accumulating kills as battle merits.
Within each Warzone, the five hundred participants ranked lowest in number of kills who fail to enter the second stage within five hours shall be eliminated!

Mission Explanation: Any participant who successfully slays ten thousand magical beasts will automatically obtain a ticket to the second stage and may apply to enter the second-stage map ahead of time.

During each stage, all participants have the right to withdraw. Upon withdrawing, they will immediately be removed from the battlefield. However, at the same time, they will permanently lose their qualification to continue participating in the competition.
Note: The detailed rules for the second stage will be announced separately within the corresponding map.
After finishing reading the knockout stage rules, Daniel pondered for a moment before summarizing them into three key points.
"First, the Divine-grade magical beasts consist of different grades mixed together. In other words, there is a very real possibility of encountering Divine-grade high-grade magical beasts."
He took a deep breath.
He could instantly kill low-grade magical beasts. Mid-grade magical beasts would be somewhat troublesome. However, if he ran into high-grade ones, things would become truly difficult.
Divine-grade high-grade creatures were not easy opponents to deal with.
"Second, the five hundred participants with the lowest kill counts will be eliminated."

That particular rule had been designed extremely cleverly. Since no one could possibly know the battle results of the other contestants, every participant might believe that they were currently among the bottom five hundred. As a result, they would push themselves even harder to hunt down magical beasts.
Each Warzone contained roughly nine hundred contestants, yet the bottom five hundred would be eliminated.
Nearly half of them would be forced out!
"There are ninety thousand magical beasts in every Warzone. With so many powerhouses competing for them, conflict will be unavoidable!"
And once conflict broke out, deaths and casualties would naturally follow.
Daniel shook his head.
Aside from the nine-star powerhouses, none of the participants would willingly yield to anyone else. Fighting over prey was inevitable.
"And that leads to the third point."
Daniel recalled a saying that had circulated among humanity throughout his previous lives.
The greatest threat would always come from one’s own kind!
"The other participants are a hundred times more dangerous than the magical beasts."
Only after everyone had finished reading the rules did Oracle-grade Budelica continue speaking.
"The knockout stage—officially begins now!"
"All participants, enter the Realm of the Holy Spirit!"
With that, he waved his sleeve, and a scroll fell into the center of the magic formation.
When the scroll unfurled, there was initially nothing inside it.
In the next instant, countless scenes flashed across its surface.
"The Divine-grade secret treasure, Realm of the Holy Spirit, appears differently in everyone’s eyes," James explained quietly. "Whatever occupies your heart is what you will see before you."
"Mosi, what do you see?"
James suddenly turned and asked him.
"Punishment."
A complicated expression crossed Mosi’s face as he uttered only a single word.
"Punishment? Do you mean the heavenly tribulation that Oracle-grade powerhouses must endure, or divine punishment for one’s sins?"
James shook his head before turning toward Daniel.
"Boss Faustus, what do you see?"
Daniel saw scenes from his previous lives.
He saw himself dying time and time again at the hands of the Dark Gods of those non-human races that had invaded Earth.
He saw countless human powerhouses sacrificing their lives for righteousness.
He saw the humans of Earth being forced into a hopeless corner by the non-human races, with nowhere left to retreat.
James’s voice pulled him back to reality.
Daniel immediately became vigilant.
This Realm of the Holy Spirit truly was anything but simple!
"As expected, Divine-grade secret treasures are unfathomable."
Daniel heightened his guard, gaining an entirely new understanding of Divine-grade secret treasures.
He turned his head and answered James, "I saw my homeland. What about you?"
"I saw all the different ways I could die."
James smiled, but his eyes were as sharp as blades.
"The second stage is probably related to illusions. We must be extremely careful."
Daniel and Mosi both nodded in agreement.
"Go in, all of you."
Chanelle, the T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse of the Canaan starfield, spoke calmly.
"If you believe your life is in danger, you may withdraw at any time."
The moment she said that, many of the contestants from the Canaan starfield secretly breathed sighs of relief.
Even low-grade Divine-grade magical beasts posed a fatal threat to eight-star powerhouses, much less the mid-grade and high-grade magical beasts that would also be roaming the battlefield!
Nearly every Oracle-grade expert from every starfield gave similar warnings to their own contestants.

After all, nine-star powerhouses were exceedingly rare. Although the other contestants were inferior to nine-star contenders, they were still the future hopes of their respective starfields. Among them, a few might very well advance to the Oracle-grade in the future.
The death of any single contestant would be a loss too heavy for their starfield to bear!
Daniel took a deep breath before transforming into a streak of light and flying toward the Realm of the Holy Spirit.
Swish! Swish! Swish!
Rays of light poured down like rain as contestants from the various starfields rushed into the realm one after another.
The knockout stage had officially begun!
The Realm of the Holy Spirit was divided into ten great Warzones, with each region containing approximately nine hundred participants.
Outside the magic formation, the sky was currently projecting everything taking place within the Realm of the Holy Spirit.
The accompanying powerhouses and Oracle-grade experts from every starfield could watch each and every battle through the images displayed across the heavenly screen.
Warzone One.
Swish—!
Daniel’s figure descended into the Realm of the Holy Spirit, hovering steadily in midair.
[Ding! You have been assigned to Warzone One.]
"Warzone One?"
His expression remained calm.
"What difference is there between the ten Warzones?"
Swish! Swish—!
Hundreds of participants appeared one after another, each vigilantly guarding against the others. The atmosphere instantly became tense and hostile.
In particular, no one dared approach the area surrounding Daniel.
Faustus, who possessed a nine-star combat rating, was absolutely not someone they could afford to provoke.
"Faustus, the nine-star powerhouse from the Canaan starfield."
"We’re pretty lucky. Warzone One only has one nine-star contender, and that’s Faustus."
"Indeed. As long as we don’t get in his way, we should be able to avoid trouble."
"Exactly, exactly. We’re merely being rational. This is definitely not fear."
Daniel released his mind power without the slightest restraint, spreading it out like an invisible net that enveloped the surrounding area.
Even if the other powerhouses were displeased by this, none of them dared express it.
"This space is rather large."

Although his mind power could not cover the entirety of the Warzone, it was enough for him to sense the vastness of the map. At the same time, he discovered that he seemed to be the only nine-star powerhouse in this Warzone.
Oh, right. There was also a powerhouse from the Samuel starfield named Yelisy, but he had only been marked as eight-star on the roster.
He was not worth worrying about.
At that moment, a grand and majestic voice reverberated throughout the entire Realm of the Holy Spirit.
"Commence the release of magical beasts!"
The instant the voice faded, countless Divine-grade magical beasts poured down from above like a torrential rainstorm.
"Run!"
"Holy shit! So this is how they’re releasing them?!"
"This is insane! Who could possibly withstand so many magical beasts all at once?"
The quick-reacting participants’ expressions changed drastically as they unleashed their secret arts and desperately fled.
"Ninety thousand magical beasts are coming down on us at the same time! Are you kidding me?!"
One participant flew toward the ground with a bitter expression, intending to use the complicated terrain below to maneuver around them.
"Staying alive comes first!"
"Retreat for now! Find advantageous terrain!"
In the blink of an eye, ninety percent of the participants rushed toward the ground.
Daniel noticed that among all the contestants present, only Yelisy had a blazing fighting spirit in his eyes.
"Magical beasts."
Daniel’s gaze sharpened.
He summoned ninety-nine clones, scattering them throughout the Realm of the Holy Spirit in an attempt to achieve total firepower coverage without leaving any blind spots.
Boom—!
An overwhelmingly powerful aura erupted from his body.
Within the void, the elemental forces of ice and fire instantly gathered together, transforming into a vast ocean where freezing cold and scorching flames intertwined.
And at this very moment, the magical beasts were still falling from the sky!

sentences.text: [Knockout Stage Rules]
Competition Venue: [Realm of the Holy Spirit]
Competition Zones: The battlefield is divided into ten great Warzones.
Participants will be randomly assigned to a Warzone.
Competition Duration: 5 hours
Competition Structure: Three stages
Stage One:
Mission Objective: Slay magical beasts and obtain qualification for the second stage.
Mission Details: The organizers will release tens of thousands of Divine-grade magical beasts into the Realm of the Holy Spirit.
These magical beasts are inherently ferocious and will indiscriminately slaughter every living creature they encounter.
All participants must personally hunt and kill magical beasts, accumulating kills as battle merits.
Within each Warzone, the five hundred participants ranked lowest in number of kills who fail to enter the second stage within five hours shall be eliminated!

Mission Explanation: Any participant who successfully slays ten thousand magical beasts will automatically obtain a ticket to the second stage and may apply to enter the second-stage map ahead of time.
During each stage, all participants have the right to withdraw.
Upon withdrawing, they will immediately be removed from the battlefield.
However, at the same time, they will permanently lose their qualification to continue participating in the competition.
Note: The detailed rules for the second stage will be announced separately within the corresponding map.
After finishing reading the knockout stage rules, Daniel pondered for a moment before summarizing them into three key points.
"First, the Divine-grade magical beasts consist of different grades mixed together.
In other words, there is a very real possibility of encountering Divine-grade high-grade magical beasts."
He took a deep breath.
He could instantly kill low-grade magical beasts.
Mid-grade magical beasts would be somewhat troublesome.
However, if he ran into high-grade ones, things would become truly difficult.
Divine-grade high-grade creatures were not easy opponents to deal with.
"Second, the five hundred participants with the lowest kill counts will be eliminated."
That particular rule had been designed extremely cleverly.
Since no one could possibly know the battle results of the other contestants, every participant might believe that they were currently among the bottom five hundred.
As a result, they would push themselves even harder to hunt down magical beasts.
Each Warzone contained roughly nine hundred contestants, yet the bottom five hundred would be eliminated.
Nearly half of them would be forced out!
"There are ninety thousand magical beasts in every Warzone.
With so many powerhouses competing for them, conflict will be unavoidable!"
And once conflict broke out, deaths and casualties would naturally follow.
Daniel shook his head.
Aside from the nine-star powerhouses, none of the participants would willingly yield to anyone else.
Fighting over prey was inevitable.
"And that leads to the third point."
Daniel recalled a saying that had circulated among humanity throughout his previous lives.
The greatest threat would always come from one’s own kind!
"The other participants are a hundred times more dangerous than the magical beasts."
Only after everyone had finished reading the rules did Oracle-grade Budelica continue speaking.
"The knockout stage—officially begins now!"
"All participants, enter the Realm of the Holy Spirit!"
With that, he waved his sleeve, and a scroll fell into the center of the magic formation.
When the scroll unfurled, there was initially nothing inside it.
In the next instant, countless scenes flashed across its surface.
"The Divine-grade secret treasure, Realm of the Holy Spirit, appears differently in everyone’s eyes," James explained quietly.
"Whatever occupies your heart is what you will see before you."
"Mosi, what do you see?"
James suddenly turned and asked him.
"Punishment."
A complicated expression crossed Mosi’s face as he uttered only a single word.
"Punishment?
Do you mean the heavenly tribulation that Oracle-grade powerhouses must endure, or divine punishment for one’s sins?"
James shook his head before turning toward Daniel.
"Boss Faustus, what do you see?"
Daniel saw scenes from his previous lives.
He saw himself dying time and time again at the hands of the Dark Gods of those non-human races that had invaded Earth.
He saw countless human powerhouses sacrificing their lives for righteousness.
He saw the humans of Earth being forced into a hopeless corner by the non-human races, with nowhere left to retreat.
James’s voice pulled him back to reality.
Daniel immediately became vigilant.
This Realm of the Holy Spirit truly was anything but simple!
"As expected, Divine-grade secret treasures are unfathomable."
Daniel heightened his guard, gaining an entirely new understanding of Divine-grade secret treasures.
He turned his head and answered James, "I saw my homeland.
What about you?"
"I saw all the different ways I could die."
James smiled, but his eyes were as sharp as blades.
"The second stage is probably related to illusions.
We must be extremely careful."
Daniel and Mosi both nodded in agreement.
"Go in, all of you."
Chanelle, the T7 Oracle-grade powerhouse of the Canaan starfield, spoke calmly.
"If you believe your life is in danger, you may withdraw at any time."
The moment she said that, many of the contestants from the Canaan starfield secretly breathed sighs of relief.
Even low-grade Divine-grade magical beasts posed a fatal threat to eight-star powerhouses, much less the mid-grade and high-grade magical beasts that would also be roaming the battlefield!
Nearly every Oracle-grade expert from every starfield gave similar warnings to their own contestants.
After all, nine-star powerhouses were exceedingly rare.
Although the other contestants were inferior to nine-star contenders, they were still the future hopes of their respective starfields.
Among them, a few might very well advance to the Oracle-grade in the future.
The death of any single contestant would be a loss too heavy for their starfield to bear!

Swish!
Swish!

chapters.title: Chapter 279 -279: First Place by an Insurmountable Lead, Leaving the Entire Field in the Dust
paragraphs: "Endless Divine Power!"
Daniel’s true body and his ninety-nine clones joined forces to control the seemingly boundless Sea of Elements, an ocean of interwoven ice and fire.
The vast power suddenly closed in like the collapse of heaven and earth, swallowing every magical beast that was still plummeting through the air.
At the same time, an endless stream of ice and fire elements continued to condense wildly in the void, constantly pouring into the Sea of Elements and ensuring that it would never run dry.
Countless Divine-grade magical beasts were dragged into the vast ocean. Their shrill, agonized howls rose one after another, each cry more heart-wrenching than the last.
[Ding! You have slain a Divine-grade magical beast and obtained Primal Spirit ×1000...]
System notifications surged in wave after wave like an unending tide.
Daniel had long since grown accustomed to this. He did not even lift an eyelid.
Meanwhile, every other contestant in Warzone 1 stared at the scene in stunned disbelief.
That limitless Sea of Elements had nearly enveloped the entire Warzone, sweeping all ninety thousand magical beasts into its grasp!
Whether those magical beasts were low-grade, mid-grade, or high-grade, there was no exception.
The magical beasts writhed and struggled within the elemental sea, their miserable roars shaking the heavens and earth, yet no matter how desperately they fought, none could break free.
"By the Creator... Lord Faustus... is he planning to take on ninety thousand Divine-grade magical beasts all by himself?"
One contestant swallowed with difficulty, his eyes bulging out of their sockets.
"Take them on? You call this taking them on?"
"This is clearly... Lord Faustus claiming all ninety thousand magical beasts for himself! It doesn’t matter what grade they are. He’s crushing every single one of them!"
"The competition only just started!"
"He opened with a forbidden-grade Sea of Elements. Is this... his way of showing them respect?"
Elysi’s brows drew tightly together. He looked toward Daniel’s direction with displeasure, a trace of wariness and indignation flashing through his eyes.
What an enormous appetite this fellow had!
He was actually trying to monopolize all the magical beast resources in the entire Warzone.
A flicker of unease rose within Elysi’s heart. If he wanted to hunt magical beasts and increase his own kill count, he might have no choice but to clash with Faustus head-on.
Yet he could sense an unfamiliar but incredibly powerful stream of mind power locked firmly onto him at all times.
His heart churned with conflict, but even after a long while, he did not dare move.
In the spectator arena, the massive screen across the sky displayed every battle taking place in each Warzone.

The shocking sight of Faustus sweeping through ninety thousand magical beasts single-handedly fell into the eyes of every Oracle-grade present. Not one of the gathered powerhouses could remain unmoved.
"That Faustus from Canaan Starfield is no simple character."
The Oracle-grade of Samuel Starfield raised an eyebrow and sighed in a low voice.
"Elysi is probably in trouble. Forget it. As long as he keeps his true strength concealed, that will be enough. There is no need for him to confront a peak powerhouse like this directly."
"Faustus... As expected of the Starchosen of this generation. He cannot be underestimated."
The Oracle-grade of Aurora Starfield watched the enormous screen with great interest, a faint, meaningful smile forming at the corner of his lips.
"A minor issue. Marcus of my Starfield possesses formidable strength. He is in no way inferior to Faustus."
The Oracle-grade of Alba Starfield stroked his long beard, his smile carrying a touch of confidence.
As Daniel controlled the Sea of Elements and harvested magical beasts at a frantic pace, he silently calculated his kill count.
Just then, an icy announcement suddenly resounded throughout the map, its voice covering the entire Realm of the Holy Spirit.
[Battle Record Announcement: Faustus has slain more than one hundred magical beasts.]
[Battle Record Announcement: Harris has slain more than one hundred magical beasts.]
[Battle Record Announcement: Udi has slain more than one hundred magical beasts.]
[Battle Record Announcement: ...]
"A realm-wide announcement?"
Daniel blinked.
There were actually so many contestants capable of keeping pace with him?
The corners of his mouth curved upward slightly as he murmured softly,
"Can all of you... continue following behind me?"
Several seconds later, the announcements exploded once more!
[Battle Record Announcement: Faustus has slain more than one thousand magical beasts.]
[Battle Record Announcement: Eris has slain more than one thousand magical beasts.]
[Battle Record Announcement: Igor has slain more than one thousand magical beasts.]
"Only two."
Daniel’s eyes lit up as he memorized those two names.
Eris. Igor!
Both were nine-star powerhouses, and neither was an ordinary figure!
Then, almost in the very same instant—
[Battle Record Announcement: Faustus has slain more than ten thousand magical beasts!]
This time, no other name appeared after his on the announcement board!
Warzone 7.
When Faustus’s battle record exploded through the realm like a clap of thunder, James was drenched in sweat as he cut down a magical beast.
The instant he heard the announcement, his entire body froze.
James gritted his teeth and cursed under his breath, "Damn it, Faustus, you ridiculously overpowered monster!"
He glanced at his own kill count.
He had only just broken past five hundred!
"Faustus..."
Harris’s eyes were filled with complicated emotions.
"As expected, you are still just as dazzling as ever. So brilliant that no one can even look directly at you!"
Warzone 5.
"Faustus has already killed ten thousand magical beasts?"
The corner of Silas’s mouth twitched. He nearly lost his grip on the weapon in his hand.
"Could... could he possibly be cheating?"
Even a rare ripple of emotion appeared in Julian’s empty eyes.
"Faustus... is somewhat terrifying."
The announcements continued, but Faustus’s name was like a brand burned into the very top of the leaderboard, immovable and impossible to ignore!
[Battle Record Announcement: Faustus has slain more than twenty thousand magical beasts.]
Boom—!
The contestants in Warzone 1 completely erupted into an uproar.
Many experts stopped fleeing and flew back up into the air, staring blankly at the distant figure who resembled an invincible war god.
"Did I hear that wrong? These magical beasts... what grade were they again?"
"D-Divine-grade..."
"The creatures Lord Faustus is killing are Divine-grade magical beasts? Anyone who didn’t know better would think he was slaughtering ants..."
"I’m starting to suspect something is wrong with my ears."
"Everyone, those are Divine-grade magical beasts! He can surround and massacre so many of them all by himself... ’Absurd’ is no longer enough to describe this!"
The sound of the announcements rang out like beating war drums, never pausing for even an instant.
[Battle Record Announcement: Faustus has slain more than thirty thousand magical beasts.]
Boom—!
This time, it was no longer limited to Warzone 1.
Upon hearing that number, every contestant across all ten Warzones felt an illusory sense of disbelief, as though they had somehow fallen into a dream.
"You’ve got to be kidding me!"
"Are we really participating in the same trial?"
"What exactly are we even doing here?"
"Faustus has already killed thirty thousand... I only just finished killing my fifth one!"
"I only just managed to escape from the magical beasts chasing me... Compared to him, I’m nothing but a joke."
"Faustus... is he the God of War himself?"
The expressions of the other nine-star powerhouses became especially ugly.
"Faustus... You truly hid your strength well!"
Silas raised his head toward the sky and let out a long sigh, his face filled with helplessness.
"Hiss—"
Harris felt a bitter dryness in his throat.
He suddenly realized just how foolish he had been to once imagine defeating Faustus and proving himself stronger.
Faustus was unquestionably the strongest enemy he had ever encountered in his life.
There was no one else even close.
"Faustus... I wonder who would prove superior between you and Flora?"
Julian pondered silently, a flicker of expectation flashing through his eyes.
At the same time, in the spectator stands, cries of astonishment continuously rose from the gathered Oracle-grades.
"This kid... is an absolute monster!"
The Oracle-grade of Maritim Starfield shook his head in amazement.
"Canaan Starfield’s Contribution Points and harvest this time will probably be beyond anyone else’s reach."
The Oracle-grade of Lumina Starfield gave a soft sigh, his voice filled with envy.
"During the warm-up competition, Samuel Starfield suppressed the entire field. How awe-inspiring they were then."
"And now? They have merely served as the perfect foil for Faustus and Canaan Starfield."
The stronger Samuel Starfield appeared, the more it highlighted Faustus’s brilliance.
No matter how powerful they were, they still did not possess anyone who could stand shoulder to shoulder with Faustus.
In the end, Faustus alone was stronger than them all!
"Marcus of my Starfield... is only very, very slightly inferior to Faustus."
The Oracle-grade of Alba Starfield reluctantly revised his earlier statement, his voice noticeably lower than before.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 -280-The Second-Stage Illusion Trial
paragraphs: Warzone 1.
The kill notifications ringing in Daniel’s ears surged endlessly like a raging tide.
By the moment the realm-wide announcement sounded, his kill count had already broken through the thirty-thousand mark!
"Thirty thousand magical beasts..."
The corners of his mouth curved upward, carrying a faint smile.
Each Warzone contained a total of ninety thousand magical beasts, yet he alone had slaughtered a full third of them, firmly standing above every other contestant!
Furthermore, all thirty thousand magical beasts he had massacred were low-grade Divine-grade beasts.
Of the remaining sixty thousand, the overwhelming majority were mid-grade and high-grade Divine-grade beasts. Only a scattered handful of low-grade beasts remained throughout the zone.
The difficulty of killing mid-grade Divine-grade magical beasts compared to low-grade ones was like the difference between heaven and earth.
In other words, every single contestant in Warzone 1 had been thoroughly screwed over by Faustus.
If they wanted to advance, they would have no choice but to grit their teeth and tackle those mid-grade and high-grade hard targets.
"Since victory is already firmly within my grasp, there is no need to waste any more effort."
Daniel had no intention of spending his time and energy gnawing away at those hard bones.
The efficiency was low, and the risks were high.
Without the slightest hesitation, he chose to activate the second stage of the elimination round.
Just then—
[Realm-Wide Announcement: The first contestant to enter the second stage of the elimination round has appeared!]
[Congratulations to Faustus, contestant of Canaan Starfield from Warzone 1, for becoming the first powerhouse to advance into the second stage!]

The instant the realm-wide announcement exploded across the battlefield, every contestant in Warzone 1 looked as though someone had forcibly stuffed a mouthful of bitter herbs down their throat. Their faces darkened until they were nearly black.
Faustus, that damned bastard!
"Wait... Does that mean only mid-grade Divine-grade magical beasts and above are left for us to hunt now?"
One expert looked utterly lost, his voice trembling.
"Heh... Mid-grade and above? You want to kill them? More like they’ll kill you!"
Another expert’s face was as gloomy as water. Inwardly, he had already cursed Faustus a thousand times over.
"Damn it! That bastard Faustus took every easy magical beast for himself and left all the troublesome ones to us!"
"I quit! How are we supposed to keep competing like this? I admit defeat!"
"Lord Faustus, you’ve cut off our path forward!"
Another contestant looked as though he was on the verge of tears.
The experts in the other Warzones were equally shaken, and heated discussions erupted everywhere.
"How long has it even been since the competition started? Faustus has already entered the second stage?"
"Faustus ended the competition the moment he entered the field. This is absurd!"

"With someone that powerful here, who can possibly suppress him? He stands alone at the very top while the rest of us have all become mere foils. Is this even a competition anymore, or is it just his one-man performance?"
"I would rather face an ancient Dark God in the abyss than compete on the same stage as Faustus."
"The most terrifying part is that he has not even gone all out yet. The goal we are desperately fighting for is something he can reach with a casual wave of his hand!"
Whoosh—!
Faustus suddenly appeared within the map of the second stage.

The Realm of the Holy Spirit was profound and unfathomable. Not only was its first layer more than ten times vaster than the great world outside, it actually concealed multiple layers of space within itself!
The second stage of the elimination round was located in this second spatial layer.
"Are all Divine-grade secret treasures this wondrous?"
Daniel pondered inwardly, his curiosity toward Divine-grade secret treasures deepening even further.
As long as he secured first place in the competition, the Divine-grade skill book and the Divine-grade secret treasure would both fall into his hands.
He looked around.
As far as his eyes could see, the entire area was filled with circular stone platforms, each roughly a meter in diameter.
There were platforms upon the ground and platforms suspended high in the sky. They were packed densely throughout the space, stretching endlessly into the distance with no end in sight.
"What are these things?"
A glimmer flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
At this moment, he was still the only person in the second layer.
He casually selected one of the stone platforms and sat down cross-legged upon it.
Almost at the same moment, the rules of the second stage flooded into the depths of his mind.
So that was how it worked.

Those circular platforms were exceptional auxiliary treasures designed to temper one’s Mental State. They allowed powerful individuals to hone their Mental State within illusions, thereby strengthening themselves.
The rules of the second stage were surprisingly simple.
After accepting the trial of the Dreamscape Platform, whoever could escape the illusion and awaken in the shortest amount of time would achieve the best result.
The first two thousand contestants to awaken would advance. Everyone else would be eliminated.
Daniel calmed his mind and began circulating his mind power according to the instructions provided by the rules.
Before long, he felt his eyelids grow as heavy as if they had been filled with lead.
Then he fell into a deep sleep.
Outside the competition grounds, in the spectator arena.
Since Daniel was currently the only contestant in the second spatial layer, he naturally became the center of everyone’s attention.

"Lord Coleman’s secret treasure, the Realm of the Holy Spirit, is truly extraordinary. In particular, those Dreamscape Platforms can rightfully be called a sacred land for tempering one’s Mental State."
"Indeed. I believe these juniors will all benefit tremendously from them."
The Oracle-grade of Aurora Starfield spoke with a smile.
"They will certainly gain many benefits, but it is also extremely easy to become lost within the illusion."
Chanelle, the Oracle-grade of Canaan Starfield, smiled faintly.
"If a contestant becomes too attached to the opportunities within the illusion and delays their progress in the competition, they may very well risk being eliminated instead."
"Do you all think Faustus might become the first to awaken?"
The Oracle-grade of Viridis Starfield asked.
"That is difficult to say. There is something rather uncanny about that brat Faustus."
The Oracle-grade of Alba Starfield gave a bitter smile.

"If he becomes lost within the illusion, then he would be far too foolish. How could the second stage possibly compare to the Spirit Tower in the third stage? If it were me, I would decisively abandon the trial inside the illusion and rush straight toward the Spirit Tower instead."
The Oracle-grade of Aetno Starfield laughed.
"You are worrying over nothing. The contestants do not understand the Realm of the Holy Spirit. The benefits of the Spirit Tower may indeed be the greatest, but they have no way of knowing that."
"Precisely. Forcibly breaking free from the illusion is extraordinarily difficult. Merely preserving one’s rationality within it is already no easy feat."
"This stage is most advantageous to contestants who specialize in Mental State cultivation and illusion arts."
"Eris of Lumina Starfield may even be able to surpass Faustus. After all, she is one of the finest masters of illusion techniques!"
Before long, a second powerhouse appeared in the second layer of the Realm of the Holy Spirit.
"Faustus..."
Harris glanced from afar in Daniel’s direction before hurriedly choosing a Dreamscape Platform and sitting down cross-legged.
I absolutely will not lose to you in this second stage, Faustus!
He instantly entered the proper state.
Whoosh—!
The third and fourth contestants appeared one after another.
Udi of Copper Starfield cast an indifferent glance at Daniel and Harris. The proud look on his face immediately vanished.
He pursed his lips, then casually found a place to sit down.
Igor of Maritim Starfield studied Faustus with great interest for a moment before selecting a platform of his own.
The fifth, sixth, and seventh contestants arrived almost simultaneously.
Eris of Lumina Starfield, along with Mosi and James of Canaan Starfield!
With perfect mutual understanding, Mosi and James chose the two platforms adjacent to Daniel’s, sitting down on his left and right respectively.
The eighth, ninth, and tenth contestants followed close behind.
They were Flora and Julian of Samuel Starfield, Silas of Viridis Starfield, White Wolf of Alba Starfield, and Coldstar of Aetno Starfield.
Once they saw the situation clearly, they each silently selected a Dreamscape Platform and sat down.
At this point, every nine-star contestant from the various Starfields had arrived!
A long while later, a disheveled figure finally appeared on the scene.
The moment he arrived, he glared viciously at Daniel’s back.
Had Faustus not slaughtered practically every low-grade Divine-grade magical beast in Warzone 1, he would never have been forced into such a miserable state.
It was none other than Elysi!
"Faustus... You damned bastard!"
With a bellyful of rage and nowhere to vent it, Elysi selected a Dreamscape Platform and sat down heavily upon it.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 -281-Did He Clear the Trial Just by Taking a Nap?
paragraphs: Outside the competition grounds, discussion erupted one after another.
"Isn’t Samuel Starfield going a little too far?! Elysi clearly possesses nine-star strength, yet you forcibly disguised him as an eight-star contestant..."
Chanelle, the Oracle-grade of Canaan Starfield, let out a cold laugh, her voice filled with undisguised mockery.
"How could an eight-star powerhouse possibly slay a mid-grade Divine-grade magical beast alone? You hid him so deeply. Just what exactly were you plotting?"
"Samuel Starfield is truly shameless."
The Oracle-grades of the other Starfields chimed in one after another, showering them with sarcastic remarks.

"In my opinion, they were originally planning to play dirty. They simply never expected Faustus to instantly slaughter thirty thousand low-grade Divine-grade magical beasts, forcing Elysi to expose his true strength."
Someone quietly analyzed the situation.
"Elysi truly does possess the strength to single-handedly kill mid-grade Divine-grade magical beasts. He is in no way inferior to any of the nine-star powerhouses present."
"Hmph. Why should I explain myself to any of you?"
The Oracle-grade of Samuel Starfield wore an indifferent expression, though inwardly, he was extremely displeased with Canaan Starfield.

Canaan Starfield already possesses three nine-star contestants, making them the strongest force among all the Starfields in the heavens. So what if my Samuel Starfield concealed a single nine-star contestant?
Although the Oracle-grades of the various Starfields were dissatisfied, there was nothing they could do about it.
Now that all the nine-star powerhouses had arrived, the contestants who came afterward began pouring into the second layer batch by batch.
Unlike the nine-star powerhouses, these contestants were far from composed. Every single one was either wounded or visibly exhausted.
Clearly, they had gone all out when hunting magical beasts.
After arriving in scattered groups, a total of four thousand contestants finally gathered within the second layer.
There were only two thousand advancement slots available in the second stage of the elimination round.
In other words, half of them would see their journeys end here!
"Whew—!"
Daniel leisurely opened his eyes.
He looked around and discovered that the second-layer space was now completely packed with contestants. Moreover, he was the first person to awaken.
"Strange... Why don’t I feel like I entered an illusion at all?"
He frowned, unable to understand what had happened.
According to the rules, the Dreamscape Platform was supposed to drag a person into an illusory realm.
Yet for some unknown reason, he had simply fallen asleep.
It had been an exceptionally deep sleep too. He had not even had a single dream.
"Could it be because I’m a player?"
Unable to figure out the answer, he could only attribute it to the fact that the advancement system of players was entirely different from that of NPCs.
In the spectator arena, the instant Daniel awakened, every powerhouse present saw it clearly.
At this point, the thousands of contestants who had already been eliminated were also able to watch the events unfolding within the second layer through the celestial screen.
All the other powerhouses were still immersed in their illusions. Only Daniel had awakened early, his expression as calm as ever.
"It’s Faustus again!"
The contestants eliminated from Warzone 1 felt their teeth itch with resentment.
"He’s first again? Don’t tell me he intends to take first place in every single stage of the trial?"
"That’s hard to say. The rules of the third stage haven’t been revealed yet, so no one knows."
"This is getting ridiculous! Will someone please deal with that Faustus fellow already?"
The contestants from Warzone 1 had absolutely no favorable feelings toward Daniel. After all, he had thoroughly ruined them during the first stage.
"You have to be kidding me. The time he took to awaken was far too short, wasn’t it?"
An Oracle-grade looked astonished.
"Something seems a little off."
The other Oracle-grades also turned their attention toward Daniel’s figure.
How could the legendary Dreamscape Platforms possibly be so simple?
The stronger someone was, the more easily they could become immersed within the illusion. Divine-grade powerhouses, in particular, found it extraordinarily difficult to break free.
Unless one had some degree of mastery over the Laws of Illusion, escaping from the illusory realm was nearly impossible.
Yet Daniel’s performance was simply too strange.
When he sank into the illusion, he looked as though he was merely falling asleep.
When he woke up, he looked as though he had simply finished taking a pleasant nap.
Then, looking at the other contestants, the difference was even more striking.
Their facial expressions varied wildly.
Some were grinning foolishly. Some wore worried frowns. Some looked furious. Others appeared overcome with wild joy.
As for Daniel?
He looked as though he had taken a wonderfully comfortable nap and awakened feeling completely refreshed.
It was simply outrageous!
"This young man is anything but ordinary. He is a rare and outstanding seedling of my Canaan Starfield."
"As expected of the Starchosen who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak!"
Oracle-grade Chanelle looked at Daniel with a smile while seemingly unintentionally releasing a trace of her aura.
She was making her stance clear to the Oracle-grades of every other Starfield.
Anyone who dared harbor designs on Faustus would become an enemy of Gold Mountain.
This man was under Gold Mountain’s protection!
Within the second-layer space.
Daniel glanced at James and Mosi beside him.
At this moment, James wore an excited expression, constantly smacking his lips as saliva dripped from the corner of his mouth.
Mosi, on the other hand, remained as steady as ever, still wearing that same expressionless face of his.
Daniel swept his gaze across the other contestants as well. Every one of them displayed a different abnormal reaction, presenting all manner of bizarre appearances.
"Is it really that interesting?"
Daniel blinked.
"Why do I feel like I just missed out on a fortune worth ten billion?"
Still, given the current situation, since the illusion seemed to have nothing to do with him, he might as well head directly to the final stage of the elimination round and wait there.
Once he passed the final trial, he would obtain his qualification for the advancement competition, along with the mission rewards.
Without the slightest hesitation, he chose to end the second-stage trial.
Third-Layer Space.
A towering pagoda stood majestically within the space, piercing straight through the clouds as though it connected the earth to the very end of the heavens.
This tower was known as the Spirit Tower!
The rules for the third stage of the competition poured into Daniel’s mind.
[Spirit Tower — Final Stage of the Elimination Round]
The detailed rules are as follows:

First: The Spirit Tower consists of nine floors. The strength of the guardian on each floor will increase progressively. After slaying a guardian, the challenger will obtain a reward corresponding to that floor.

Second: The first three floors are individual secret realms, and all challengers must fight alone. Starting from the fourth floor, challengers may form alliances and advance together. However, after slaying the guardian, the entire alliance will receive only one share of the reward!

Third: Advancement will be determined according to the highest floor ultimately reached by each challenger. Only the top twenty contestants may enter the advancement competition. All remaining challengers will be eliminated.
Special Note: The combat power of the Spirit Tower’s guardians ranges from peak quasi-Sage at the lowest level to Oracle-grade at the highest!
Once one thousand challengers have gathered in the third layer, the Spirit Tower will automatically open.
After reading through the rules, Daniel frowned slightly.
"The format of this competition... is rather brutal!"
There were actually only twenty slots available for the advancement competition!
In other words, out of two thousand contestants, one thousand nine hundred and eighty would be mercilessly eliminated.
"There are even rewards for killing the guardians."
Daniel felt his heart stir.

Once a reward entered his hands, it could trigger his Millionfold Boost. Even if he obtained the exact same spoils as the other contestants, the items he received would still be a million times superior to theirs!
"However, the third stage cannot begin just yet."
He drew in a deep breath.
"At least one thousand contestants need to arrive here before it can be activated."
Daniel was not in any hurry. The rewards were not going anywhere.
Within the second-layer space.
A female powerhouse suddenly opened her eyes.
Had anyone been paying close attention to her the entire time, they would have discovered that she had taken even less time to awaken than Faustus!
Faustus had at least taken a nap.
As for her, she had awakened almost instantly, as though she had never fallen into the illusion at all.
In the spectator arena, astonished cries immediately rang out.
"Who is that powerhouse? How did she awaken so quickly?!"
"The nine-star powerhouse of Lumina Starfield—Eris!"
"So it’s her! If I remember correctly, she was the fifth contestant to arrive in the second-layer space."
"Eris... She is incredibly powerful. Back in Warzone 7, no one dared approach within ten thousand meters of her."
"Nonsense. How could there possibly be a weakling among nine-star powerhouses?"
"Eris has entered the third layer..."
The eliminated contestants watched as Eris’s figure vanished through the exit of the second-layer space.
However, less than a moment after Eris departed, another powerhouse awakened.
Unexpectedly, it was Elysi, the contestant from Samuel Starfield!

Once a reward entered his hands, it could trigger his Millionfold Boost.
Even if he obtained the exact same spoils as the other contestants, the items he received would still be a million times superior to theirs!
"However, the third stage cannot begin just yet."
He drew in a deep breath.
"At least one thousand contestants need to arrive here before it can be activated."
Daniel was not in any hurry.
The rewards were not going anywhere.
Within the second-layer space.
A female powerhouse suddenly opened her eyes.
Had anyone been paying close attention to her the entire time, they would have discovered that she had taken even less time to awaken than Faustus!
Faustus had at least taken a nap.
As for her, she had awakened almost instantly, as though she had never fallen into the illusion at all.
In the spectator arena, astonished cries immediately rang out.
"Who is that powerhouse?
How did she awaken so quickly?!"
"The nine-star powerhouse of Lumina Starfield—Eris!"
"So it’s her!
If I remember correctly, she was the fifth contestant to arrive in the second-layer space."
"Eris...
She is incredibly powerful.
Back in Warzone 7, no one dared approach within ten thousand meters of her."
"Nonsense.
How could there possibly be a weakling among nine-star powerhouses?"
"Eris has entered the third layer..."
The eliminated contestants watched as Eris’s figure vanished through the exit of the second-layer space.
However, less than a moment after Eris departed, another powerhouse awakened.
Unexpectedly, it was Elysi, the contestant from Samuel Starfield!

chapters.title: Chapter 282 -282-Elysi’s Hidden Strength Revealed—Nine Stars!
paragraphs: The first thing Elysi did after awakening was look toward the place where Daniel had previously been sitting.
Just as expected, he was already gone.
"Faustus... Hmph!"
He snorted coldly and immediately chose to enter the third-layer space.
The spectator arena instantly erupted, discussions exploding like thunder.
"You’ve got to be kidding me! It’s actually Elysi!"
"Elysi? Who is that? I don’t remember anyone by that name among the nine-star powerhouses."
"Wait, Elysi? Isn’t he an eight-star powerhouse?"
"Eight-star, my ass! He definitely concealed his strength. Otherwise, there’s no way he could have killed a mid-grade Divine-grade magical beast on his own!"
"He’s the third to awaken? He took almost the same amount of time as Eris! There is no way this guy is merely an eight-star contestant!"
"By the Creator, just what kind of monsters are these people?!"
"Elysi was screwed over rather badly by Faustus in the first stage. Hahaha! I wonder what kind of sparks will fly when these two powerhouses collide."
"That depends on whether they end up facing each other in the advancement competition!"
Third-Layer Space.
Faustus was waiting when a figure suddenly appeared out of thin air.
He was slightly taken aback.
He had been the first to enter the Dreamscape Platform trial and had possessed a clear advantage in time, yet another powerhouse had still managed to awaken so quickly?
Without that advantage, this person might have been the true first-place finisher.
With that thought in mind, he focused his attention on the newcomer.
It was a female contestant.
Her clothing and appearance were both utterly ordinary. Even the aura emanating from her body was so unremarkable that there was not the slightest flaw to be found in it.
She had practically brought the words perfectly ordinary to their absolute limit.
However, how could a powerhouse capable of awakening so quickly from an illusion of that caliber truly be ordinary?
There had to be something extraordinary about her.
"It’s... Eris."
Faustus had memorized the names of nearly every nine-star powerhouse.
She was Lumina Starfield’s only nine-star contestant—Eris.
Eris also looked at him, her face filled with vigilance, but she did not speak.
The third-layer space fluctuated once again, and another figure appeared.
Faustus and Eris both turned to look at the newcomer at the same time.
"Hm? Elysi?!"
A cold smile formed at the corner of Faustus’s mouth.
He quickly arrived at a conclusion.
This fellow had hidden his strength!
Elysi was clearly a nine-star powerhouse, yet he had disguised himself as an eight-star contestant.

Faustus and Elysi had both been assigned to Warzone 1. He remembered clearly that when the magical beasts were first released, nearly every contestant had fled for their lives. Only Elysi, like himself, had actively gone out to fight the magical beasts.
"He actually awakened so quickly as well."
Faustus’s brow twitched slightly.
Elysi’s strength could not be underestimated!
Eris, however, looked perfectly unsurprised.
Elysi was equally unshaken by Eris’s appearance. Evidently, the two of them already knew something about each other.
"Faustus!"
Elysi looked at Faustus and revealed a provocative smile.
This bastard had certainly made things miserable for him back in Warzone 1.
Before long, more and more powerhouses awakened from the second layer and were teleported before the Spirit Tower in the third layer.
James and Mosi arrived one after another as well.
After reading through the rules, the two fell silent for a moment before raising their heads to look at Daniel.
"Boss Faustus, what do you think?" James asked.
"We form a team once we reach the fourth floor," Daniel replied decisively.
"Exactly what I had in mind."
James glanced at Mosi and smiled.
"Good."
As always, Mosi was a man of few words.
"Then it’s settled."
The three of them quickly finalized their agreement to form a team.
The contestants from the other Starfields were also engaged in their own discussions.
Everyone present was similar enough in strength that no one believed they could single-handedly kill the guardian of the fifth floor.
That guardian would be at the peak of the Divine grade!
Even the guardian of the fourth floor was a high-grade Divine-grade existence, far beyond what a nine-star powerhouse could contend against alone.
"This time, we need to be especially wary of Samuel Starfield and Canaan Starfield."
Harris sought out Igor of Maritim Starfield and Udi of Copper Starfield, bringing three nine-star powerhouses together in one place.
Harris had originally possessed another teammate: the nine-star powerhouse Nox!
Unfortunately, Nox had been slain by Flora during the warm-up competition, leaving Harris with no choice but to search for other unaffiliated nine-star contestants.
"Indeed. Both of those Starfields possess three nine-star contestants each."
Udi’s expression was gloomy as he spoke in a low voice to Harris and Igor beside him.
"Once we enter the advancement competition, we absolutely must contend properly with the nine-star powerhouses from those two Starfields."
"Of course. Otherwise, wouldn’t this trip have been a complete waste? Furthermore, we need to study the rules carefully."
Igor glanced toward the nine-star powerhouses from the other Starfields before speaking gravely.
"The fourth floor allows teams to be formed, and there is no limit on the number of members."
Harris and Udi’s eyes flashed sharply when they heard this.
"That’s right! As long as we gather enough nine-star powerhouses, we may very well be able to overwhelm the guardian of the fifth floor through sheer numbers!"
"I think that plan is workable."
The nine-star contestants from the other Starfields were also forming their own groups.
Silas, White Wolf of Alba Starfield, Eris of Lumina Starfield, and Coldstar of Aetno Starfield formed a team, agreeing to gather together upon reaching the fourth floor.
As for the three powerhouses from Samuel Starfield—Julian, Flora, and Elysi—they naturally banded together.
Just then, a voice as cold as frost suddenly descended from the void.
[Realm-Wide Announcement: The Spirit Tower has opened! All contestants may now enter the Spirit Tower!]
The instant the announcement ended, Faustus and his two companions transformed into streaks of light and flew inside.
More than a thousand other powerhouses also shot forward, charging into the tower one after another.
Spirit Tower.
Faustus’s figure appeared on the first floor.
[Ding! You have entered the first floor of the Spirit Tower.]
Without the slightest panic, he calmly surveyed his surroundings before fixing his gaze on the guardian.
[Spirit Tower Guardian — Peak Demi-Sage Rank]
The guardian resembled a puppet, with the aura of a peak demi-sage rank existence emanating from its body.
As long as Faustus remained still, the puppet did not move either.
"Slaying the guardian grants a reward."
He raised an eyebrow and took a step forward.
Step—!
The puppet moved.
Its Divine Domain and Immortal Singularity unfolded simultaneously.
At the same time, the Spirit Tower’s announcements rang out.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Flora of Samuel Starfield has entered the second floor!]
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Julian of Samuel Starfield has entered the second floor!]
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Harris of Aurora Starfield has entered the second floor!]
A continuous series of announcements sounded one after another.
Faustus remained expressionless.
He had no idea why these people were in such a hurry.
Were they fighting over first place?
"Divine Domain—Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Boom—!
His Divine Domain expanded, instantly crushing the puppet and killing it in a single strike.
After the puppet collapsed, a wooden chest burst out beside its fallen body.
Faustus opened the chest.
[Ding! You have obtained [Spatial Transfer Scroll (Small)] (Supreme Grade)!]
[Ding! You have sold the [Spatial Transfer Scroll] to the Doom Guild, triggering Millionfold Boost! You have obtained [Spatial Transfer Scroll (Small)] (Divine Grade)!]
"Spatial Transfer Scroll?"
He had heard of this item before.
It was a single-use life-saving item. Once activated, it could randomly teleport its user to any location within the Starfield.
"Not bad."
Originally, it had only been a Supreme-grade item. After being amplified, it had leaped directly to the Divine grade.
It was indeed quite good.
"On to the second floor."
The Spirit Tower’s announcements rang out once again.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Flora of Samuel Starfield has entered the third floor!]
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Julian of Samuel Starfield has entered the third floor!]
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Harris of Aurora Starfield has entered the third floor!]

chapters.title: Chapter 283 -283-First Among All, Faustus
paragraphs: Faustus appeared on the second floor.
The guardian of this floor was an iron-skinned puppet with the strength of a low-grade sage.
"Divine Domain—Chaotic Reincarnation."
Without the slightest hesitation, he unfolded his Divine Domain. In an instant, it crushed the iron puppet’s Divine Domain beneath it!
Once again, an iron chest appeared in front of him.
[Ding! You have obtained a [Large Spatial Transfer Scroll] (supreme-grade)!]
[Ding! You have sold the [Spatial Transfer Scroll] to the Doom Guild, triggering Millionfold Boost! You have obtained a [Large Spatial Transfer Scroll] (Divine-grade)!]
A small Spatial Transfer Scroll could only teleport its user within a starfield, while a large one could cross the boundaries between starfields.
Daniel nodded in satisfaction and put it away.
"On to the third floor!"
His figure vanished from the second floor in an instant.
At this moment, however, there was still no news of any of the first group of nine-star powerhouses clearing the third floor.
The guardian on the third floor was a mid Divine-grade puppet. Even a nine-star powerhouse could only wear it down little by little.
On the third floor.
The moment Faustus appeared, he immediately summoned his clones and deployed his Divine Domain.
Dense layers of Divine Domains unfurled simultaneously, their overwhelming might filling the entire floor.
The guardian here was a silver-white humanoid puppet at mid Divine-grade.
Killing a mid Divine-grade opponent alone would take some time. That was precisely why none of the nine-star powerhouses had managed to clear the floor yet.
The moment Daniel unfolded his Divine Domain, countless skills poured down like a torrential storm.
Immortal Icon!
Endless Divine Power!
Void Annihilation!
Arrow of Judgment!
Judgment of Frost and Flame!
What made Faustus truly terrifying was his ability to instantly unleash innumerable skills. Every single skill could be amplified many times over, and every attack dealt true damage.
Coupled with his Law of Fate, not a single strike missed!
A hundred overlapping Divine Domains layered upon one another, reducing the gap between him and a mid Divine-grade sage to almost nothing.
In the viewing arena, the second group of eliminated contestants poured into the spectator zone, their gazes locked unblinkingly on the vast projection screen in the sky.
"As expected of Harris, a descendant of the number one race in the starry skies! He’s about to kill the guardian of the third floor!"
"Flora’s Strength can’t instantly kill targets with such a vast rank difference, but she’s nearly worn it down."
"Julian’s blade is terrifying indeed. Even a mid-grade sage guardian can do nothing but passively endure his attacks."
"That James from the Canaan starfield is really something. He has tens of thousands of clones surrounding one guardian and beating it senseless. Is that really necessary?"
Within the Spirit Tower, the guardians on several floors were already on the verge of collapse, needing only one or two more attacks to be finished off.
The first powerhouse to step onto the fourth floor was about to be born!
In the spectator stands, the eliminated contestants held their breath, their hearts pounding like drums.
Was the finest challenger of the third-floor trial finally about to emerge?
Julian of the Samuel starfield. Harris of the Aurora starfield. Igor of the Maritim starfield. Faustus of the Canaan starfield. Udi of the Copper starfield...
These powerhouses were like elite runners on a racetrack, charging toward the finish line almost shoulder to shoulder. No one knew who would break through first.
"Harris, go! Take first place and bring glory to the Aurora starfield!"
The spectators from the Aurora starfield clenched their fists, veins bulging on their foreheads.
"Igor! Igor is the strongest!"
Even the Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Maritim starfield was shouting encouragement.
"Udi, hurry! Charge!"
The spectators from the Copper starfield were so excited that they shot to their feet.
"Julian, claim first place!"
The powerhouses of the Samuel starfield roared loudly.
"Faustus..."
Chanelle, the Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Canaan starfield, stared at that figure and murmured under her breath.
"Can you do it again?"
At that very moment, on one of the projected images, a silver-white guardian was finally slain!
Every single person in the viewing arena held their breath.
The result was out—the first powerhouse to kill a guardian on the third floor had appeared!
On the third floor where Faustus was fighting, the guardian was being battered by an unending tide of damage as violent as a tsunami.
"Just a little more."
The mid Divine-grade guardian had already become nothing more than a living target. It was only barely surviving thanks to the might of its sage rank.
Faustus’s skills dealt far too much damage, and they could be stacked layer upon layer. His firepower was simply outrageously overwhelming.
Then, at a certain moment—
Boom!
The guardian abruptly exploded, its body shattering into pieces.
[Ding! You have slain the guardian of the third floor of the Spirit Tower.]
A treasure chest gleaming with silver light dropped from the fallen guardian.
Faustus walked forward and opened it.
[Ding! You have obtained the special item [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium] (supreme-grade)!]
[Ding! You have sold the [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium] to the Doom Guild, triggering Millionfold Boost! You have obtained a [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium] (Divine-grade)!]
He lowered his gaze toward the item in his hand.
[Scroll of Forced Equilibrium (Divine-grade)]
Special Type: Single-use consumable item
Effect: After use, suppresses the target’s sage-rank might to the same level as the user’s.
Restriction 1: Only effective against targets below Oracle-grade.
Restriction 2: Only suppresses the target’s sage rank. The target’s own inherent strength is unaffected.
Restriction 3: This effect cannot be amplified, duplicated, extended, or otherwise enhanced...
Duration: 40 seconds
Daniel swiftly read through the description before putting the item away.
This thing was useful, but it was not overwhelmingly powerful.
It could only suppress sage rank. The target’s fundamental strength would remain intact.
Against an opponent at the peak of Divine-grade, it could at most prevent their sage rank from being quite so overwhelming.

However, the terror of a high Divine-grade or peak Divine-grade powerhouse lay in every single aspect of their power. Therefore, this scroll could only be used as a desperate trump card when gambling on a slim chance of victory.
Without the slightest hesitation, he chose to enter the fourth floor.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Congratulations to Faustus, contestant of the Canaan starfield, for becoming the first to reach the fourth floor of the Spirit Tower!]
Boom!
In the viewing arena, the spectators from all the major starfields instantly widened their eyes.

Just moments ago, they had still been shouting themselves hoarse in support of their own powerhouses. Yet on the screen, only Faustus had managed to overpower and kill the guardian of the third floor.
One had to remember that he had not even been among the first contestants to enter the third floor!
He had started later, yet arrived first, becoming the first person to reach the fourth floor!
The spectators from the various starfields wilted like frost-stricken eggplants, each of them falling silent and dispirited.
"How is that possible?! Faustus took first place again!"
"No! Harris was only a hair’s breadth away! What a pity!"
"Just what corner of the universe did Faustus crawl out from? Since when did the Canaan starfield secretly cultivate such a terrifying monster?"
"Fine. I have nothing to say about this outcome. Faustus started challenging his guardian later than most of them, after all!"
"Uh... I admit I’m convinced, but it’s still such a shame..."
The expressions of the Oracle-grade powerhouses in the spectator stands were equally fascinating.
A proud look appeared on Chanelle’s face, the corners of her lips rising slightly. She did not need to say a single word.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Viridis starfield merely smiled calmly, offering no comment.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Samuel starfield looked as though flames were about to erupt from his eyes as he stared fixedly at Faustus’s figure.

The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Aurora starfield had an extremely gloomy expression. If Nox had not been killed by Flora, then with his unparalleled ability to pierce through a single point with explosive offensive force...
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Alba starfield raised the corners of his mouth in a faint smile.
"Faustus... interesting."
Ever since the elimination round began, Faustus had forcefully dominated the announcement board.
By now, the Oracle-grade powerhouses from all the major starfields had thoroughly committed his name to memory.
Meanwhile, inside the Spirit Tower, all the contestants reacted differently the instant they heard the announcement.
"Why is it Faustus again? I’m already sick of hearing that name."
Udi grumbled sourly. In a fit of anger, he slammed his fist into the guardian in front of him, shattering it into fragments.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Udi, contestant of the Copper starfield, has entered the fourth floor!]

"Every single time, I think I can surpass him, yet every single time, he ends up one step ahead of me! I, Harris, am clearly supposed to be the greatest prodigy of this generation! Where in the world did this Faustus come from?!"
Harris furiously crushed the guardian before him.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Harris, contestant of the Aurora starfield, has entered the fourth floor!]
"Faustus is extremely dangerous!"
A flash of light passed through Julian’s hand, and the guardian in front of him collapsed with a thunderous crash.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Julian, contestant of the Samuel starfield, has entered the fourth floor!]
