Within the Spirit Tower, the guardians on several floors were already on the verge of collapse, needing only one or two more attacks to be finished off.
The first powerhouse to step onto the fourth floor was about to be born!
In the spectator stands, the eliminated contestants held their breath, their hearts pounding like drums.
Was the finest challenger of the third-floor trial finally about to emerge?
Julian of the Samuel starfield.
Harris of the Aurora starfield.
Igor of the Maritim starfield.
Faustus of the Canaan starfield.
Udi of the Copper starfield...
These powerhouses were like elite runners on a racetrack, charging toward the finish line almost shoulder to shoulder.
No one knew who would break through first.
"Harris, go!
Take first place and bring glory to the Aurora starfield!"
The spectators from the Aurora starfield clenched their fists, veins bulging on their foreheads.
"Igor!
Igor is the strongest!"
Even the Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Maritim starfield was shouting encouragement.
"Udi, hurry!
Charge!"
The spectators from the Copper starfield were so excited that they shot to their feet.
"Julian, claim first place!"
The powerhouses of the Samuel starfield roared loudly.
"Faustus..."
Chanelle, the Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Canaan starfield, stared at that figure and murmured under her breath.
"Can you do it again?"
At that very moment, on one of the projected images, a silver-white guardian was finally slain!
Every single person in the viewing arena held their breath.
The result was out—the first powerhouse to kill a guardian on the third floor had appeared!
On the third floor where Faustus was fighting, the guardian was being battered by an unending tide of damage as violent as a tsunami.
"Just a little more."
The mid Divine-grade guardian had already become nothing more than a living target.
It was only barely surviving thanks to the might of its sage rank.
Faustus’s skills dealt far too much damage, and they could be stacked layer upon layer.
His firepower was simply outrageously overwhelming.
Then, at a certain moment—
Boom!
The guardian abruptly exploded, its body shattering into pieces.
[Ding!
You have slain the guardian of the third floor of the Spirit Tower.]
A treasure chest gleaming with silver light dropped from the fallen guardian.
Faustus walked forward and opened it.
[Ding!
You have obtained the special item [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium] (supreme-grade)!]
[Ding!
You have sold the [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium] to the Doom Guild, triggering Millionfold Boost!
You have obtained a [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium] (Divine-grade)!]
He lowered his gaze toward the item in his hand.
[Scroll of Forced Equilibrium (Divine-grade)]
Special Type: Single-use consumable item
Effect: After use, suppresses the target’s sage-rank might to the same level as the user’s.
Restriction 1: Only effective against targets below Oracle-grade.
Restriction 2: Only suppresses the target’s sage rank.
The target’s own inherent strength is unaffected.
Restriction 3: This effect cannot be amplified, duplicated, extended, or otherwise enhanced...
Duration: 40 seconds
Daniel swiftly read through the description before putting the item away.
This thing was useful, but it was not overwhelmingly powerful.
It could only suppress sage rank.
The target’s fundamental strength would remain intact.
Against an opponent at the peak of Divine-grade, it could at most prevent their sage rank from being quite so overwhelming.
However, the terror of a high Divine-grade or peak Divine-grade powerhouse lay in every single aspect of their power.
Therefore, this scroll could only be used as a desperate trump card when gambling on a slim chance of victory.
Without the slightest hesitation, he chose to enter the fourth floor.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Congratulations to Faustus, contestant of the Canaan starfield, for becoming the first to reach the fourth floor of the Spirit Tower!]
Boom!
In the viewing arena, the spectators from all the major starfields instantly widened their eyes.
Just moments ago, they had still been shouting themselves hoarse in support of their own powerhouses.
Yet on the screen, only Faustus had managed to overpower and kill the guardian of the third floor.
One had to remember that he had not even been among the first contestants to enter the third floor!
He had started later, yet arrived first, becoming the first person to reach the fourth floor!
The spectators from the various starfields wilted like frost-stricken eggplants, each of them falling silent and dispirited.
"How is that possible?!
Faustus took first place again!"
"No!
Harris was only a hair’s breadth away!
What a pity!"
"Just what corner of the universe did Faustus crawl out from?
Since when did the Canaan starfield secretly cultivate such a terrifying monster?"
"Fine.
I have nothing to say about this outcome.
Faustus started challenging his guardian later than most of them, after all!"
I admit I’m convinced, but it’s still such a shame..."
The expressions of the Oracle-grade powerhouses in the spectator stands were equally fascinating.
A proud look appeared on Chanelle’s face, the corners of her lips rising slightly.
She did not need to say a single word.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Viridis starfield merely smiled calmly, offering no comment.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Samuel starfield looked as though flames were about to erupt from his eyes as he stared fixedly at Faustus’s figure.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Aurora starfield had an extremely gloomy expression.
If Nox had not been killed by Flora, then with his unparalleled ability to pierce through a single point with explosive offensive force...
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Alba starfield raised the corners of his mouth in a faint smile.
"Faustus... interesting."
Ever since the elimination round began, Faustus had forcefully dominated the announcement board.
By now, the Oracle-grade powerhouses from all the major starfields had thoroughly committed his name to memory.
Meanwhile, inside the Spirit Tower, all the contestants reacted differently the instant they heard the announcement.
"Why is it Faustus again?
I’m already sick of hearing that name."
Udi grumbled sourly.
In a fit of anger, he slammed his fist into the guardian in front of him, shattering it into fragments.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Udi, contestant of the Copper starfield, has entered the fourth floor!]
"Every single time, I think I can surpass him, yet every single time, he ends up one step ahead of me!
I, Harris, am clearly supposed to be the greatest prodigy of this generation!
Where in the world did this Faustus come from?!"
Harris furiously crushed the guardian before him.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Harris, contestant of the Aurora starfield, has entered the fourth floor!]
"Faustus is extremely dangerous!"
A flash of light passed through Julian’s hand, and the guardian in front of him collapsed with a thunderous crash.
[Spirit Tower Announcement: Julian, contestant of the Samuel starfield, has entered the fourth floor!]

chapters.title: Chapter 284 -284-A Star-Studded Lineup, Banding Together for Survival
paragraphs: The space of the fourth floor.
Daniel’s figure appeared within it.
Unlike the first three floors, there was no guardian on the fourth floor. There was only a wide-open gateway.
Beyond the gateway lay nothing but swirling chaos. Nothing inside could be seen clearly.
"Starting from the fourth floor, contestants are allowed to form teams."

He stared thoughtfully at the chaotic gateway and mused inwardly, "The guardian of the fourth floor is high Divine-grade, far stronger than a mid Divine-grade opponent. Killing it alone would be far too difficult. Teaming up is the best option."
He had already made arrangements with James and Mosi.
[Ding! You may send invitations to other contestants within the Spirit Tower. Any invited contestant will appear in your space.]
A list materialized in front of Daniel, containing the names of every contestant currently inside the Spirit Tower.
[Contestant: James. Current Floor: Third Floor. Send invitation?]
[Contestant: Mosi. Current Floor: Third Floor. Send invitation?]
He selected the invitation option.
Before long, after defeating their respective guardians on the third floor, James and Mosi appeared on the fourth floor.
The three of them gathered together and simultaneously turned their gazes toward the chaotic gateway.
"Go!"
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Without the slightest hesitation, three figures shot into the gateway.
[Ding! You have entered the fourth floor of the Spirit Tower.]
Roar!
The moment Daniel and the other two entered, a deafening beastly roar exploded beside their ears.
His mind power instantly spread outward, and he immediately sensed an aura far more powerful than his own rapidly approaching.
"Chaotic Reincarnation!"
He instantly summoned his clones, and his Divine Domain erupted with a thunderous boom.
James and Mosi deployed their own Divine Domains almost simultaneously.
Boom!
An overwhelmingly powerful wave of sage-rank might descended upon them, firmly suppressing all three of their Divine Domains.
This was suppression through sheer rank.
Facing a high Divine-grade guardian, three nine-star powerhouses held no advantage whatsoever. Their Divine Domains were being crushed to the absolute limit!
Thud!
Thud! Thud! Thud...
High above them, an enormous creature slowly strode forward.

Its body was colossal, and its four legs stepped upon the void itself. Every step it took caused space to tremble, and the hearts of the three nine-star powerhouses seemed to beat in rhythm with its footsteps.
Daniel and the other two immediately found their auras thrown into disorder, as though an invisible hand had seized them by the throat.
"We can’t let it dictate the pace of the battle. The longer this goes on, the worse it will be for us."
Daniel made his decision immediately.
"Attack now!"
"Immortal Icon!"
Rumble!
His clones simultaneously activated their secret art, transforming into enormous giants that launched a ferocious assault upon the massive beast.
Mosi’s figure suddenly blurred into an afterimage. Tearing through the air, he charged straight toward the beast.
Clang!
A blade light flashed like a cold crescent moon. Astonishingly, it sliced clean through one of the beast’s legs in a single strike, leaving behind a cut as smooth as a mirror.
James swept his hand outward, and tens of thousands of puppets surged forth like a tidal wave, instantly covering the entire space.
The puppets simultaneously unleashed all manner of skills, while the edges of their weapons gleamed with a sinister green light.
That was James’s specialty: the art of poison tempering.
He possessed countless varieties of poison, with virtually every type imaginable among them.
Daniel knew perfectly well that even a mid Divine-grade powerhouse would be unable to withstand James’s poisons!

Countless attacks poured down upon the massive beast like a violent storm. However, the majority of them sank into its vast sage-rank might, vanishing without a trace like mud disappearing into the sea.
"Die!"
Mosi shouted coldly. A brilliant light erupted from his eyes, and the aura around his body surged hundreds of times over, making his blade even sharper and fiercer than before.
"Have a taste of this!"
James sent poisonous needles, poisonous pills, poisoned blades, and clouds of toxic smoke hurtling toward the massive beast without restraint, blanketing the surroundings.
"Fighting together as a team really does make things much easier!"
The corners of Daniel’s lips curled upward slightly.

As long as they were not instantly killed or utterly crushed by the massive beast in a single strike, three nine-star powerhouses joining forces to wear down a high Divine-grade opponent was far from impossible.
The guardian of the fourth floor stood firmly at the high Divine-grade level.
A powerhouse at this level was more than capable of crushing nine-star demi-sages head-on.
Fortunately, the fourth floor allowed contestants to form teams. With three nine-star powerhouses working together, they were fully capable of exchanging blows with the guardian.
Roar!
The enormous beast roared to the heavens in pain.
In its eyes, these tiny demi-sages were nothing more than irritating mosquitoes, constantly buzzing around it, impossible to swat away.

Its sage-rank might was undoubtedly powerful, but the secret arts of nine-star powerhouses were varied and endless. Many of their methods were specifically designed to counter the traits of Divine-grade beings, leaving the beast infuriatingly stifled in battle.
The longer Mosi fought, the more frenzied he became. He was even more savage than the enormous beast itself.
A faint layer of blood-red light covered his body as he engaged the beast in an utterly berserk battle.
The beast’s body was as hard as iron, and every stomp of its feet carried subtle, intricate changes in combat technique.
Yet Mosi cared nothing for his own injuries. He traded wound for wound, and every slash of his blade carved deep cracks across the beast’s body.
The more heavily injured he became, the more insane his attacks grew.
James’s tens of thousands of puppets spread out in formation, forming a magnificent and awe-inspiring sight.

All manner of toxins continuously eroded the massive beast. Layers of negative effects stacked upon one another, making it impossible for the beast to return to its peak condition and creating an excellent opportunity for the three nine-star powerhouses to launch an all-out frontal assault.
At that moment, James suddenly took out an object.
Daniel raised an eyebrow.
Was that... the wine flask James usually drank from?
At this moment, the wine flask rapidly expanded until it was taller than a person.
James wrapped both arms around it with visible effort and aimed the mouth of the flask at the massive beast.
"Let this big fellow have a taste of something delicious too! Hahaha!"
With a low shout, he activated his skill.
A streak of black light shot from the mouth of the flask and instantly plunged into the massive beast’s sage-rank might.
In the next moment, the beast’s sage-rank might violently trembled and began to shrink at a terrifying speed.
At the same time, the beast’s body convulsed violently, and blood seeped from countless pores all across its body.
Mosi seized this opening and slashed out with his blade.
"Sever!"
Whoosh!
The blade light flashed, and one of the massive beast’s legs was severed cleanly at the base, the cut as smooth as polished glass.
However, in the very next instant, the beast’s body returned to normal, as though it had never been injured in the first place.
Boom!
Rumble!

Daniel’s clones transformed into hundred-meter-tall giants. Their fists, palms, legs, and feet created countless afterimages, and every attack tore cracks through space. Their peerless physical force smashed ruthlessly into the massive beast’s body.
At the same time, wave after wave of elemental attacks surged forward like an endless tide, continuously washing over the beast.
Under the full-force siege of three nine-star powerhouses, the enormous beast was actually beaten into a daze for a brief moment.
They were merely at the demi-sage rank...
How could they possibly be this powerful?
In the viewing arena, every spectator watched with unblinking eyes.
By now, nearly all the nine-star powerhouses had entered the fourth floor, and every one of them had formed extravagant teams composed entirely of nine-star contestants.

Among them, the Samuel Team, composed of Julian, Flora, and Elysi from the Samuel starfield, and the Canaan Team, composed of Faustus, Mosi, and James from the Canaan starfield, drew the most attention.
Meanwhile, the Hunter Team formed by Harris, Igor, and Udi, as well as the Bloodthirst Team formed by Eris, White Wolf, and Coldstar, were far less popular.
"The Samuel and Canaan teams are advancing the fastest."
The spectators could see the situation clearly.
"That’s only natural. Every nine-star contestant on their teams comes from the same starfield. Their teamwork is obviously flawless."
"The Hunter Team and the Bloodthirst Team are far inferior in comparison."

"Of course they are. Their members come from different starfields, and they’ll still have to face one another as opponents in the advancement round. None of them dares to get injured. They’re all focused solely on protecting themselves."
"They all have their own ulterior motives. In the end, they’re nothing more than a disorganized mob."
"From the looks of it, the victor of this round will come from either Samuel or Canaan."
"My bet is on Samuel. That Faustus fellow is far too domineering. He has the bearing of an undisputed powerhouse!"
"Hahaha! I’m betting on Canaan instead. I think they have a better chance of winning. After all, everyone has already witnessed just how powerful Faustus is."
"It’s still too early to say. Neither side has revealed their trump cards yet. Let’s keep watching."
As for the remaining eight-star contestants, very few of them had managed to reach the fourth floor.
Many powerful contestants had relied entirely on treasures, secret arts, or even external assistance, exhausting every possible method before they had barely managed to arrive.
To them, the guardian of the fourth floor was an insurmountable chasm.
Fortunately, the fourth floor placed no limit on the number of people who could form a team. They, too, could band together for protection.
Thus, several teams made up of dozens of powerful contestants soon appeared within the Spirit Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 285 -285-Clearing the Floor, Starburst Scroll
paragraphs: "The Canaan starfield..."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Samuel starfield glanced at Chanelle, his expression solemn.
"Every one of those youngsters they sent out is far from simple."
"The Samuel starfield is our true formidable rival."
Chanelle stared at the images in the sky, pondering silently.
"When the advancement round begins, I’m afraid a brutal battle will be unavoidable."
Inside the Spirit Tower.
James’s puppet looked listless and exhausted. Soon, a new clone took over the wine flask in its place.
The mouth of the flask continued to spew black light, relentlessly corroding the guardian’s sage-rank might.
Only now did the Divine Domains of the three finally manage to establish a firm foothold.
"Divine Domain—Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Buzz! Buzz!
Ten enormous pairs of eyes emerged in the void. Beams of light shot from their black-and-white pupils, intertwining into a vast monochrome scroll painting that enveloped the massive beast within it.
"Divine Domain—Bottomless Abyss!"

James’s tens of thousands of puppets unfolded their Divine Domains at the same time. Countless black holes materialized, frantically drawing energy from the massive beast’s sage-rank might and converting it for their own use.
"Divine Domain—Asura Sky Rend!"

Mosi’s Divine Domain erupted. In the void, a colossal blood-red giant with eight arms appeared. Every one of its arms glowed with crimson light as they launched a relentless barrage against the massive beast’s sage-rank might.
Only at this moment was the battle, which had originally been dominated by the beast, completely reversed. Daniel and the other two now held the absolute upper hand.
As long as the situation continued like this, it was merely a matter of time before the beast was killed.
Not long afterward, a thunderous explosion rang out!
The enormous beast crashed heavily to the ground, unwilling to accept its defeat.
[Ding! Your team has slain the guardian of the fourth floor of the Spirit Tower.]
A golden treasure chest dropped from the place where the guardian had fallen.
The three powerhouses simultaneously withdrew their Divine Domains, breathing heavily.
Throughout this entire battle, all three of them had attacked with everything they had, nearly exhausting themselves completely.
"If I had faced a high Divine-grade opponent alone, I basically wouldn’t have been capable of killing it."

Daniel pondered inwardly, "The vitality and sage-rank might of a high Divine-grade being have already reached an unimaginable level. It is absolutely not something I can kill alone with my current strength. Even with the three of us together, we only barely managed to defeat it after nearly exhausting all our trump cards."
He shook his head.
"The fourth floor was already this troublesome. I can’t even imagine how terrifying the guardian of the fifth floor will be."
Mosi and James exchanged a glance at the golden treasure chest before simultaneously turning their gazes toward Daniel.
"Boss Faustus, you’re the strongest among us. This treasure chest belongs to you," James said.
"Agreed," Mosi echoed.
Daniel looked at the treasure chest before him, then at his two companions.
Without them, there was absolutely no way he could have cleared this floor so smoothly.
Their contributions had been just as crucial.

They were offering the treasure chest to him because they respected and acknowledged his strength. However, he could not simply accept such benefits without giving anything in return. That would be far too selfish.
Daniel had never denied that he was a selfish person.
However, when dealing with his own people, Daniel had always been generous and fiercely protective!
"Then we’ll do it this way for now. I’ll take this treasure chest first, and after the competition ends, I’ll compensate both of you."
With a smile, Daniel picked up the dropped treasure chest and opened it.
[Ding! You have obtained the special item [Starburst Scroll] (Divine-grade)!]
Daniel’s eyes lit up.
It was actually a Divine-grade item!
He lowered his gaze toward the scroll in his hand.
[Starburst Scroll (Divine-grade)]
Special Type: Single-use consumable item
Effect: Upon use, unleashes an explosive attack with power equivalent to the ultimate strike of a peak Divine-grade powerhouse.
Restriction 1: Only effective against targets below Oracle-grade.
Restriction 2: This effect cannot be amplified, duplicated, or extended.
Duration: 30 seconds. This duration cannot be extended, amplified, duplicated, or extracted.
After reading the description, Daniel raised his eyebrows slightly.
A daring idea suddenly began to form in his mind...
In the viewing arena.
"The Canaan Team is impressive. That fellow Faustus took first place again."
The spectators had already grown numb to it. It was as though as long as Faustus was present, first place could never possibly fall into anyone else’s hands.
"To be fair, Samuel isn’t bad either. They’re only slightly slower than Canaan, and they’re about to finish too."
The spectators could all see the situation clearly.
"Do you think Faustus might continue all the way and become the champion of the entire tournament?"
One powerhouse asked worriedly.
"That... is definitely possible. Judging from his performance so far, Faustus is simply too unfathomable."
Faustus’s astonishing performance had indeed left everyone speechless with admiration.
The warm-up round had practically been a one-starfield show for Samuel. Flora had instantly killed a nine-star powerhouse, and for a time, no one else had been able to match her brilliance.
However, from the moment the elimination round began, Faustus had risen like a blazing comet.
Thirty thousand magical beasts had perished in an instant, allowing him to seize first place single-handedly.
During the illusion trial on the second floor, he had once again been the first to awaken!

Then, during the Spirit Tower trial, everyone else had wished they could charge straight through to the fourth floor in a single breath. Faustus alone had remained calm and unhurried, advancing steadily one step at a time. Yet despite that, he had overtaken every single opponent and become the first to set foot upon the fourth floor!
And now, the Canaan Team had once again become the first team to kill the guardian of the fourth floor!
Faustus!
The spectators’ thoughts were already completely filled with this name.

He had left an unforgettable impression on everyone present, even surpassing the shock Flora had caused in the warm-up round when she judged and killed Nox, a powerhouse of the same level, with a single utterance.
By this point, the vast majority of the spectators already believed that Faustus had an extremely high chance of claiming the tournament championship.
"Do you think Faustus and the others will go challenge the fifth floor?"
Someone asked hesitantly.

"Of course they won’t! The guardian of the fifth floor is at the peak of Divine-grade! No matter how bold the Canaan Team is, they wouldn’t willingly throw away their lives. Unless every nine-star powerhouse joined forces, there wouldn’t even be the slightest chance of victory."
"Exactly. The fourth floor is already their limit."
The spectators understood this perfectly well.
The difficulty of the fourth floor had already reached the ceiling of what these contestants could handle. There was absolutely no way anyone would dare to challenge the fifth floor.
That guardian was at the peak of Divine-grade!
No matter how powerful the nine-star contestants were, they were still only at the peak of demi-sage rank. The gap between them and a peak Divine-grade opponent was like an insurmountable chasm.
"You’ve already done enough. You performed wonderfully."
Chanelle was secretly delighted.
The fact that they had firmly suppressed every other starfield was already an extremely rare achievement.
As long as they continued steadily, winning the championship was far from an impossible dream.
In this universe-level tournament, the major starfields had poured out all their foundations and resources, all for the sake of obtaining a respectable ranking.

Chanelle was brimming with confidence. Even if the Canaan starfield did not become the greatest winner in the end, they would surely achieve excellent results and secure even greater benefits for their starfield.
She asked for nothing more.
Just then, a wave of cheers erupted in the viewing arena.
The spectators from the Samuel starfield became wildly excited after seeing that their own three-person powerhouse team had successfully slain the guardian of the fourth floor as well.
Only the Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Samuel starfield remained outwardly calm, a trace of unwillingness hidden deep within his eyes.
"Being firmly suppressed by the Canaan starfield really is an unpleasant feeling."
He felt extremely frustrated inwardly.
Both teams consisted of three nine-star powerhouses. Why was his side always just slightly inferior?
Julian was not weak. Flora was incredibly powerful. As for Elysi, there was even less need to question her strength.
Yet somehow, their combination still could not compare to the trio of Faustus, James, and Mosi.
It truly left him feeling unable to accept the result!
"Forget it. We’ll see who comes out on top in the advancement round."
He helplessly shook his head.
As for whether the Samuel Team would proceed to the fifth floor, he did not care about that either.
Their advancement was already guaranteed. There was nothing wrong with choosing not to enter the fifth floor.
Suddenly, a series of shocked cries rang out throughout the viewing arena.
"The Hunter Team cleared the floor!"
"The Bloodthirst Team cleared it too!"
"Every single nine-star powerhouse has now cleared the fourth floor of the Spirit Tower!"

The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Samuel starfield glanced at Chanelle, his expression solemn.
"Every one of those youngsters they sent out is far from simple."
"The Samuel starfield is our true formidable rival."
Chanelle stared at the images in the sky, pondering silently.
"When the advancement round begins, I’m afraid a brutal battle will be unavoidable."
Inside the Spirit Tower.
James’s puppet looked listless and exhausted.
Soon, a new clone took over the wine flask in its place.
The mouth of the flask continued to spew black light, relentlessly corroding the guardian’s sage-rank might.
Only now did the Divine Domains of the three finally manage to establish a firm foothold.
"Divine Domain—Chaotic Reincarnation!"
Buzz!
Buzz!
Ten enormous pairs of eyes emerged in the void.
Beams of light shot from their black-and-white pupils, intertwining into a vast monochrome scroll painting that enveloped the massive beast within it.
"Divine Domain—Bottomless Abyss!"
James’s tens of thousands of puppets unfolded their Divine Domains at the same time.
Countless black holes materialized, frantically drawing energy from the massive beast’s sage-rank might and converting it for their own use.
"Divine Domain—Asura Sky Rend!"
Mosi’s Divine Domain erupted.
In the void, a colossal blood-red giant with eight arms appeared.
Every one of its arms glowed with crimson light as they launched a relentless barrage against the massive beast’s sage-rank might.
Only at this moment was the battle, which had originally been dominated by the beast, completely reversed.
Daniel and the other two now held the absolute upper hand.
As long as the situation continued like this, it was merely a matter of time before the beast was killed.
Not long afterward, a thunderous explosion rang out!
The enormous beast crashed heavily to the ground, unwilling to accept its defeat.
[Ding!
Your team has slain the guardian of the fourth floor of the Spirit Tower.]
A golden treasure chest dropped from the place where the guardian had fallen.
The three powerhouses simultaneously withdrew their Divine Domains, breathing heavily.
Throughout this entire battle, all three of them had attacked with everything they had, nearly exhausting themselves completely.
"If I had faced a high Divine-grade opponent alone, I basically wouldn’t have been capable of killing it."
Daniel pondered inwardly, "The vitality and sage-rank might of a high Divine-grade being have already reached an unimaginable level.
It is absolutely not something I can kill alone with my current strength.
Even with the three of us together, we only barely managed to defeat it after nearly exhausting all our trump cards."
He shook his head.
"The fourth floor was already this troublesome.
I can’t even imagine how terrifying the guardian of the fifth floor will be."
Mosi and James exchanged a glance at the golden treasure chest before simultaneously turning their gazes toward Daniel.
"Boss Faustus, you’re the strongest among us.
This treasure chest belongs to you," James said.
"Agreed," Mosi echoed.
Daniel looked at the treasure chest before him, then at his two companions.
Without them, there was absolutely no way he could have cleared this floor so smoothly.
Their contributions had been just as crucial.
They were offering the treasure chest to him because they respected and acknowledged his strength.
However, he could not simply accept such benefits without giving anything in return.
That would be far too selfish.
Daniel had never denied that he was a selfish person.
However, when dealing with his own people, Daniel had always been generous and fiercely protective!
"Then we’ll do it this way for now.
I’ll take this treasure chest first, and after the competition ends, I’ll compensate both of you."
With a smile, Daniel picked up the dropped treasure chest and opened it.
[Ding!

Daniel’s eyes lit up.
It was actually a Divine-grade item!
He lowered his gaze toward the scroll in his hand.
[Starburst Scroll (Divine-grade)]
Special Type: Single-use consumable item
Effect: Upon use, unleashes an explosive attack with power equivalent to the ultimate strike of a peak Divine-grade powerhouse.
Restriction 1: Only effective against targets below Oracle-grade.
Restriction 2: This effect cannot be amplified, duplicated, or extended.
Duration: 30 seconds.
This duration cannot be extended, amplified, duplicated, or extracted.

A daring idea suddenly began to form in his mind...

chapters.title: Chapter 286 -286-No One Dares Advance? Then We’ll Rise to the Challenge!
paragraphs: "Everyone, shall we proceed to the fifth floor?"

White Wolf looked around at his teammates and quietly calculated, "If we join forces with the three members of the Hunter Team, six nine-star powerhouses working together should have at least some chance of victory, right?"

Coldstar frowned slightly and said softly, "Having cleared the fourth floor, we already have our qualification for the advancement round firmly in hand. I’m not going to the fifth floor. I doubt anyone from the other teams will be willing to go either."
Eris silently shook her head, her attitude perfectly clear.
White Wolf sighed and gave a bitter smile.
"Then forget it."
On the other side, Harris tentatively made a suggestion to his teammates.

"How about we join forces with the three from the Bloodthirst Team and take a gamble on the fifth floor? If Faustus and his people stop at the fourth floor, while we manage to clear the fifth, we’ll finally be able to surpass him."
His teammates looked at the eagerness in his eyes, then shook their heads one after another.
"I’m not going. The Samuel and Canaan teams most likely won’t go either. There’s no need to take such a risk," Udi refused decisively.

"Heh. You think just three nine-star powerhouses are enough to covet the fifth floor? Besides, I don’t believe Samuel and Canaan would ever join forces," Igor sneered. "We should focus on preparing for the advancement round instead."
"Fine."
Harris helplessly let his shoulders droop, clenching his fists tightly.
In the end, he had still missed an excellent opportunity to suppress Faustus.
On the Samuel Team’s side, Elysi smiled.
"Let’s leave. The advancement round is already waiting for us."
"Mm." Julian nodded in agreement. "Who would dare challenge the fifth floor? We don’t, and the Canaan Team certainly won’t either."
"Withdraw," Flora said crisply.
A short while later, every nine-star powerhouse had left the Spirit Tower and appeared outside the viewing arena.
As there were still some teams fighting desperately inside the tower, the elimination round had not yet reached the settlement stage.
However, one thing was certain: all the nine-star powerhouses had already secured their qualifications for the advancement round.
"Hmm? Faustus and the others haven’t come out yet?"
Harris swept his gaze across the area outside the arena. For some inexplicable reason, his heart tightened, and he immediately looked up toward the images projected in the void.
"What’s going on?"
White Wolf noticed something strange as well. Among all the nine-star teams, only the Canaan Team was nowhere to be seen.
"Could they still be inside the Spirit Tower?"
White Wolf stared intently at the projection.
"The three powerhouses from Canaan aren’t here?"
Elysi also sensed that something was wrong.
"What are they doing?"
Noticing the strange atmosphere around him, Coldstar raised his head as well.
"What happened...?"
Udi’s gaze followed the others and landed on the images in the void.
Within the projection, the three members of the Canaan Team had already vanished from the fourth floor.
Suddenly—
The image lit up once more.
The figures of Faustus, James, and Mosi reappeared, but they were already standing on the fifth floor!
Whoosh!
The expressions of every nine-star powerhouse present instantly darkened.
Crash!
Every spectator in the arena shot to their feet at the same time, their fists clenched tightly in excitement.
Boom!
Every Oracle-grade powerhouse present was stunned speechless.
Chanelle’s Oracle-grade aura fell into turmoil!
"What?!"
She clenched her fists tightly and stared at the scene in the projection with utter disbelief.
Inside the Spirit Tower.
Daniel opened the treasure chest and reviewed everything he had obtained.
"On the third floor, I obtained the [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium]. It can forcibly suppress the sage-rank might of any powerhouse below Oracle-grade down to the level of my Divine Domain."
He pondered inwardly, "On the fourth floor, I obtained the [Starburst Scroll], whose power can reach the level of an ultimate strike from a peak Divine-grade powerhouse."
A cold gleam flashed through his eyes, and the corners of his lips curled upward slightly.
"With these in hand, even if I face the peak Divine-grade guardian of the fifth floor, I now have trump cards worth gambling on."
He immediately discussed the matter with James and Mosi.
After hearing his explanation, brilliant lights flashed through both of their eyes.
"Boss Faustus actually obtained treasures this extraordinary?"
James grinned.
"Of course I’m going to charge into the fifth floor with you, Boss. I’d love to find out just what a peak Divine-grade opponent is really made of."
"Together," Mosi said, still as cold and taciturn as ever.
Seeing the intense fighting spirit in the eyes of his two teammates, Daniel nodded slightly.
With the two scrolls as their trump cards, their chances of defeating the guardian were not small.
Even if victory proved impossible, they could still voluntarily give up the challenge.
The peak Divine-grade guardian was many times stronger than a high Divine-grade opponent. There would be nothing shameful about abandoning the challenge if they found themselves unable to proceed.
Simply by possessing the courage to face the fifth floor head-on, the three of them had already left every other nine-star powerhouse far behind.

"If we step onto the fifth floor, we’ll probably scare every powerhouse watching out of their wits," James said with a smile. "Other than us, it’ll probably be very difficult to find a second team bold enough to continue challenging the tower."
Daniel smiled and nodded.
He knew full well that without those two scrolls, he would never have entertained such an insane idea.
"Let’s go."
Once the three of them had made their decision, their figures instantly disappeared from the fourth floor.
Inside the Spirit Tower.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Daniel, James, and Mosi appeared simultaneously on the fifth floor of the Spirit Tower.
Outside the viewing arena, there was first a moment of absolute silence.
Then, an earth-shaking uproar erupted!
"They... they really dared to do it!"
Silas of the Viridis starfield stared blankly at the sight before him.
In the projection, Daniel and the other two had indeed stepped onto the fifth floor.

Just as every other nine-star powerhouse had withdrawn from the Spirit Tower and prepared to welcome the advancement ranking round, the three nine-star powerhouses of the Canaan starfield had actually dared to challenge the peak Divine-grade guardian of the fifth floor.
That was a peak Divine-grade opponent!
"By the Creator God, they really went to the fifth floor!"
The spectators were so shocked that they could barely speak coherently.
"Every single time Faustus makes a move, he does something completely unexpected!"
"Holy shit! I suddenly have this urge to become one of his followers."
"This is ridiculous. I almost want to cheer for him... even though he literally just tricked us not long ago."
A contestant who had previously been trapped in Warzone 1 wore an incredibly conflicted expression, his voice filled with inner struggle.
"Faustus, you’ve surprised me yet again."
Harris’s expression was livid, each word forced through clenched teeth.
Faustus seemed to have become an insurmountable mountain that fate had placed directly in his path. Every time they crossed paths, he would be firmly suppressed by the other party.
That mountain known as Faustus loomed before him, seemingly impossible to ever climb over.
"How dare they set foot on the fifth floor?!"
Udi stared fixedly at the figures in the projection, his voice filled with furious disbelief.
"These powerhouses from the Canaan starfield are truly bold. They’ve certainly broadened my horizons."
A playful gleam appeared in Julian’s eyes, and the corners of his lips curved into a meaningful smile, as though he were savoring the anticipation of a magnificent show about to begin.
In this tournament, only the Samuel starfield and the Canaan starfield possessed three nine-star powerhouses each on the surface. Naturally, the two sides had been compared again and again.
However, ever since the warm-up round, the Samuel starfield had been powerfully suppressed by the Canaan starfield, leaving far too much resentment in their hearts.

Yet now, the nine-star powerhouses from the Canaan starfield actually dared to form a team and challenge the guardian of the fifth floor. That courage alone was enough to make everyone see them in an entirely new light.
However—
None of them believed Daniel and the others could actually succeed.
Chanelle nodded slightly.
"No matter what happens, at this moment, the three of you have truly stood at the summit of the starry sea."
"At the very least, in terms of momentum, you have already surpassed every other contestant."
"Enjoy it to your hearts’ content!"

paragraphs: The fifth floor of the Spirit Tower.
Whoosh!
The instant Daniel appeared, he immediately used the [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium]!
[Notice: You have used the [Scroll of Forced Equilibrium]! The target’s current sage-rank might has been forcibly suppressed from [Peak Divine-grade] to [Divine Domain-level]!]
The guardian’s sage-rank might plummeted as though it had fallen from a sheer cliff!
Daniel did not dare waste even half a second. He instantly summoned his clones and unfolded his Divine Domain.
James and Mosi simultaneously unleashed their own Divine Domains as well. With all three Divine Domains working together, they firmly suppressed the guardian of the fifth floor.
The guardian of the fifth floor was astonishingly a golden puppet—
A peak Divine-grade puppet!
At this moment, it was still immersed in the shock of its sage-rank might suddenly plummeting, unable to recover its senses.
The Divine Domains of the three nine-star powerhouses had already descended with overwhelming force, firmly pinning down its weakened sage-rank might!
Outside the viewing arena, cries of astonishment erupted one after another.
"Divine Domain suppression! They actually achieved Divine Domain suppression!"
"There’s no need to guess. They must have used some kind of secret treasure. Otherwise, there is absolutely no way they could have suppressed its sage-rank might!"
"Although its sage-rank might has been suppressed, the guardian’s inherent strength is still terrifying beyond belief."
"If their damage output can reach the level of a full-force strike from a high Divine-grade powerhouse, they might be able to slowly wear the guardian down."
"The Canaan Team consists entirely of demi-sages. Where are they supposed to find the destructive power of a high Divine-grade powerhouse?"
"In this battle... I’m afraid the three members of the Canaan Team are destined to lose."
At this moment, every spectator held their breath, staring fixedly at the projection.
"Starburst Scroll."

[Notice: You have used the [Starburst Scroll]! When using yourself as the catalyst for self-destruction, the power of the explosion will reach the level of an ultimate strike from a peak Divine-grade powerhouse!]
Whoosh! Whoosh!
A purple radiance enveloped Daniel’s true body.
His clones were perfectly synchronized with his true body. All ninety-nine clones began glowing with a dim, eerie purple light at the same time.
"Charge!"
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Daniel’s ninety-nine clones simultaneously charged toward the golden puppet.
Only an instant had passed since the three of them entered the fifth floor.
The golden puppet blankly stared at the swarm of clones rushing toward it, a hint of disdain flashing through its eyes.
Although it had been caught off guard at the beginning and its sage-rank might had fallen to Divine Domain-level, its own inherent strength had not been affected in the slightest.
These challengers were merely at the demi-sage rank.
No matter how powerful a demi-sage might be, they could never possibly be its opponents!
It immediately executed a combat technique and launched an overpowering attack.
"Die!"
Even a casual strike from the golden puppet carried lingering traces of the Laws. Its power was terrifying beyond imagination.
"You demi-sage ants, all of you can die together!"
However, Daniel’s clones had never intended to survive in the first place.
In fact, they had never even intended to approach the golden puppet directly.
As long as the power was sufficient, there was no need for physical contact to inflict fatal damage.
"Explode!!!"
Explode!
Boom!
Rumble!
Daniel’s clones began self-destructing one after another.
Under the enhancement of the Starburst Scroll, each and every self-destruction reached the level of an ultimate strike from a peak Divine-grade powerhouse.
Rumble!

Every explosion shook the surrounding space violently. Even the incomparably stable space of the Realm of the Holy Spirit began to tremble, as countless dense cracks spread outward like a gigantic spiderweb.
Boom!
As Daniel’s clones continued to explode one after another, the surrounding space finally became unable to endure the strain and began to shatter!
Rumble!
The space surrounding the golden puppet shattered completely!
The golden puppet was utterly dumbfounded.
The bone-piercing pain and the tidal wave of overwhelming damage battered it senseless, yet it had no way to respond.
Its sage-rank might was being firmly suppressed. Like a trapped beast struggling within a cage, it could no longer mobilize even the slightest fraction of that power.
Boom!

Daniel’s clones continued to self-destruct in succession. Attacks that were almost equivalent to the ultimate strikes of beings at the same level exploded against the golden puppet like successive thunderbolts, leaving behind fatal injuries.
Boom!
The Origin Core within the golden puppet had already begun to fracture.
Its body was covered in spiderweb-like cracks and blackened scorch marks!
Rumble...
At last, the deafening roar of self-destruction abruptly came to an end.
"Is it... finally over?"
The golden puppet was on the verge of death. A trace of relief appeared within its shattered eyes.
No!
That was not right!
Under its dumbfounded gaze, Daniel’s true body transformed into a dazzling streak of light. Like a falling meteor, he shot directly toward the golden puppet!
Outside the viewing arena, every powerhouse involuntarily rose to their feet.

The ordinary spectators were left slack-jawed. The nine-star powerhouses were shaken to their very souls. Even the Oracle-grade powerhouses from the major starfields could no longer conceal their shock.
"What... what is happening?"
"Is Faustus going to self-destruct his true body?"
The spectators’ minds were filled with questions.
Self-destructing his clones was already an act of utter madness.
But self-destructing his true body?
Was that not simply courting death?
"My horizons were still too narrow! This isn’t merely playing big anymore—he’s trying to blast a hole through the heavens!"
"Faustus... is he committing suicide?"
The nine-star powerhouses were completely stunned.
"Faustus is going to self-destruct his true body too? What kind of joke is this?!"
Harris’s eyes widened, his face filled with disbelief.
For the first time, he felt like a complete fool.
"Could it be... that Faustus’s true body can also return from the dead?"
Silas frowned deeply, unable to comprehend what he was seeing.
Udi’s mind trembled violently. As he stared at the figure in the projection charging fearlessly toward the golden puppet, he found himself unable to say a single word.
"Marcus... is ultimately inferior to Faustus."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from the Alba starfield sighed emotionally. In the end, he had finally accepted reality.
"Far too powerful... This fellow is truly terrifying!"
The powerhouses from the Samuel starfield were filled with envy and apprehension.
"This brat... as long as he does not die, he is bound to become an Oracle-grade powerhouse in the future."
A brilliant light rippled through Chanelle’s eyes. In his heart, he had already made his decision.
This human brat was under his protection from now on!
Daniel charged toward the golden puppet.
"Die—!"
He roared furiously, and his entire body exploded with a deafening boom.
A world-destroying surge of energy erupted like a volcano, once again swallowing the golden puppet completely.
At the same time, James and Mosi unleashed the strongest battle power they possessed, sending attack after attack crashing down upon the golden puppet like a violent storm.
Whoosh!
At the exact instant Daniel self-destructed, his figure unexpectedly reappeared.
Immortal Revival!
Whoosh! Whoosh!
He once again summoned his clones.
However, this time, the empowerment of the Starburst Scroll had already been exhausted, while the effective duration of the Scroll of Forced Equilibrium was also about to expire.
"Now, face your end!"
Leading his clones, Daniel launched the final ferocious assault upon the golden puppet.
Almost at the exact instant the effect of the Scroll of Forced Equilibrium disappeared—
Boom!!!
The golden puppet, the peak Divine-grade guardian of the fifth floor, crashed thunderously to the ground.
[Ding! You have slain the guardian of the fifth floor of the Spirit Tower.]
Beside the fallen golden puppet, a purple-gold treasure chest glittered brilliantly.
Huff... Huff... Huff...!
The moment the guardian collapsed, Daniel, James, and Mosi floated in midair, gasping for breath without pause.
"That was seriously insane, Boss..."
James smiled lazily and bared his teeth.
"Following Boss Faustus means every single operation feels like dancing on the edge of a blade."
"Agreed," Mosi echoed coldly.
Daniel burst out laughing.
"I can’t help it. Even when I want to keep a low profile, I just can’t manage it. Honestly, I never intended to show off..."

"This time, I’m afraid every contestant watching must have been scared senseless," James said smugly. "We challenged the guardian of the fifth floor and actually won. The other nine-star powerhouses couldn’t have been frightened out of their minds, could they? Hahaha..."
Outside the viewing arena, the spectators only now understood what had happened.
Faustus could actually resurrect after death!
"By the Creator God! That fellow is utterly insane!"
The spectators shook their heads with rueful laughter, before suddenly coming back to their senses.
"Wait! Doesn’t that mean only the Canaan Team has reached the fifth floor? They’re in a league of their own now!"
"I can hardly imagine how terrifying it must feel to become Faustus’s enemy. Fortunately, I’ll never have the privilege. I’d probably die far too easily..."
"I’ll stop pretending! From this day onward, I’m a die-hard follower of Faustus!"
"Follower plus one! Even though he tricked me before, somehow... being tricked by him actually feels kind of glorious."
"Exactly! Faustus and the rest of us once fought side by side, after all!"
"The Canaan Team... actually succeeded!"
The members of the Samuel Team revealed genuine admiration on their faces.
Even though they might become opponents during the advancement round in the future, that did not prevent them from appreciating an enemy like this.
An opponent like this was worthy of respect!
"Too powerful... Faustus is completely monstrous!"
The Hunter Team was genuinely shaken by Daniel’s individual combat strength.
"I truly have no idea how we’re supposed to face Faustus if we encounter him in the advancement round."
The powerhouses of the Bloodthirst Team exchanged glances, faint unease rising in their hearts.
"Hahaha... Excellent. Truly excellent!"
A delighted smile appeared on Chanelle’s face. At this moment, he felt incomparably pleased.
His gaze swept, seemingly unintentionally, across the gathered Oracle-grade powerhouses.
The smile tugging at the corners of his mouth simply could not be suppressed!

chapters.title: Chapter 288 -288-Panacea of All-Devouring Transmutation, Top of the Rankings
paragraphs: Urged on by James and Mosi, Daniel bent down and picked up the spoils.
The instant his fingertips brushed against the treasure chest, a warm current seeped out through the gap in its lid.
He swiftly flipped it open.
[Ding! You have obtained the special potion [Panacea of All-Devouring Transmutation] (Divine-grade)!]
"A potion? It’s actually a potion?"
The corners of Daniel’s lips lifted, and a gleam flashed through his eyes.
To him, potions had always been the most worthwhile kind of treasure.
He possessed the power of the Eternal Ring. Any enhancement granted by a potion could be transformed into a permanent blessing.
The rarer and more supreme the potion, the more priceless it became in his hands!
His gaze settled on the sacred potion emitting a faint, mysterious glow.
[Panacea of All-Devouring Transmutation] (Divine-grade)
Requirement: Supreme-grade
Effect: Upon consumption, grants your [Divine Domain] the [Devour] trait.

[Devour]: Allows your Domain to devour any type of [Domain] in existence. After devouring it, the absorbed Domain will automatically be transformed into nourishment for your own, causing your Domain to grow increasingly powerful.

Note: The effectiveness of Devour depends on the target’s strength. The Domain of a weaker opponent may be consumed in an instant, while that of a stronger foe must be devoured gradually. Attempting to devour an overly powerful Domain may even result in backlash!
Duration: 5 minutes
Description: Devour all things to nourish oneself. No Domain is beyond consumption; no boundary is beyond assimilation.
After reading through the potion’s effects, Daniel tilted his head back and drank the sacred potion in one gulp.
The warm liquid slid down his throat, spreading through his chest like a silent flame.
[Ding! You have used [Panacea of All-Devouring Transmutation] (Divine-grade)!]
[Notification: A new enhancement has been added to your status bar. Please check the details yourself.]
He could not be bothered to look.
After all, under the effect of the Eternal Ring, the enhancement that should have lasted only a limited amount of time had already become permanent.
"This potion is absolutely heaven-defying."
Daniel pondered silently.
"To devour other people’s Domains and use them to strengthen my own, without any apparent upper limit... This is outrageously powerful!"
He could already imagine the scene.
The moment he unleashed his Divine Domain, it would tear into his opponents’ Divine Domains and devour them in only a few bites.
While strengthening himself, he would simultaneously weaken his enemies.
Just imagining such a scene was enough to set his heart racing.
"Still... I took both the treasure chests from the fourth and fifth floors. I can’t help feeling a little guilty about it."
Daniel took out the two Spatial Transfer Scrolls he had obtained on the first and second floors, then handed them to James and Mosi.
"These are compensation for the two of you."
Watching the pair accept the Spatial Transfer Scrolls, Daniel immediately felt much more at ease.
Truthfully, Spatial Transfer Scrolls were not all that useful to him.
They were exceptional life-saving treasures, exceedingly rare and valuable.
But Daniel was confident that there would probably never come a day when he needed to flee for his life!
"Run away? Not happening."
A faint smile tugged at his lips.
At last, Team Canaan emerged from the Spirit Tower.
The instant they stepped through the vortex gate, thunderous cheers and applause erupted across the viewing arena like a tidal wave.

Although every competitor was fighting for their respective starfield, making them enemies of one another, true power would earn respect under any circumstances—even when that power belonged to an opponent!
It was reverence for strength.
What they respected was not merely the other side, but a spirit. A belief.
Besides, Daniel and his teammates deserved such respect.
Once the matches resumed, everyone would fight to the death when necessary.
Even dying for the sake of the living beings of one’s own starfield would still earn the respect of one’s opponents.
The greatest respect one could show an opponent was to use every ounce of one’s strength to defeat them—even to kill them!
Daniel and the other two returned to the seating area belonging to Canaan starfield.
Oracle-grade Chanelle greeted them with a smile.
"You performed very well in this match!"
Daniel and the others returned the greeting before taking their seats beneath the watchful gazes of their more than twenty companions.
With that, the elimination round officially came to an end.
Next came the advancement round!
At that moment, the projected images in the void abruptly disappeared. In their place, a ranking list slowly appeared.
Daniel raised his head and looked at it.
[Starlight Combat Power Rankings]
First Place: [Faustus] (Canaan starfield)—Nine Stars!
Second Place: [James] (Canaan starfield)—Nine Stars!
Third Place: [Mosi] (Canaan starfield)—Nine Stars!
Fourth Place: [Harris] (Aurora starfield)—Nine Stars!
Fifth Place: [Flora] (Samuel starfield)—Nine Stars!
Sixth Place: [Julian] (Samuel starfield)—Nine Stars!
Seventh Place: [Udi] (Copper starfield)—Nine Stars!
Eighth Place: [Elysi] (Samuel starfield)—Nine Stars!
Ninth Place: [Eris] (Lumina starfield)—Nine Stars!
Tenth Place: [White Wolf] (Alba starfield)—Nine Stars!
Eleventh Place: [Cold Star] (Aetno starfield)—Nine Stars!
Twelfth Place: [Igor] (Maritim starfield)—Nine Stars!
Thirteenth Place: [Silas] (Viridis starfield)—Nine Stars!
Fourteenth Place: [Marcus] (Vesta starfield)—Eight Stars!
After reading the ranking list, Daniel’s expression remained unchanged.
Meanwhile, countless gazes, whether deliberate or otherwise, fell upon him.
"Faustus taking first place is indisputable!"
"I can just about understand James and Mosi ranking in the top three as well."
"But Harris actually took fourth place... In my opinion, Flora might be even stronger than him."

"It’s hard to say how Flora compares in other aspects, but her ability in a one-on-one fight is nothing short of astonishing. This ranking was determined by their overall performance throughout the entire elimination round, so there’s no questioning its authority. Still, when it comes to the sheer brilliance of killing an opponent in a single strike, I’m afraid no one can match Flora."
"Damn, these rankings are making me itch with curiosity... I really want to see Flora and Harris go all out against each other. Now that would be exciting!"
"Exactly. Rankings are ultimately only numbers on paper. Who is truly stronger can only be decided in the arena."
The spectators discussed the rankings animatedly.
Just then, the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield appeared once again.
His appearance meant that the elimination round had officially concluded!
The advancement round, the stage that made everyone’s blood boil and filled them with the greatest anticipation, was about to begin.
The advancement round was the true heart of the tournament!
"The elimination round has concluded."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse’s voice reverberated throughout the entire arena.
"Thank you to all of the competitors for presenting us with such spectacular battles."
"And now, for the latest news—this Starlight Tournament has already attracted the attention of the outer universes."
Boom!
The spectator stands instantly erupted into an uproar.
This tournament was already a universe-level grand event. No one had expected it to draw the attention of powers from the outer universes as well!
Perhaps, by the time it ended, this tournament would rise into a grand event of the Endless Starsea itself!
The Oracle-grade powerhouse paused for a moment before suddenly smiling.
"The highly anticipated advancement round will begin tomorrow. However, the twenty experts who advanced today must first draw their respective opponents."
"The advancement round will consist of one-on-one matches. The first round will determine the top ten. As for the format of the second round, it will be announced when the time comes!"
"Now, competitors in the advancement round, please draw your opponents at random according to your order on the Combat Power Rankings."
After the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield finished speaking, his gaze turned in the direction of Canaan starfield.
"Faustus stands at the top of the rankings, so you will be the first to draw."
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Every spectator’s gaze instantly converged upon Daniel.
Those gazes contained anticipation, excitement, and fear.
Among the twenty experts who had advanced, quite a few secretly dreaded the possibility of being drawn as Faustus’s opponent.
"May the God of Creation protect me. I truly don’t want to face Faustus."
Marcus’s expression was ugly, his eyes filled with dread.
"Ancestors, please bless me. Please don’t let Faustus draw my name."
Another expert muttered prayers under his breath.
"Faustus..."
Harris stared at Daniel, his heart tangled with conflicting emotions.
For some reason, he longed to fight Faustus and experience an ultimate showdown against him, yet deep inside, he could not suppress a faint trace of unease!
Could it be that he had already grown afraid before even properly confronting Faustus?
Harris’s expression hardened.
"No!"
"Even if I die, I will die standing!"

Daniel took out the two Spatial Transfer Scrolls he had obtained on the first and second floors, then handed them to James and Mosi.
"These are compensation for the two of you."
Watching the pair accept the Spatial Transfer Scrolls, Daniel immediately felt much more at ease.
Truthfully, Spatial Transfer Scrolls were not all that useful to him.
They were exceptional life-saving treasures, exceedingly rare and valuable.
But Daniel was confident that there would probably never come a day when he needed to flee for his life!
"Run away?
Not happening."
A faint smile tugged at his lips.
At last, Team Canaan emerged from the Spirit Tower.
The instant they stepped through the vortex gate, thunderous cheers and applause erupted across the viewing arena like a tidal wave.

Although every competitor was fighting for their respective starfield, making them enemies of one another, true power would earn respect under any circumstances—even when that power belonged to an opponent!
It was reverence for strength.
What they respected was not merely the other side, but a spirit.
A belief.
Besides, Daniel and his teammates deserved such respect.
Once the matches resumed, everyone would fight to the death when necessary.
Even dying for the sake of the living beings of one’s own starfield would still earn the respect of one’s opponents.
The greatest respect one could show an opponent was to use every ounce of one’s strength to defeat them—even to kill them!
Daniel and the other two returned to the seating area belonging to Canaan starfield.
Oracle-grade Chanelle greeted them with a smile.
"You performed very well in this match!"
Daniel and the others returned the greeting before taking their seats beneath the watchful gazes of their more than twenty companions.
With that, the elimination round officially came to an end.
Next came the advancement round!
At that moment, the projected images in the void abruptly disappeared.
In their place, a ranking list slowly appeared.
Daniel raised his head and looked at it.
[Starlight Combat Power Rankings]
First Place: [Faustus] (Canaan starfield)—Nine Stars!
Second Place: [James] (Canaan starfield)—Nine Stars!
Third Place: [Mosi] (Canaan starfield)—Nine Stars!
Fourth Place: [Harris] (Aurora starfield)—Nine Stars!
Fifth Place: [Flora] (Samuel starfield)—Nine Stars!
Sixth Place: [Julian] (Samuel starfield)—Nine Stars!
Seventh Place: [Udi] (Copper starfield)—Nine Stars!
Eighth Place: [Elysi] (Samuel starfield)—Nine Stars!
Ninth Place: [Eris] (Lumina starfield)—Nine Stars!
Tenth Place: [White Wolf] (Alba starfield)—Nine Stars!
Eleventh Place: [Cold Star] (Aetno starfield)—Nine Stars!
Twelfth Place: [Igor] (Maritim starfield)—Nine Stars!
Thirteenth Place: [Silas] (Viridis starfield)—Nine Stars!
Fourteenth Place: [Marcus] (Vesta starfield)—Eight Stars!
After reading the ranking list, Daniel’s expression remained unchanged.
Meanwhile, countless gazes, whether deliberate or otherwise, fell upon him.
"Faustus taking first place is indisputable!"
"I can just about understand James and Mosi ranking in the top three as well."
"But Harris actually took fourth place...
In my opinion, Flora might be even stronger than him."
"It’s hard to say how Flora compares in other aspects, but her ability in a one-on-one fight is nothing short of astonishing.
This ranking was determined by their overall performance throughout the entire elimination round, so there’s no questioning its authority.
Still, when it comes to the sheer brilliance of killing an opponent in a single strike, I’m afraid no one can match Flora."
"Damn, these rankings are making me itch with curiosity...
I really want to see Flora and Harris go all out against each other.
Now that would be exciting!"
"Exactly.
Rankings are ultimately only numbers on paper.
Who is truly stronger can only be decided in the arena."
The spectators discussed the rankings animatedly.
Just then, the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield appeared once again.
His appearance meant that the elimination round had officially concluded!
The advancement round, the stage that made everyone’s blood boil and filled them with the greatest anticipation, was about to begin.
The advancement round was the true heart of the tournament!
"The elimination round has concluded."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse’s voice reverberated throughout the entire arena.
"Thank you to all of the competitors for presenting us with such spectacular battles."
"And now, for the latest news—this Starlight Tournament has already attracted the attention of the outer universes."
Boom!
The spectator stands instantly erupted into an uproar.
This tournament was already a universe-level grand event.
No one had expected it to draw the attention of powers from the outer universes as well!
Perhaps, by the time it ended, this tournament would rise into a grand event of the Endless Starsea itself!
The Oracle-grade powerhouse paused for a moment before suddenly smiling.
"The highly anticipated advancement round will begin tomorrow.
However, the twenty experts who advanced today must first draw their respective opponents."
"The advancement round will consist of one-on-one matches.
The first round will determine the top ten.
As for the format of the second round, it will be announced when the time comes!"
"Now, competitors in the advancement round, please draw your opponents at random according to your order on the Combat Power Rankings."
After the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield finished speaking, his gaze turned in the direction of Canaan starfield.
"Faustus stands at the top of the rankings, so you will be the first to draw."
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Every spectator’s gaze instantly converged upon Daniel.
Those gazes contained anticipation, excitement, and fear.
Among the twenty experts who had advanced, quite a few secretly dreaded the possibility of being drawn as Faustus’s opponent.
"May the God of Creation protect me.
I truly don’t want to face Faustus."
Marcus’s expression was ugly, his eyes filled with dread.
"Ancestors, please bless me.
Please don’t let Faustus draw my name."
Another expert muttered prayers under his breath.
"Faustus..."
Harris stared at Daniel, his heart tangled with conflicting emotions.
For some reason, he longed to fight Faustus and experience an ultimate showdown against him, yet deep inside, he could not suppress a faint trace of unease!
Could it be that he had already grown afraid before even properly confronting Faustus?
Harris’s expression hardened.
"No!"
"Even if I die, I will die standing!"

chapters.title: Chapter 289 -289-A Brazen Declaration of War, Making Enemies of the Entire Arena
paragraphs: Daniel rose to his feet and flew toward the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield, reaching out to draw his opponent.
"Oh! The result is out!"
"Faustus’s opponent is..."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse glanced at the number in Daniel’s hand before turning toward the seating area of Samuel starfield with an amused smile.
Every spectator immediately followed his gaze.
Faustus’s opponent would be one of Samuel starfield’s experts!
Julian inexplicably grew nervous, every hair on his body standing on end.
Flora lowered her head, her body trembling slightly. No one could tell whether it was from excitement or fear.
Elysi, on the other hand, raised his head and looked expectantly toward Daniel, his blood boiling with anticipation!
"So soon? Canaan starfield and Samuel starfield are going to clash head-on already!?"
"The only question is, who will Faustus face? Which of Samuel starfield’s three nine-star experts will it be?"
"I hope it’s Flora. That would practically be like watching the finals in advance."
"Look at Elysi. He seems eager to test himself against Faustus."
"Elysi... To be honest, I’ve never been certain just how strong he truly is..."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse’s gaze abruptly locked onto Elysi.
"Canaan starfield’s Faustus versus Samuel starfield’s Elysi!"
"As Faustus holds first place in the rankings, his match in the advancement round will be scheduled as the final bout!"
Boom!
The spectator stands instantly erupted.
Faustus’s opponent in the very first round was actually Elysi!
Whoosh!
Elysi suddenly sprang to his feet, both fists clenched tightly as his blade-like gaze fixed firmly on Daniel.
Faustus!
You made my life absolutely miserable in Battle Zone One.
In the advancement round, we will settle every score between us in a single battle!
Daniel lazily swept his gaze across Elysi before indifferently withdrawing it, the corner of his mouth curling ever so slightly.
Elysi?
Heh.
A playful smile surfaced on the face of the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield. Suddenly, he called out in a loud voice.
"Faustus, is there anything you would like to say to Elysi?"
Whoosh!
The audience instantly boiled over with excitement.
"This is about to stir up a storm!"
"In the name of the God of Creation, is this the moment when they exchange declarations of challenge? I can hardly wait!"
"In my opinion, Lord Faustus probably cannot even be bothered to speak for Elysi’s sake. Elysi? Is he even worthy of having Faustus address him?"
However, before Daniel could say anything, Elysi had already seized the initiative and roared aloud.
"I, Elysi, have never been one for empty words! Faustus, come at me with everything you have—I, Elysi, am no easy prey!"
Whoa!
The entire arena erupted into an uproar.
Many experts suddenly viewed Elysi in a new light.
This fellow was rather fearless!
Had he always been like this?
The competitors from Samuel starfield, however, looked utterly unsurprised, as though they had long since grown accustomed to Elysi’s flamboyant behavior.
"It’s just... I still preferred the low-profile Elysi from before..."
Previously, Elysi had always concealed his true strength, appearing before everyone as an eight-star expert.
Samuel starfield had hidden him exceedingly well, like a sharp blade sealed away within its sheath. The various starfields had always been unclear about his true level of power.

Yet now, Elysi showed no fear of Faustus whatsoever. He had even publicly thrown down the gauntlet, causing every expert present to look at him in an entirely new light and develop a certain degree of anticipation.
Could this fellow truly have some hidden trump card up his sleeve?
Faced with Elysi’s arrogant declaration, Daniel could not even be bothered to lift an eyelid. He calmly flew back to Canaan starfield’s viewing area.
His contempt for Elysi was like casually brushing a fallen leaf from his shoulder. Elysi was not worth wasting words on.
That attitude alone was the perfect response, instantly infuriating Elysi so badly that his expression turned ashen and a smoldering rage lodged in his chest.
"Next, James of Canaan starfield will come forward to draw his opponent."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield turned his gaze toward James.
James slowly walked onto the stage and reached out to draw a numbered token. The moment he saw it, his heart sank.
"God of Creation above... What kind of luck is this...?"
He groaned inwardly, utterly miserable.
"I actually drew her."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield announced in a resounding voice that echoed throughout the arena.
"Canaan starfield’s James will face—Flora!"
Whoa!
The competitors from Samuel starfield and Canaan starfield were both stunned into silence.
The competitors from the other starfields, on the other hand, grinned so widely they could barely close their mouths, inwardly bursting with delight.
"Hahaha! Samuel and Canaan really are evenly matched!"
"Faustus against Elysi, James against Flora... If Mosi ends up matched against Julian as well, that would be absolutely perfect!"
"That’s what they get for each having three nine-star experts! Of course they were bound to crash into each other!"
"These are pinnacle-level duels! This round is going to be unbelievably thrilling!"
"I can’t wait! I absolutely cannot wait!"
"James, do you have anything you would like to say?"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield asked with a beaming smile.
"No!"
James replied irritably, his heart filled with annoyance.
His luck was rotten beyond belief. Of all the people he could have drawn, he had somehow ended up facing Flora.
What terrible luck!
The Oracle-grade powerhouse watched as James walked off the stage in frustration, then shifted his gaze toward Mosi.
"Next, it is Canaan starfield’s Mosi’s turn to come forward and draw his opponent."
Whoosh! Whoosh!
This time, the gazes of every spectator surged toward Samuel starfield like a tidal wave.
If Mosi’s opponent turned out to be Julian, it would be a stroke of absolute genius!
Expressionless, Mosi walked onto the stage. Even after the result of the draw appeared, his face remained as cold and indifferent as frost.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield loudly announced the result.
"Canaan starfield’s Mosi will face—Eris!"
Mosi was ranked third, while Eris of Lumina starfield was ranked ninth.
The moment the identity of his opponent was announced, disappointment inevitably appeared on the spectators’ faces.
"It’s actually not Julian? That won’t do!"
"Eris against Mosi... I suppose that pairing is still somewhat interesting."
"I think Mosi only received such a high evaluation because he rode on the coattails of his teammates. It’s difficult to say how strong he actually is, so my bet is on Eris to win..."
"Mosi, do you have anything to say?"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield asked.
Mosi glanced at him before slowly shaking his head.
Making threatening declarations before a match was far too unlike him!
Next, Harris, who ranked fourth, stepped forward to draw his opponent.
When the result was revealed, his opponent turned out to be Julian!
The audience immediately erupted in shock.
Harris was ranked fourth, while Julian was ranked sixth. Their positions were extremely close, and in the eyes of the crowd, their strength should also be roughly equal.
"Julian versus Harris! This pairing is simply perfect!"
"One is known as the Uncounterable Blade, while the other hails from the number one race beneath the starry skies—what kind of ultimate showdown is this!?"
"A clash between two fighters at the absolute pinnacle! There is no better match than this!"
When the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield asked Harris whether he had anything to say, Harris instead turned toward Canaan starfield’s seating area.
"My opponent..."
He abruptly extended a finger and pointed directly toward Daniel, his gaze burning with intensity.
"Is him, and him alone—Faustus!"
Boom!
The spectators erupted into an uproar once again, the waves of noise rising like a surging tide.
Good heavens, was he implying that Julian was not even worthy of being his opponent?
Just how arrogant did a person have to be to say something like that!?
The competitors from Samuel starfield were even more enraged.
What was the meaning of this? Was Faustus the only person Harris saw as an opponent?
"And here I thought Harris carried himself with the dignity of a true expert. So this is all he amounts to."
"Julian, beat that Harris to a pulp tomorrow!"
"How unbelievably arrogant! Just you wait, Harris!"
Harris paid no attention whatsoever to the fury of Samuel starfield’s competitors and continued speaking.
"Faustus, I will be waiting for you in the finals!"
Whoa!
At this point, it was no longer merely Samuel starfield that Harris was disregarding.
He was looking down upon every single nine-star expert present—with the sole exception of Faustus!
Daniel looked at Harris on the stage and merely smiled faintly.
Yet deep within his eyes, a trace of battle intent quietly emerged.
"The number one race beneath the starry skies?"
He murmured inwardly.
"Now that sounds somewhat interesting."
