chapters.title: Chapter 290 -290-Clearstone, a Visitor from Beyond the Universe
paragraphs: The drawings for the advancement round continued.
Udi of Copper starfield was matched against Marcus, the eight-star expert from Vesta starfield.
His luck immediately drew the envy of most of the competitors.
A nine-star expert against an eight-star expert—this was practically no more difficult than a warm-up match!
"Udi practically picked up a massive bargain this round."
"That luck of his must have been blessed by the Goddess of Fortune herself!"
"Facing a mere eight-star opponent, Udi will probably pass this round without even breaking a sweat."
Immediately afterward, White Wolf of Alba starfield, who ranked tenth on the Combat Power Rankings, was matched against Silas of Viridis starfield, who ranked thirteenth.
Although this was likewise a pinnacle clash between two nine-star experts, the spectators generally favored White Wolf.
"Back when White Wolf’s name already shook the four directions, Silas probably hadn’t even stepped through the Gate of Divinity yet."
"In terms of foundation and renown, White Wolf is indeed a level above him."
"That may be true, but nothing in this world is absolute. How many years has it been since Faustus suddenly appeared out of nowhere? Who would dare claim that White Wolf is stronger than Faustus?"
Meanwhile, Cold Star of Aetno starfield, ranked eleventh, was matched against Igor of Maritim starfield, who ranked twelfth.
Yet another battle between two nine-star experts!
The first round of the advancement stage followed a one-on-one elimination format, which meant that only ten participants could advance.
However, there were fewer than twenty nine-star experts in total, meaning the eight-star experts also had an opportunity to fight their way into the top ten of the rankings.
That was precisely the significance of this tournament.
Reaching the top ten alone was already an excellent result. The various starfields would divide their benefits according to their final rankings.
As for an eight-star expert advancing while a nine-star expert was eliminated?
All that could be said was that, sometimes, luck was also a part of one’s strength!
Once every competitor had finished drawing their opponent, the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield announced in a resounding voice,
"Participants of the advancement round, please return and rest. The advancement round will officially begin tomorrow."
Under Oracle-grade Chanelle’s leadership, Daniel returned with the others to their resting quarters.
The moment he stepped into his room, a system notification rang out.
[Ding! Congratulations on perfectly completing your mission and successfully obtaining a qualification for the advancement round.]
[Notification: You have obtained one [Divine-grade Treasure Chest].]
Daniel retrieved the treasure chest from his backpack space. With a light touch of his fingertips, the lid opened in response.
[Ding! You have obtained the special Holy Relic [Clearstone] (Divine-grade)!]
Daniel held the Holy Relic in his palm. A vast yet soothing wave of Strength surged through his fingertips and poured into his bloodline.
[Clearstone] (Divine-grade)
Requirement: Supreme-grade
Effect: Once equipped, grants immunity to all [Laws of Illusion] and [Laws of Lust] below Oracle-grade, permanently stabilizing your [Mental State]!

Record: The Laws of Illusion are strange, elusive, and exceedingly difficult to defend against. The [Laws of Lust], which stand shoulder to shoulder with the Laws of Illusion, are equally impossible to guard against. Once this Holy Relic is equipped, its wearer shall have nothing to fear when facing either of these two great Laws, for their Mental State shall remain as unshakable as a boulder.
A sharp gleam flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
This item was anything but ordinary!
Without hesitation, he equipped Clearstone upon his chest. At once, a clear and refreshing Strength washed through his mind like a spring, purifying his thoughts.
Just then—
[Ding! You have received a new mission: [Starlight Tournament · 3]. Please check it in time.]
[Notification: A new mission has been added to your mission panel. Please check the details yourself.]
Daniel immediately opened his mission panel.
[Starlight Tournament · 3] (Special)
Restriction: Faustus
Requirement: Participate throughout the entire event
Objective: Obtain a qualification for the [Second Round of the Advancement Stage]

Record: Emerge victorious in the first round of the advancement stage, and you shall step onto the battlefield of the second round. Crush every enemy who seeks to block your coronation, and climb to the summit!
Time Limit: Long-term
Reward: [Mysterious Holy Relic (Divine-grade)]
Daniel closed the mission panel, the corner of his mouth curving upward.
"Another Divine-grade reward. This tournament is turning out to be quite profitable!"
He smiled faintly, battle intent reflecting deep within his eyes.
The following day, the advancement round began.
Chanelle led every competitor from Canaan starfield into the arena.
The venue had changed completely from the day before.

Within the grand formation, the space had been divided into five separate sections. Each floated independently in the void, completely isolated from the others and incapable of interfering with one another.
Daniel sat in the viewing area, his expression indifferent.
According to the tournament schedule, his match had been arranged as the final battle. It was not yet his turn to take the stage.
At this moment, the competitors from every major starfield had already gathered.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield swept his gaze across the entire arena.

"The rules of the advancement round are clear and straightforward. The ten victors will automatically obtain qualifications for the second round of the advancement stage. The second round will continue tomorrow."
He raised his hand and pointed toward the five sections of isolated space behind him.
"Everyone, please look!"

"These are five arenas created specifically for this tournament. The competitors in the advancement round will take the stage in two batches. Each batch will consist of ten competitors, with all five matches taking place simultaneously."
"After the battles conclude, the Combat Power Rankings will be updated accordingly."
So those five separated spatial regions had been specially established for the advancement round.
Such an arrangement was efficient and direct, allowing the first round of matches to be completed rapidly.
Conquest starfield, Starvault Sanctum.
The fabric of space suddenly rippled, as though a stone had been tossed into the surface of a still lake.
A man dressed in long robes, his face covered in a thick beard, tore open a spatial rift and slowly stepped out.
His foot descended upon the void.
In the next instant, his figure vanished.
When he reappeared, he was already ten thousand miles away.
Starvault Sanctum.
The robed man abruptly appeared before the sacred hall.
The sanctuary guards immediately stepped forward to block his path and shouted sharply,
"Halt! State your identity!"
The robed man wore a gentle smile, and his voice was warm and courteous.

He immediately gave an order to those beside him.
"Invite in our distinguished guest from the outer universe."
"Dustin pays his respects to the Lord of the Sanctum."

"How many years has it been since you stepped into the transcendent realm?"
"Reporting to the Lord of the Sanctum, thirteen years in total."
Dustin smiled faintly.
"Hiss... This is truly outrageous!"

"Are you the expert sent by the Chaosverse to participate in my Starlight Tournament?"
"That is correct."

"I was fortunate enough to defeat all those of my generation in the Chaosverse. Although my strength is nothing remarkable, I still wished to visit your esteemed universe to learn and seek guidance."

sentences.text: The drawings for the advancement round continued.
Udi of Copper starfield was matched against Marcus, the eight-star expert from Vesta starfield.
His luck immediately drew the envy of most of the competitors.
A nine-star expert against an eight-star expert—this was practically no more difficult than a warm-up match!
"Udi practically picked up a massive bargain this round."
"That luck of his must have been blessed by the Goddess of Fortune herself!"
"Facing a mere eight-star opponent, Udi will probably pass this round without even breaking a sweat."
Immediately afterward, White Wolf of Alba starfield, who ranked tenth on the Combat Power Rankings, was matched against Silas of Viridis starfield, who ranked thirteenth.
Although this was likewise a pinnacle clash between two nine-star experts, the spectators generally favored White Wolf.
"Back when White Wolf’s name already shook the four directions, Silas probably hadn’t even stepped through the Gate of Divinity yet."
"In terms of foundation and renown, White Wolf is indeed a level above him."
"That may be true, but nothing in this world is absolute.
How many years has it been since Faustus suddenly appeared out of nowhere?
Who would dare claim that White Wolf is stronger than Faustus?"
Meanwhile, Cold Star of Aetno starfield, ranked eleventh, was matched against Igor of Maritim starfield, who ranked twelfth.
Yet another battle between two nine-star experts!
The first round of the advancement stage followed a one-on-one elimination format, which meant that only ten participants could advance.
However, there were fewer than twenty nine-star experts in total, meaning the eight-star experts also had an opportunity to fight their way into the top ten of the rankings.
That was precisely the significance of this tournament.
Reaching the top ten alone was already an excellent result.
The various starfields would divide their benefits according to their final rankings.
As for an eight-star expert advancing while a nine-star expert was eliminated?
All that could be said was that, sometimes, luck was also a part of one’s strength!
Once every competitor had finished drawing their opponent, the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield announced in a resounding voice,
"Participants of the advancement round, please return and rest.
The advancement round will officially begin tomorrow."
Under Oracle-grade Chanelle’s leadership, Daniel returned with the others to their resting quarters.
The moment he stepped into his room, a system notification rang out.
[Ding!
Congratulations on perfectly completing your mission and successfully obtaining a qualification for the advancement round.]
[Notification: You have obtained one [Divine-grade Treasure Chest].]
Daniel retrieved the treasure chest from his backpack space.
With a light touch of his fingertips, the lid opened in response.
[Ding!
You have obtained the special Holy Relic [Clearstone] (Divine-grade)!]
Daniel held the Holy Relic in his palm.
A vast yet soothing wave of Strength surged through his fingertips and poured into his bloodline.
[Clearstone] (Divine-grade)
Requirement: Supreme-grade
Effect: Once equipped, grants immunity to all [Laws of Illusion] and [Laws of Lust] below Oracle-grade, permanently stabilizing your [Mental State]!
Record: The Laws of Illusion are strange, elusive, and exceedingly difficult to defend against.
The [Laws of Lust], which stand shoulder to shoulder with the Laws of Illusion, are equally impossible to guard against.
Once this Holy Relic is equipped, its wearer shall have nothing to fear when facing either of these two great Laws, for their Mental State shall remain as unshakable as a boulder.
A sharp gleam flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
This item was anything but ordinary!
Without hesitation, he equipped Clearstone upon his chest.
At once, a clear and refreshing Strength washed through his mind like a spring, purifying his thoughts.
Just then—
[Ding!
You have received a new mission: [Starlight Tournament · 3].
Please check it in time.]
[Notification: A new mission has been added to your mission panel.
Please check the details yourself.]
Daniel immediately opened his mission panel.
[Starlight Tournament · 3] (Special)
Restriction: Faustus
Requirement: Participate throughout the entire event
Objective: Obtain a qualification for the [Second Round of the Advancement Stage]
Record: Emerge victorious in the first round of the advancement stage, and you shall step onto the battlefield of the second round.
Crush every enemy who seeks to block your coronation, and climb to the summit!
Time Limit: Long-term
Reward: [Mysterious Holy Relic (Divine-grade)]
Daniel closed the mission panel, the corner of his mouth curving upward.
"Another Divine-grade reward.
This tournament is turning out to be quite profitable!"
He smiled faintly, battle intent reflecting deep within his eyes.

Chanelle led every competitor from Canaan starfield into the arena.
The venue had changed completely from the day before.

Daniel sat in the viewing area, his expression indifferent.
According to the tournament schedule, his match had been arranged as the final battle.
It was not yet his turn to take the stage.

"These are five arenas created specifically for this tournament.
The competitors in the advancement round will take the stage in two batches.

"After the battles conclude, the Combat Power Rankings will be updated accordingly."

chapters.title: Chapter 291 -291-Challenging Every Competitor Single-Handedly
paragraphs: "What?!"
The smile on the face of the Lord of Starvault Sanctum froze instantly.
His expression became exceedingly complicated—seven parts displeasure, two parts anger, and one part unconcealable shock.
How could this Dustin dare make such an utterly absurd request?
To challenge every competitor all by himself!
Who had given him the courage to say such a thing?
Could it be that he had always been this "brave"?
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum drew in a deep breath, doing his utmost to suppress the surging emotions in his chest before speaking in a low voice.
"I do not believe I heard you clearly. Please say that again."
Dustin nodded, his tone still as gentle as before.
"Dustin... wishes to challenge every expert here single-handedly."
"Haha..."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum was so furious that he began to laugh. Then, he suddenly barked out,
"Very well!"
"As expected of the greatest prodigy selected by the Chaosverse—the strongest member of the younger generation of the Chaos Humans! I accept your request!"
A ball of fury smoldered in his chest.
This Dustin appeared warm and courteous on the surface, but in truth, he was arrogant beyond measure!
In that case, they would let him properly experience the true strength of the younger generation of the Myriad-Star Cosmos!
"Thank you for making the arrangements, my Lord."
Dustin remained perfectly calm, as though this response had been within his expectations from the very beginning.
"How do you intend to challenge them?"
At this point, the Lord of Starvault Sanctum decided to simply go along with him to the end.
Dustin smiled faintly.
"Since the first round of the tournament is still underway, I will not interfere with it."

"Once the second round has concluded, I ask that you arrange an arena for me, my Lord. I will personally face every participant from your esteemed universe. They may come at me together, or challenge me one-on-one. Either is fine by me."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum gradually regained his composure, but inwardly, he sneered without end.
This man was arrogant to the absolute extreme!
"Then it shall be as you wish. I only hope that you... manage to survive."
Dustin smiled lightly, his long robes fluttering despite the absence of any wind.
"I appreciate your good wishes."
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum soon made arrangements with the Oracle-grade powerhouses of the various starfields regarding Dustin, the expert from an outer universe.
The Oracle-grade powerhouses of the major starfields were so enraged that they practically began smoking from every orifice.
An expert from the Chaosverse actually dared look down on them to such an extent!
"That Dustin is only at the peak of demi-sage rank. No matter how powerful he is, just how strong could he possibly be?"
"Since the Chaosverse dares to come here and challenge us on our own ground, then we shall let them witness our strength!"
An Oracle-grade powerhouse from a certain starfield was furious beyond measure.
"My Aurora starfield’s Harris is more than enough to take him down!"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Aurora starfield spoke with absolute confidence.
"My Copper starfield’s Udi is equally capable of fighting him."
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Copper starfield was just as assured.
"Faustus... will certainly be able to defeat him."
Chanelle spoke calmly.
"Our Myriad-Star Cosmos possesses prodigies as numerous as the clouds. How could we possibly allow a madman from the Chaosverse to run rampant here?"
The Lord of Starvault Sanctum laughed loudly.
"Let us display some magnanimity as well. Allow Dustin to observe the first round of the tournament and see for himself just how laughable his words truly are!"
Chanelle nodded slightly.
"Then let us do exactly that."
"That’s right. We should first crush some of his arrogance."
"It is indeed time to teach him a proper lesson."
Dustin silently appeared at the edge of the viewing arena, without a sound or trace, like a ghostly shadow drifting in from another world.
Before he arrived, the experts of his race had specifically instructed him to pay close attention to a human competitor named Faustus!
Dustin’s gaze passed through the clamorous crowd and fell upon Canaan starfield’s seating area.
At first glance, he saw Daniel.
"So he is the current leader of the ancestral land of my Chaos Humans?"
A trace of curiosity flashed through Dustin’s eyes.
Lord Hyman had once said that this man possessed overwhelming Fortune Points and had the potential to become a Great Oracle-grade powerhouse.
His assessment of Faustus was in no way inferior to his assessment of Dustin himself!
In Canaan starfield’s viewing area, Daniel vaguely sensed an intense gaze examining him.
However, he did not think much of it.
Ever since he reached the top of the Starlight Combat Power Rankings, his every movement had been watched by countless eyes. He had long since grown accustomed to it.
His gaze remained fixed upon the arenas.
The first batch of experts in the advancement round had already stepped onto the stage and were merely awaiting the signal to begin.
Among these five pairs of competitors, three matches were battles between eight-star experts, while the remaining two were pinnacle clashes between nine-star experts.
Cold Star against Igor!
White Wolf against Silas!
"What a pity. There is no betting at this stage of the tournament."
Daniel felt somewhat disappointed.
Just then—
"Begin!"
At the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield’s command, his voice thundered across the surroundings.
Every spectator’s gaze instantly turned toward the five spatial arenas.
Arena One: White Wolf versus Silas.
White Wolf smiled faintly at Silas.
"You had better be careful."
Boom!
Almost simultaneously, the two of them unleashed their Divine Domains. Two vast and majestic pressures collided like enormous tidal waves.
White Wolf’s Divine Domain resembled a treasury filled with countless treasures, each one dazzling and extraordinary.
Silas’s Divine Domain, on the other hand, was formed from two streams of black and white energy that revolved around one another in an endless cycle.
The Divine Domains of the two nine-star experts instantly pressed against each other in a violent collision, evenly matched from the very beginning.
"The Law of Life and Death?"
White Wolf grinned.
"Silas, you truly live up to your reputation."
Silas’s expression remained solemn. A long sword suddenly appeared in his hand, and with a sweep of his arm, he launched a ferocious strike.
Sword light flashed.
Black and white radiance surged toward White Wolf like a raging tide.
White Wolf showed no fear whatsoever. He gave a loud shout.
"Astral Treasury, open!"

The treasures inside his Divine Domain poured out like a raging flood, transforming into a vast, boundless ocean. Every single treasure radiated brilliant light as they surged toward Silas in an overwhelming assault.
In the viewing area, James stared in astonishment.
"This White Wolf might actually be my natural nemesis!"

"He possesses countless treasures, and every single one of them carries extraordinary power. Although I have plenty of puppets, I’m afraid even they would be unable to withstand an attack of this scale."
Mosi looked at the endless sea of treasures and, in a rare display of opinion, uttered a single word.
"Annoying."
A gleam flashed through Daniel’s eyes.
"So the Law that Silas controls is actually the Law of Life and Death."

His own Divine Domain already incorporated the two great Laws of Life and Death and Reincarnation. However, this was the first time he had seen an expert whose Divine Domain itself was based upon the Law of Life and Death.
On the arena—
White Wolf’s sea of treasures attempted to resist and counterattack Silas’s streams of life-and-death energy.
However, the black and white energy continuously corroded them. Their Divinity drained away at astonishing speed, and one treasure after another became useless scrap before falling into the dust.
At the same time, Silas neither dodged nor evaded the incoming attacks from White Wolf’s sea of treasures.
Instead, he manipulated his Divine Domain and enveloped every one of White Wolf’s treasures within the black and white energy of life and death.
"What is he trying to do?"
White Wolf’s heart tightened.
Even if Silas managed to destroy his sea of treasures, he himself would still be killed by their assault.
Was he truly planning to trade his own life for countless treasures?
Could it be that he also possessed the ability to revive after death?
"No. It cannot possibly be that simple."
White Wolf immediately heightened his vigilance.
Sure enough—
Silas made no attempt to dodge White Wolf’s assault. His body was battered by the treasures until it became a bloody, mangled mess.
However, at the same time, his black and white energies of life and death had already enveloped every single one of White Wolf’s treasures.
"Life-Death Reversal!"
Crash! Crash! Crash!
Under the corrosion of the black and white energies, all of White Wolf’s treasures were reduced to worthless junk!

Meanwhile, waves of white light continuously flashed across Silas’s body. An enormous amount of life force flooded over him like water bursting through a shattered dam, rapidly restoring his damaged body.
"Hiss—!"
White Wolf immediately frowned deeply.
The Law of Life and Death was actually this powerful!
"However, I will not lose!"
The aura around White Wolf abruptly erupted.
"The strength of my physical body is comparable to a Divine-grade Secret Treasure! This is my true killing move!"
In the viewing area, Dustin smiled faintly.
"Interesting. To think that he has tempered his physical body to such an extent. Its strength is no weaker than a Divine-grade Secret Treasure."
"White Wolf is way too ridiculous, isn’t he?"
James’s expression darkened.
White Wolf’s Divine Domain and techniques seemed to counter him by nature.
Fortunately, White Wolf was not his opponent. Otherwise, faced with a body comparable to a Divine-grade Secret Treasure, James would undoubtedly have been forced into an extremely difficult battle.
Silas, however, merely sneered coldly.
"Do you think you are the only one who possesses a Divine-grade Secret Treasure?"
Whoosh!
He released his grip, and the long sword in his hand instantly transformed into a streak of light, shooting toward White Wolf.
"A Divine-grade Secret Treasure!"
White Wolf was an expert when it came to treasures. With a single glance, he immediately recognized what it was.
Frowning, he drove his fist toward the flying sword.
Boom!
The instant fist and sword collided, space itself shook violently.

Under the corrosion of the black and white energies, all of White Wolf’s treasures were reduced to worthless junk!
Meanwhile, waves of white light continuously flashed across Silas’s body.
An enormous amount of life force flooded over him like water bursting through a shattered dam, rapidly restoring his damaged body.
"Hiss—!"
White Wolf immediately frowned deeply.
The Law of Life and Death was actually this powerful!
"However, I will not lose!"
The aura around White Wolf abruptly erupted.
"The strength of my physical body is comparable to a Divine-grade Secret Treasure!
This is my true killing move!"
In the viewing area, Dustin smiled faintly.
"Interesting.
To think that he has tempered his physical body to such an extent.
Its strength is no weaker than a Divine-grade Secret Treasure."
"White Wolf is way too ridiculous, isn’t he?"
James’s expression darkened.
White Wolf’s Divine Domain and techniques seemed to counter him by nature.
Fortunately, White Wolf was not his opponent.
Otherwise, faced with a body comparable to a Divine-grade Secret Treasure, James would undoubtedly have been forced into an extremely difficult battle.
Silas, however, merely sneered coldly.
"Do you think you are the only one who possesses a Divine-grade Secret Treasure?"
Whoosh!
He released his grip, and the long sword in his hand instantly transformed into a streak of light, shooting toward White Wolf.
"A Divine-grade Secret Treasure!"
White Wolf was an expert when it came to treasures.
With a single glance, he immediately recognized what it was.
Frowning, he drove his fist toward the flying sword.
Boom!
The instant fist and sword collided, space itself shook violently.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 -292-White Wolf Concedes, the Law of Replication
paragraphs: Boom!
White Wolf sent the longsword flying with a single punch, but his expression abruptly changed.
"Something’s wrong!"
He looked down at his hand.
Among the black and white energies of life and death, the black energy had already wound itself around his hand and was rapidly spreading upward.
In the blink of an eye, his entire arm had turned pitch-black.
Swoosh!
At the same time, Silas’s longsword came thrusting after him once more.
White Wolf no longer dared use the arm saturated with death energy. Gritting his teeth, he had no choice but to swing his other fist.
Boom!
Fist and sword collided with a metallic clang, sending sparks flying in every direction.
However, that death energy clung to him like a curse buried deep in his bones. In an instant, it stained his other uninjured arm the same lifeless shade of black.
That was the color of death.
An omen that life itself was about to be severed.
Whoosh!
Silas’s longsword pierced through the air for the third time, swift as a meteor.
White Wolf clenched his teeth, his heart filled with helplessness.
He had no way to counter Silas’s ability. Now that his Divine Domain had already been shattered, he could only watch helplessly as Silas’s Law of Life and Death corroded him away.
"I... concede!"
White Wolf roared the words through gritted teeth, unwillingness filling his voice.
Although he was confident that he would not be killed easily, if all he could do was endure attacks without fighting back, then he might as well concede outright and preserve some dignity.
Swoosh!
The longsword stopped just short of his chest, the chilling edge of its blade stinging his skin.
Silas turned his wrist and withdrew the sword.
White Wolf immediately flew down from the arena, his face ashen with humiliation.
"White Wolf’s weakness is far too obvious."
Daniel shook his head.

"He relies too heavily on external power. Even though he tempered his own body into something comparable to a Divine-grade Secret Treasure, once his Divine Domain is broken, his combat power falls drastically."
"Exactly."
James nodded.
"If he had comprehended the power of Laws himself, Silas might not necessarily have been his match. In fact, there probably would not be many experts present capable of defeating him."
"Let’s look over there."
Daniel turned his gaze toward the arena where Cold Star and Igor were fighting.
At this moment, the battle between the two experts had also reached its conclusion.
Their fight was extraordinarily deadlocked. Both of them wielded long sabers, and their techniques were exactly alike, as though one were the mirrored reflection of the other!
"Tidal Tsunami!"
Igor suddenly slashed out with his saber, unleashing a blade light that surged forward like an enormous tsunami.
"Tidal Tsunami!"
Cold Star likewise swung his saber, his attack identical down to the slightest detail.
Rumble!
The two peerless saber lights collided, erupting with a deafening roar that caused the entire arena to tremble violently.
Igor flew into a rage.
"Cold Star, if you have any ability of your own, then stop copying me!"
"What kind of joke is that?"
Cold Star laughed softly.
"My ability is [Replication]. However much Strength you possess, I possess the same amount of Strength."
Igor felt a chill crawl through his heart.
This fellow was far too troublesome to deal with.
"Then if we continue fighting like this, how could either of us possibly decide the victor?"
"Hahaha... You are thinking too much!"
Cold Star grinned.
A dark blue pearl suddenly emerged in the void, radiating a terrifying pressure that made hearts tremble.
"I possess a Divine-grade Secret Treasure. You do not!"
Boom!
The pearl slammed violently toward Igor.
"Break!"
Igor swung his saber repeatedly, launching blade light after blade light toward the pearl like a violent storm.
Yet every one of them was instantly shattered by the pearl’s overwhelming power.
"Damn it... That is a World Pearl!"
Igor suddenly froze in shock.
A World Pearl was formed by condensing an entire miniature world into a single object. It contained the immense power of a complete heaven and earth. How could mere saber lights possibly shake it?
"Concede!"
Cold Star abruptly rushed forward and seized the opportunity to slash out with his saber.
Faced with the combined assault of the World Pearl and Cold Star’s saber light, Igor immediately found himself struggling desperately to defend both sides.
Clenching his teeth, he raised his saber to meet the howling World Pearl head-on.
Boom!
The instant the World Pearl collided with the long saber, cracks like a spiderweb abruptly spread through the surrounding space.
Pfft!
Igor felt as though his body had been crushed beneath an enormous mountain, his internal organs seemingly shattering all at once.
He was violently smashed out of the arena and lost consciousness on the spot.
The entire audience fell deathly silent.
Cold Star smiled faintly, recalled the World Pearl, and gracefully descended to the ground.
In the viewing area—
"The Law of Replication..."
Dustin looked toward Cold Star and nodded slightly.
"Interesting. He is qualified to fight me."
"This Cold Star is ridiculously powerful."
James furrowed his brows.
"His replication ability is practically impossible to counter."
"Yes."
Mosi’s response was as concise as ever.
"His replication ability essentially places him in an unbeatable position."
Daniel spoke calmly.
"And that Divine-grade Secret Treasure of his is also extremely formidable."
"That Divine-grade Secret Treasure is roughly on the same level as my wine flask."
James said.
Daniel immediately understood.
Some experts rejected external power, such as Mosi.

Mosi disdained using Divine-grade Secret Treasures or similar external aids. Experts like him believed that only one’s own personal ability could be considered true Strength, and that relying on outside objects would merely hinder one’s growth.
Such experts were obsessively devoted to tempering and refining themselves.
Clearly, Igor belonged to the same category.
After all, both men came from major factions, and those factions even possessed Oracle-grade powerhouses. Producing one or two Divine-grade Secret Treasures for them would hardly have been difficult.
At the opposite extreme stood someone like White Wolf, who was fanatically obsessed with treasures.
He had forcibly tempered his own body into something comparable to a Divine-grade Secret Treasure and had collected countless other Secret Treasures to serve as his offensive methods.
With this, the victors among the first batch of competitors in the advancement round had been decided.
The nine-star experts Cold Star and Silas had both successfully advanced. Having defeated opponents at the same level as themselves, their strength was beyond question.
Silas’s power of the Law of Life and Death was extraordinarily heaven-defying, while Cold Star’s replication ability could likewise be described as nearly impossible to overcome.
Three eight-star experts had also been fortunate enough to fight their way into the second round.
The spectator stands buzzed with animated discussion, waves of voices surging through the arena.
"Cold Star is incredible! I bet he is guaranteed to make it into the top three!"
"Is Silas supposed to be inferior, then? The Law of Life and Death is no easy thing to deal with!"
"If both of them can make it into the top three, are you saying all the other nine-star experts are weak?"
"Hahaha, exactly! Cold Star and Silas are certainly powerful, but do you honestly think Faustus and Harris are weak?"
"Listening to you all analyze it like this, these battles in the arena feel like ancient powerhouses slaughtering one another. This is getting more and more exciting!"
"The truly earth-shattering battles have yet to begin. The second batch to enter the arena contains the real trump cards capable of tearing the heavens apart!"

Just as the audience’s blood began to boil with excitement, the voice of the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield abruptly resounded throughout the arena, suppressing all the surrounding noise.
"The matchups for the second batch are now announced as follows—"
He spoke each name with deliberate emphasis.
"Faustus versus Elysi!"
"James versus Flora! Mosi versus Eris! Harris versus Julian! Udi versus Marcus!"
The moment those words were spoken, the entire arena erupted into an uproar.
Every expert about to take the stage ranked among the strongest individuals on the Combat Power Rankings.
These were no ordinary clashes.
They were collisions between contenders for the throne, destined battles between those standing at the very summit!
However, the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield suddenly raised one arm and extended a finger, pointing toward the central arena surrounded by golden runes.
In an instant, brilliant golden light erupted around the arena. Layer after layer of seals emerged like surging tides, isolating that entire region of space from the outside world.
"Everyone!"
A meaningful smile curled across the lips of the Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica starfield.

"As Faustus stands at the top of the rankings and commands the attention of countless spectators, I hereby announce that the battle between Faustus and Elysi shall take place independently within a specially designated arena!"
"The remaining four pairs of competitors shall enter first and take their positions!"
The audience immediately voiced their approval.
As the top-ranked competitor, Faustus naturally deserved treatment worthy of his standing.
If several trump-card battles took place simultaneously, would everyone watch Faustus, or would they watch the other experts fight?
It was far better to arrange Faustus’s battle as a separate spectacle, allowing every spectator to fully enjoy the show!

chapters.title: Chapter 293 -293-Caution Taken to the Extreme, Pursuit of the Pinnacle
paragraphs: Whoosh! Whoosh!
The remaining eight contestants descended onto their respective battle arenas.
Daniel sat in the spectator stands, silently observing the unfolding matches.
The Oracle-grade Budelica proclaimed in a resonant voice, "The second round of matches begins now!"
Arena Two.
Standing opposite James in the arena was Flora.
And Flora was the contestant who had attracted the most attention after Faustus!
Of course, James, who ranked second on the Combat Power Rankings, was hardly an easy opponent either.
Flora’s silvery-white hair drifted gently in the breeze, resembling frost and snow.
Her lips parted slightly as she whispered, "Choice of Judgment—"
A slender finger pointed toward James from afar.
"Receive the Grim Reaper’s Scythe!"
In the spectator stands, countless pairs of eyes locked firmly onto the arena.
It was the Law of Judgment again!
Would James die?
Thud!
In the very next instant, James’s body collapsed limply to the ground like a pile of mud.
Immediately afterward, a puppet crawled out from the sleeve of James’s dead body. Its form expanded out of thin air before transforming into another James.
Even the folds in his robes were identical down to the smallest detail!
He winked at Flora, the corner of his mouth rising slightly.
"Go on. Do it again."
Flora’s expression instantly darkened like the bottom of a pot.
Boom!
The spectator stands erupted into an uproar, waves of noise surging like a roaring tide.
"James has really taken playing it safe to the absolute extreme!"
"Is that the Path of Puppetry? Tsk, tsk... He’s practically Flora’s natural nemesis!"
"It’s over. Flora, one of my top three favorites, probably won’t be able to escape elimination now."
Daniel gazed at the arena and could not help smiling.
Even he had no idea where James’s true body was hidden.
What Flora faced was nothing more than one of his duplicates.
Even if she killed this one, she would only be met by another ten thousand, another million duplicates. The one thing she would never be able to touch was his actual body.
After all, that fellow had carved his fear of death into his very bones.
"Those two are both rather interesting."
A sharp gleam flickered in Dustin’s eyes.
The law Flora controlled was actually the Grand Judgment Law. Her words became reality; with a single utterance, she could determine life and death.
As for the path James followed as a Puppet Master, especially that secret technique of turning puppets into human replicas, it was nothing short of extraordinary.
"Judging solely by their strength beneath Divine-grade, either of them would be capable of ranking among the top ten even in the Chaosverse," Dustin commented.
Flora gritted her teeth. She wanted to continue attacking, but she had no way to break through James’s puppet technique.
The Grand Judgment Art was powerful, but its consumption was equally immense. She could not afford to keep using it endlessly.
Once she understood how this match would ultimately end, Flora unwillingly said, "I concede!"
James smiled, seemingly unsurprised.
In truth, aside from James himself, no one knew just how many trump cards he possessed.
Flora had made a wise decision.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse of Samuel Starfield also looked rather helpless.
Flora’s strengths and weaknesses were both equally obvious. James was indeed the one opponent she could not defeat.
Had she faced any powerful contestant other than James, she would never have been rendered so powerless.
"Luck simply didn’t fall on our side!"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse of Samuel Starfield let out a sigh.
"Damn it!"
Elysi glared maliciously at James before turning a dissatisfied gaze toward Flora as she stepped down from the arena.
Useless trash!
She had actually allowed Canaan Starfield to win the very first match!
Among the four matches, however, James had not been the first to claim victory.
Udi had been the first.
His opponent, Marcus, possessed only eight-star strength.
The instant the battle began, Udi kicked Marcus straight out of the arena. The entire fight was clean, swift, and completely without suspense.
"Winner of Arena Five—Udi!"
"Winner of Arena Two—James!"
The Oracle-grade Budelica announced the conclusions of the two matches.
At the same time, fierce battles were still raging in the remaining arenas. Blades flashed, sword shadows danced, and killing intent permeated the air.
Arena Three: Mosi versus Eris!
Mosi’s opponent was Eris.
"This is so infuriating! I didn’t even want to come to this competition in the first place! Being forced to participate was bad enough, and now I have to fight you too!"
Eris’s Divine Domain erupted outward with a boom. Wisps of bitter grievance spread through the entire space like fine threads.
Mosi’s ears became filled with sorrowful murmurs, soft sobs and plaintive whispers that seemed to lament endlessly.
Yet Mosi remained unmoved.
He resembled a block of eternal ice, frozen for countless ages and incapable of melting.
"You’re ignoring me!?"
Eris raised an eyebrow. Her voice suddenly transformed into an enraged roar, brimming with fury.
"I’m going to tear you into pieces!"
Mosi remained expressionless. The saber in his hand was still gathering momentum. His saber intent surged like the tide, compressed until it was nearly at the point of shattering apart!
"Mosi, would you like to find somewhere quiet with me and talk about our ideals?"
Eris’s demeanor changed once more, becoming as gentle and tender as flowing water.
The sight left many spectators completely baffled, while some powerful experts who understood the situation felt their hearts tighten.
The illusion-type law controlled by Eris was invisible and untraceable. One careless moment, and her opponent would sink helplessly into it!
"Hehe... You really are interesting. Are you made of stone? Come on, say something!"
Eris’s personality shifted like a revolving lantern, changing endlessly in the blink of an eye.
And at that exact moment—
Mosi moved!
The saber momentum he had been nurturing had already reached its absolute limit, like an arrow drawn back upon a fully stretched bowstring. It had to be released.
"...Demon Severance!"
Slash!
A flash of saber light erupted, resembling a bolt of white silk sweeping across the heavens and tearing the sky apart.
That incomparably sharp saber qi carved countless spiderweb-like cracks through the void itself.
Eris’s pupils abruptly contracted.
Blood sprayed across the arena as a figure crashed to the ground like a kite with its strings severed.
"Winner of Arena Three—Mosi!"
One slash, one kill.
Clean and decisive!
An uproar surged through the spectator stands like an incoming tide.
"That Mosi is terrifyingly powerful!"
"This is unbelievable! Eris could clearly manipulate her opponent’s seven emotions and six desires as though controlling a puppet on strings... Could Mosi truly be a stone spirit given human form?"
"From beginning to end, he didn’t even furrow his brow once. Is there truly someone in this world entirely immune to emotional disturbance?"
James could no longer hold back his amusement and burst into laughter.
"This draw must have been deliberately arranged by the God of Fate! Mosi is practically Eris’s destined nemesis! Hahahaha..."
"Mosi is not devoid of emotion."
Daniel also smiled and shook his head, his gaze profound and distant.

"His emotions were all sacrificed to that endless conviction the moment he set foot upon the road of the strong. He forged every ounce of passion and obsession within him into the edge of the saber in his hand."
"His saber will cut down everything that obstructs his ascent to the summit. It will never look back."
James repeatedly nodded at Daniel’s words.
Even Mosi, who had always maintained an icy expression, had a faint, almost imperceptible gleam flash through his eyes.
In the spectator stands, many powerful experts fell silent upon hearing those words.
Arena Four: Harris versus Julian.
"Now only Harris and Julian remain."
James turned his gaze toward Arena Four.
Daniel looked over as well.
Between Harris and Julian, who was stronger?
Once the two of you determine a winner, it will be my turn to enter the arena.
Three winners had already emerged from the second batch of advancement matches: James, Mosi, and Udi.
They had eliminated Flora, Eris, and Marcus respectively.
At this moment, only one battlefield remained locked in confrontation—the fourth-ranked Harris against the sixth-ranked Julian.
The two stood silently opposite one another.
Neither made the slightest reckless move!

"Luck simply didn’t fall on our side!"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse of Samuel Starfield let out a sigh.
"Damn it!"
Elysi glared maliciously at James before turning a dissatisfied gaze toward Flora as she stepped down from the arena.
Useless trash!
She had actually allowed Canaan Starfield to win the very first match!
Among the four matches, however, James had not been the first to claim victory.
Udi had been the first.
His opponent, Marcus, possessed only eight-star strength.
The instant the battle began, Udi kicked Marcus straight out of the arena.
The entire fight was clean, swift, and completely without suspense.
"Winner of Arena Five—Udi!"
"Winner of Arena Two—James!"
The Oracle-grade Budelica announced the conclusions of the two matches.
At the same time, fierce battles were still raging in the remaining arenas.
Blades flashed, sword shadows danced, and killing intent permeated the air.
Arena Three: Mosi versus Eris!
Mosi’s opponent was Eris.
"This is so infuriating!
I didn’t even want to come to this competition in the first place!
Being forced to participate was bad enough, and now I have to fight you too!"
Eris’s Divine Domain erupted outward with a boom.
Wisps of bitter grievance spread through the entire space like fine threads.
Mosi’s ears became filled with sorrowful murmurs, soft sobs and plaintive whispers that seemed to lament endlessly.
Yet Mosi remained unmoved.
He resembled a block of eternal ice, frozen for countless ages and incapable of melting.
"You’re ignoring me!?"
Eris raised an eyebrow.
Her voice suddenly transformed into an enraged roar, brimming with fury.
"I’m going to tear you into pieces!"
Mosi remained expressionless.
The saber in his hand was still gathering momentum.
His saber intent surged like the tide, compressed until it was nearly at the point of shattering apart!
"Mosi, would you like to find somewhere quiet with me and talk about our ideals?"
Eris’s demeanor changed once more, becoming as gentle and tender as flowing water.
The sight left many spectators completely baffled, while some powerful experts who understood the situation felt their hearts tighten.
The illusion-type law controlled by Eris was invisible and untraceable.
One careless moment, and her opponent would sink helplessly into it!
"Hehe...
You really are interesting.
Are you made of stone?
Come on, say something!"
Eris’s personality shifted like a revolving lantern, changing endlessly in the blink of an eye.
And at that exact moment—
Mosi moved!
The saber momentum he had been nurturing had already reached its absolute limit, like an arrow drawn back upon a fully stretched bowstring.
It had to be released.
"...Demon Severance!"
Slash!
A flash of saber light erupted, resembling a bolt of white silk sweeping across the heavens and tearing the sky apart.
That incomparably sharp saber qi carved countless spiderweb-like cracks through the void itself.
Eris’s pupils abruptly contracted.
Blood sprayed across the arena as a figure crashed to the ground like a kite with its strings severed.
"Winner of Arena Three—Mosi!"
One slash, one kill.
Clean and decisive!
An uproar surged through the spectator stands like an incoming tide.
"That Mosi is terrifyingly powerful!"
"This is unbelievable!
Eris could clearly manipulate her opponent’s seven emotions and six desires as though controlling a puppet on strings...
Could Mosi truly be a stone spirit given human form?"
"From beginning to end, he didn’t even furrow his brow once.
Is there truly someone in this world entirely immune to emotional disturbance?"
James could no longer hold back his amusement and burst into laughter.
"This draw must have been deliberately arranged by the God of Fate!
Mosi is practically Eris’s destined nemesis!
Hahahaha..."
"Mosi is not devoid of emotion."
Daniel also smiled and shook his head, his gaze profound and distant.
"His emotions were all sacrificed to that endless conviction the moment he set foot upon the road of the strong.
He forged every ounce of passion and obsession within him into the edge of the saber in his hand."
"His saber will cut down everything that obstructs his ascent to the summit.
It will never look back."
James repeatedly nodded at Daniel’s words.
Even Mosi, who had always maintained an icy expression, had a faint, almost imperceptible gleam flash through his eyes.
In the spectator stands, many powerful experts fell silent upon hearing those words.
Arena Four: Harris versus Julian.
"Now only Harris and Julian remain."
James turned his gaze toward Arena Four.
Daniel looked over as well.
Between Harris and Julian, who was stronger?
Once the two of you determine a winner, it will be my turn to enter the arena.
Three winners had already emerged from the second batch of advancement matches: James, Mosi, and Udi.
They had eliminated Flora, Eris, and Marcus respectively.
At this moment, only one battlefield remained locked in confrontation—the fourth-ranked Harris against the sixth-ranked Julian.
The two stood silently opposite one another.
Neither made the slightest reckless move!

chapters.title: Chapter 294 -294-The Terror of the Strongest Lifeform in the Starsea
paragraphs: James stared at the arena and spoke in a low voice.

"Julian isn’t absolutely certain that he can kill Harris in a single strike, and Harris isn’t absolutely certain that he can avoid Julian’s throwing knife... so neither of them dares to make the first move."
"They appear to be waiting, but the outcome will be decided in the blink of an eye," Daniel continued. "Because Julian only has one chance to attack."
James nodded.

Julian himself controlled two low-grade laws: the Law of Causality and the Law of Destruction. Combined with his Divine-grade secret treasure, the throwing knife that inherently contained the power of the Law of Space, his strength was truly terrifying.
However, Harris was no ordinary powerhouse either.
If Julian failed to take his life with that single knife, the one who died would be Julian himself.
"Hmm?"
Mosi suddenly let out a low sound of surprise.
At that very moment, every spectator witnessed the astonishing phenomenon before their eyes.
Behind Harris, within the void, an enormous creature abruptly condensed into existence!
The colossal being occupied nearly half the entire space. It towered over tens of thousands of meters high, its entire body exuding a vast, ancient, and mysterious aura.
"A Starbeast!"
Heaven-shaking cries of astonishment erupted from the spectator stands.
Even the Oracle-grade powerhouses turned their gazes toward the arena, their expressions becoming grave.
"So that is... a Starbeast?"
"One of the supreme lifeforms of the Endless Starsea!"
"It is said that Starbeasts require more than five hundred thousand years to reach adulthood, and once they mature, they can even awaken a supreme bloodline..."
The Starbeasts were the strongest race in the Endless Starsea!

They possessed no fixed territory, and their descendants were extraordinarily rare. However, once they reached adulthood, they would naturally possess Divine-grade strength—and the moment they entered Divine-grade, they would stand at its very peak!
If one of them was fortunate enough to awaken its bloodline, it could instantly step into the Oracle-grade realm.
In other words, the Harris before them could still only be considered a juvenile Starbeast!
"To think he is actually a Starbeast..."
James’s voice trembled slightly. "It is said that descendants of the Starbeast race are exceedingly rare. In our universe, Harris is currently the only one of his kind."
"So this is a Starbeast..."
Daniel gazed at the immense phantom that blotted out the sky and covered the earth, his heart filled with emotion.
"The Endless Starsea truly contains every wonder imaginable."
At this moment, he felt like a country boy who had only just entered a grand city for the first time. Everything he saw filled him with novelty and amazement.
Inside the arena, tiny beads of cold sweat had already appeared on Julian’s forehead, slowly sliding down from the corners of his brows.
"You should never have given me time to awaken my innate phantom."
Harris grinned, revealing rows of ghastly white teeth.
"Concede, Julian!"
Before his voice had even faded—
Awooo!
The phantom of the Starbeast behind Harris suddenly raised its head and let out a mighty roar toward the heavens.
The entire space shook violently. The earth shattered apart, and countless fragments of rock were sucked into the colossal beast’s mouth like mere morsels of food!
The sky trembled as endless matter surged madly into that enormous maw.
Even the wind and the light itself could not escape.
An irresistible devouring force swept through the arena.

Julian felt as though both his Divine Soul and his physical body were being violently torn at by an overwhelming Strength that he could not resist. He was almost dragged directly into the giant beast’s belly.
"Hmph!"
Julian let out a muffled grunt and gritted his teeth, desperately holding on. A trace of horror flashed through his eyes.
"So this is the devouring power of a Starbeast? It is said to stand above all laws and devour everything in existence!"
"I will not concede!"
Although Julian did not possess absolute confidence in his victory, he would never willingly give up here.
Even when facing the strongest lifeform in the Endless Starsea, he still had to hold the conviction that he would win.
That was the Rank he had pursued throughout his entire life!
Whoosh!
An incomparably blazing light burst from Julian’s eyes.
At this moment, his condition rose to an unprecedented peak. His strength surpassed that of every previous moment in his life.
This knife would be the strongest strike he had ever unleashed—
The most dazzling, and also the most lethal!
Swish!
A flash of blade light erupted.
Carrying an unstoppable will to advance and an absolute determination to kill, the throwing knife tore through the air, imbued with the powers of three great laws: Causality, Destruction, and Space!
Shnk!
The throwing knife struck its target squarely.
Julian’s knife was now embedded directly in Harris’s forehead!
Heaven-shaking cries of shock exploded from the spectator stands.
"Holy shit! Harris lost?"
"The strongest lifeform in the Starsea? Is that all he has?"
"No, that’s not it! Julian is simply too strong!"
"Julian has lost."
Daniel abruptly fixed his gaze on Harris.
He could sense a surging tide of vitality erupting from within Harris’s body. That life force was so abundant that it was comparable to an entire miniature world brimming with life!
How could the vitality of a single living being be so vast?
"The defining trait of a Starbeast is its ability to devour everything," James said with a sigh. "And naturally, ’everything’ includes all laws as well."
"As expected of the strongest lifeform in the Endless Starsea. Once they fully awaken their bloodline, they will unquestionably become supreme powerhouses."
"They can even devour laws and convert them into nourishment for themselves."
Daniel shook his head.
"Starbeasts are practically unbeatable existences."
However, an almost imperceptible smile tugged at the corner of his lips.
He happened to possess a Starbeast egg himself!
It was something he had obtained after Heavenscar plundered the treasury of the Holy Kingdom.
He had already removed its seal long ago. He simply had never known how he should deal with it.
Now that he had witnessed the terrifying power and talent Harris had displayed, Daniel had begun to form a plan in his heart.
"At present, the Chronoverse Prologue Codex is still missing three elemental cores."
He silently contemplated, "Once I gather them all, I will be able to control the Laws of Time and Space. However, elemental cores are not something I can obtain merely by being anxious."
The Starbeast egg, on the other hand, was something he could put to use.
He turned his attention back toward the arena.
Inside the arena, even after taking Julian’s knife to the forehead, Harris remained completely unharmed.
"Idiot. You have no chance left!"
An endless torrent of life force poured down from the Starbeast phantom behind Harris, leaving him entirely unscathed as it repaired every trace of damage he had suffered.
At the same time, the devouring force grew increasingly violent, as though it intended to swallow the entire space itself.
Julian no longer had the opportunity to throw a second knife, because his strongest strike had always been his first.
In other words, he had already lost.
At this moment, he could no longer withstand the increasingly overwhelming devouring power. His Divine Soul was forcibly torn from him and sucked away.
Immediately afterward came his physical body...
A moment later, Julian had been completely devoured by the Starbeast!
Julian had fallen!
Even until the moment of his death, he had failed to force Harris to reveal any other abilities.
This scene caused every contestant who had already advanced to furrow their brows tightly.
"By the Creator God... This has already surpassed the limits of a quasi-Sage, hasn’t it?"
Udi’s face was deathly pale, and his voice trembled as he spoke.
"The strongest race of the Endless Starsea truly lives up to its reputation."
Harris was like a terrifying curse mark, branded deeply into the hearts of every one of his opponents.
Silas shook his head and let out a long sigh.
"Had I been standing in Julian’s position..."
Cold Star involuntarily shuddered.
"Even if I can replicate all things, how could I possibly replicate a bloodline power capable of devouring heaven and earth?"
Harris was an insurmountable mountain before him!
He gave a bitter smile, a helpless gleam flashing through his eyes.
In the stands, the spectators were all dumbfounded, as though an invisible giant hand had seized them by the throat.
The reversal in this battle had happened as swiftly as a meteor flashing across the night sky, leaving everyone utterly unprepared.
"Julian fell just like that? He didn’t even get the chance to use a second knife..."
"The racial talent of the Starbeasts is simply too heaven-defying. They can devour everything, even laws themselves... Who could possibly contend with an existence like that?"
"This is ridiculous. Why are they even still fighting? They might as well deliver the championship trophy straight to Harris right now!"
"That sounds perfectly reasonable to me—but I’m afraid certain challengers won’t agree."
