chapters.title: Chapter 295 -295-Merciless Annihilation, Brutality Taken to the Extreme
paragraphs: In the most remote corner of the spectator stands, Dustin sat alone in silence.
He stared at the enormous phantom behind Harris, the one that blotted out the sky and covered the earth. The usual calmness on his face had vanished, replaced by a rare trace of solemnity.
It reminded him of a certain past he did not wish to mention.
"Starbeasts really are troublesome existences."
He muttered softly to himself, a hint of helplessness in his tone.
"There is one in the Chaosverse as well, though that fellow is far more arrogant and overbearing than Harris."
"If that fellow had not matured long ago and already entered the peak of Divine-grade, the outcome of the Rookie Tournament would truly have been difficult to predict."
"Had I not descended upon this battlefield, Faustus would most likely have been destined to fight Harris for supremacy."
The corner of Dustin’s mouth lifted slightly, a trace of pride flashing through his eyes.
"Unfortunately, Faustus will not have that opportunity anymore—because I have already arrived."
"A Starbeast?"
A confident arc appeared on his lips.
"So long as one’s Strength is great enough, there is nothing to fear!"
Dustin withdrew his gaze. His fingertips lightly tapped against the armrest of his seat, as though he were calculating something.
In the distance, Harris seemed to sense the scrutinizing gaze.
He tilted his head slightly, only to see an empty corner of the stands.
Harris retracted the enormous Starbeast phantom behind him.
The space within the arena had already been completely destroyed, reduced to a scene of utter devastation.
Fortunately, each arena was an independently separated space. Destroying one would have no effect on the others.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica Starfield immediately announced in a booming voice,
"The winner—Harris!"
Deafening cheers instantly erupted from the spectator stands.
At this moment, Harris’s popularity soared to its peak.
However, the atmosphere in the viewing area of Samuel Starfield had become unbearably heavy.

They had possessed only three nine-star powerhouses in total. Flora had been eliminated by James, while Julian had been slain by Harris. Now, the only one remaining, Elysi, still had to face Faustus of Canaan Starfield!
The situation could not have been worse.
Upon hearing the announcement of his victory, Harris showed no trace of surprise.
From afar, he looked toward the viewing area of Canaan Starfield, his gaze firmly locked onto Faustus.
"I’ll see you in the finals."
He murmured silently, "The Starchosen of this generation who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak... I intend to challenge you for supremacy once more!"
A moment later, he flew back to Aurora Starfield’s seating area, where he was greeted by thunderous cheers and applause.
The Oracle-grade Budelica smiled before announcing loudly,
"The next match—Faustus of Canaan Starfield versus Elysi of Samuel Starfield."
"One is ranked first on the Combat Power Rankings, while the other is the powerhouse ranked eighth."
"Now, please enter the arena!"
Whoosh! Whoosh!
In the spectator stands, every gaze surged forward like a tide, converging upon the central arena!
"Faustus..."
"Although you and I are separated by cosmic star rivers and belong to different worlds, we Chaos Humans have never regarded you as an outsider."
Dustin’s gaze grew profound as he spoke in a low voice.
"Allow me to witness with my own eyes just how many layers of heaven your edge can pierce through."
Before the Oracle-grade Budelica had even finished speaking, Faustus’s figure had already flashed into existence at the center of the arena.
Refusing to show weakness, Elysi appeared almost simultaneously, facing him from afar.
The battles of the other powerhouses had long since concluded.
At this moment, this final battle had truly become the focus of all attention!
Every spectator, every participant who had advanced, and even the various Oracle-grade powerhouses held their breaths in intense concentration.
Faustus occupied the top position on the rankings. Just how powerful was he?
And what confidence did Elysi possess that allowed him to challenge the number one contender?
The battle drums had yet to sound, but killing intent was already lurking in the air!
"Faustus..."
Elysi held his head high and puffed out his chest. Battle intent burned like blazing flames in his eyes, while a confident smile curved his lips.
Faustus merely blinked faintly, completely unperturbed.
His gaze was casual and indifferent, as though the person standing before him was not a nine-star powerhouse, but nothing more than a gust of wind destined to disperse!
Excitement boiled through the spectator stands as roars and cheers surged one after another like crashing waves.
"Faustus! Crush him!"
"Elysi, show us what you’re really capable of!"
"Faustus, the starlight in the long night of the Starsea!"
"O Starchosen who reached the summit in this generation! Let us see your true strength!"
"The match—begins!"
The Oracle-grade Budelica’s voice shook the entire arena.
Boom!
Elysi’s entire body trembled as his Divine Domain erupted outward with a thunderous roar, spreading across the sky like an enormous illusory curtain.
He laughed wildly.
"Faustus, allow me to personally show you what a true illusion is!"
In an instant, the illusion surged outward like a tide, swallowing Faustus within layer after layer of unreal abyssal depths.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
All the spectators involuntarily turned their gazes toward Faustus, as though they wanted to pierce through the veil of mist and glimpse the truth hidden within.
"Elysi is actually proficient in the path of illusions?"
"He and Eris truly make a fine combination—one controls illusions, while the other controls enchantment. Their abilities complement each other perfectly."
"Can Faustus break through this illusion? It is said that only those whose will is as firm as bedrock can remain unaffected by it."
"That’s hard to say. Illusion-type laws are extremely bizarre. They aren’t something one can simply crush with raw strength alone. What truly matters is the stability of one’s Mental State."
"If one’s Mental State is unstable, then even heaven-defying Strength merely turns one into a bird trapped inside a cage."
The scene before Faustus’s eyes changed endlessly, making it impossible to distinguish truth from falsehood.
Yet his heart remained as clear as a spotless mirror, without the slightest ripple.
"No wonder Elysi was the third person to awaken on the second level of the elimination round. So the law he controls is the Law of Illusion."
The corner of Faustus’s mouth rose slightly, a trace of mockery surfacing in his eyes.
"Unfortunately, these are nothing but flashy and useless tricks."
He possessed [Clearstone], which could break through every illusion and all forms of deception.
He was Elysi’s natural nemesis!
"Kill him!"
With a single thought from Faustus, his avatars were instantly summoned forth.
"Immortal Icon!"
Boom!
Ten giants, each a hundred meters tall, abruptly descended upon the arena. Their iron fists were like mountains, smashing through Elysi’s illusion with overwhelming, irresistible force.
Several fists and feet streaked forward as swiftly as meteors, carrying world-destroying Strength as they hurtled toward Elysi.
Elysi’s expression changed drastically, his eyes filled with disbelief and terror.
"Impossible! My illusion can even trap and kill Divine-grade powerhouses! How could he break through it so easily?!"
"Could it be that I’m the one caught in an illusion? Impossible! Faustus could never possess such a law!"
Only these few fragmented thoughts had time to flash through his mind.
In the next instant, fists and feet as massive as mountains had already drowned him completely.
"Faustus, wait!"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Samuel Starfield actually spoke out publicly to plead for mercy.
However, it was already too late.
Boom!
Rumble!
The arena shook violently, as though the earth were splitting apart and mountains were collapsing. The surrounding space seemed liable to be torn apart at any moment.

The gigantic avatars summoned by Faustus possessed unmatched brute force in every movement. They shattered laws with pure Strength, their attacks unyielding, overwhelming, and ferocious to the extreme!
[Ding! You have slain [Elysi]!]
Faustus abruptly stopped attacking and recalled his avatars.
Before him, nothing remained but a scattered pile of mangled remains!
"Hmph!"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Samuel Starfield snorted angrily and flicked his sleeve, refusing to speak any further.
What a pity!
Samuel Starfield had once again lost one of its nine-star generals.
Julian had perished at Harris’s hands, and now Elysi had died at Faustus’s hands. Of their three great nine-star powerhouses, only Flora remained alive—and she had already been eliminated.
"Heh!"
Chanelle’s gaze was as sharp as a sword as it pierced toward Samuel Starfield’s seating area.
In the spectator stands, every powerhouse sucked in a sharp breath.
Was this not far too brutal?
Could Faustus also be some monstrous beast disguised in human skin?
Elysi was still a nine-star powerhouse, one who was proficient in the Law of Illusion. Yet before Faustus, he had been crushed into pulp as easily as an ant.
From the moment Faustus launched his assault to the instant Elysi died, everything had happened with unbelievable speed!

sentences.text: In the most remote corner of the spectator stands, Dustin sat alone in silence.
He stared at the enormous phantom behind Harris, the one that blotted out the sky and covered the earth.
The usual calmness on his face had vanished, replaced by a rare trace of solemnity.
It reminded him of a certain past he did not wish to mention.
"Starbeasts really are troublesome existences."
He muttered softly to himself, a hint of helplessness in his tone.
"There is one in the Chaosverse as well, though that fellow is far more arrogant and overbearing than Harris."
"If that fellow had not matured long ago and already entered the peak of Divine-grade, the outcome of the Rookie Tournament would truly have been difficult to predict."
"Had I not descended upon this battlefield, Faustus would most likely have been destined to fight Harris for supremacy."
The corner of Dustin’s mouth lifted slightly, a trace of pride flashing through his eyes.
"Unfortunately, Faustus will not have that opportunity anymore—because I have already arrived."
"A Starbeast?"
A confident arc appeared on his lips.
"So long as one’s Strength is great enough, there is nothing to fear!"
Dustin withdrew his gaze.
His fingertips lightly tapped against the armrest of his seat, as though he were calculating something.
In the distance, Harris seemed to sense the scrutinizing gaze.
He tilted his head slightly, only to see an empty corner of the stands.
Harris retracted the enormous Starbeast phantom behind him.
The space within the arena had already been completely destroyed, reduced to a scene of utter devastation.
Fortunately, each arena was an independently separated space.
Destroying one would have no effect on the others.
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Budelica Starfield immediately announced in a booming voice,
"The winner—Harris!"
Deafening cheers instantly erupted from the spectator stands.
At this moment, Harris’s popularity soared to its peak.
However, the atmosphere in the viewing area of Samuel Starfield had become unbearably heavy.
They had possessed only three nine-star powerhouses in total.
Flora had been eliminated by James, while Julian had been slain by Harris.
Now, the only one remaining, Elysi, still had to face Faustus of Canaan Starfield!
The situation could not have been worse.
Upon hearing the announcement of his victory, Harris showed no trace of surprise.
From afar, he looked toward the viewing area of Canaan Starfield, his gaze firmly locked onto Faustus.
"I’ll see you in the finals."
He murmured silently, "The Starchosen of this generation who reached the summit of Cloudcrest Peak...
I intend to challenge you for supremacy once more!"
A moment later, he flew back to Aurora Starfield’s seating area, where he was greeted by thunderous cheers and applause.
The Oracle-grade Budelica smiled before announcing loudly,
"The next match—Faustus of Canaan Starfield versus Elysi of Samuel Starfield."
"One is ranked first on the Combat Power Rankings, while the other is the powerhouse ranked eighth."
"Now, please enter the arena!"
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
In the spectator stands, every gaze surged forward like a tide, converging upon the central arena!
"Faustus..."
"Although you and I are separated by cosmic star rivers and belong to different worlds, we Chaos Humans have never regarded you as an outsider."
Dustin’s gaze grew profound as he spoke in a low voice.
"Allow me to witness with my own eyes just how many layers of heaven your edge can pierce through."
Before the Oracle-grade Budelica had even finished speaking, Faustus’s figure had already flashed into existence at the center of the arena.
Refusing to show weakness, Elysi appeared almost simultaneously, facing him from afar.
The battles of the other powerhouses had long since concluded.
At this moment, this final battle had truly become the focus of all attention!
Every spectator, every participant who had advanced, and even the various Oracle-grade powerhouses held their breaths in intense concentration.
Faustus occupied the top position on the rankings.
Just how powerful was he?
And what confidence did Elysi possess that allowed him to challenge the number one contender?
The battle drums had yet to sound, but killing intent was already lurking in the air!
"Faustus..."
Elysi held his head high and puffed out his chest.
Battle intent burned like blazing flames in his eyes, while a confident smile curved his lips.
Faustus merely blinked faintly, completely unperturbed.
His gaze was casual and indifferent, as though the person standing before him was not a nine-star powerhouse, but nothing more than a gust of wind destined to disperse!
Excitement boiled through the spectator stands as roars and cheers surged one after another like crashing waves.
"Faustus!
Crush him!"
"Elysi, show us what you’re really capable of!"
"Faustus, the starlight in the long night of the Starsea!"
"O Starchosen who reached the summit in this generation!
Let us see your true strength!"
"The match—begins!"
The Oracle-grade Budelica’s voice shook the entire arena.
Boom!
Elysi’s entire body trembled as his Divine Domain erupted outward with a thunderous roar, spreading across the sky like an enormous illusory curtain.
He laughed wildly.
"Faustus, allow me to personally show you what a true illusion is!"
In an instant, the illusion surged outward like a tide, swallowing Faustus within layer after layer of unreal abyssal depths.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
All the spectators involuntarily turned their gazes toward Faustus, as though they wanted to pierce through the veil of mist and glimpse the truth hidden within.
"Elysi is actually proficient in the path of illusions?"
"He and Eris truly make a fine combination—one controls illusions, while the other controls enchantment.
Their abilities complement each other perfectly."
"Can Faustus break through this illusion?
It is said that only those whose will is as firm as bedrock can remain unaffected by it."
"That’s hard to say.
Illusion-type laws are extremely bizarre.
They aren’t something one can simply crush with raw strength alone.
What truly matters is the stability of one’s Mental State."
"If one’s Mental State is unstable, then even heaven-defying Strength merely turns one into a bird trapped inside a cage."
The scene before Faustus’s eyes changed endlessly, making it impossible to distinguish truth from falsehood.
Yet his heart remained as clear as a spotless mirror, without the slightest ripple.
"No wonder Elysi was the third person to awaken on the second level of the elimination round.
So the law he controls is the Law of Illusion."
The corner of Faustus’s mouth rose slightly, a trace of mockery surfacing in his eyes.
"Unfortunately, these are nothing but flashy and useless tricks."
He possessed [Clearstone], which could break through every illusion and all forms of deception.
He was Elysi’s natural nemesis!
"Kill him!"
With a single thought from Faustus, his avatars were instantly summoned forth.
"Immortal Icon!"
Boom!
Ten giants, each a hundred meters tall, abruptly descended upon the arena.
Their iron fists were like mountains, smashing through Elysi’s illusion with overwhelming, irresistible force.
Several fists and feet streaked forward as swiftly as meteors, carrying world-destroying Strength as they hurtled toward Elysi.
Elysi’s expression changed drastically, his eyes filled with disbelief and terror.
"Impossible!
My illusion can even trap and kill Divine-grade powerhouses!
How could he break through it so easily?!"
"Could it be that I’m the one caught in an illusion?
Impossible!
Faustus could never possess such a law!"
Only these few fragmented thoughts had time to flash through his mind.
In the next instant, fists and feet as massive as mountains had already drowned him completely.
"Faustus, wait!"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Samuel Starfield actually spoke out publicly to plead for mercy.
However, it was already too late.
Boom!
Rumble!
The arena shook violently, as though the earth were splitting apart and mountains were collapsing.
The surrounding space seemed liable to be torn apart at any moment.
The gigantic avatars summoned by Faustus possessed unmatched brute force in every movement.
They shattered laws with pure Strength, their attacks unyielding, overwhelming, and ferocious to the extreme!
[Ding!
You have slain [Elysi]!]
Faustus abruptly stopped attacking and recalled his avatars.
Before him, nothing remained but a scattered pile of mangled remains!
"Hmph!"
The Oracle-grade powerhouse from Samuel Starfield snorted angrily and flicked his sleeve, refusing to speak any further.
What a pity!
Samuel Starfield had once again lost one of its nine-star generals.
Julian had perished at Harris’s hands, and now Elysi had died at Faustus’s hands.
Of their three great nine-star powerhouses, only Flora remained alive—and she had already been eliminated.
"Heh!"
Chanelle’s gaze was as sharp as a sword as it pierced toward Samuel Starfield’s seating area.
In the spectator stands, every powerhouse sucked in a sharp breath.
Was this not far too brutal?
Could Faustus also be some monstrous beast disguised in human skin?
Elysi was still a nine-star powerhouse, one who was proficient in the Law of Illusion.
Yet before Faustus, he had been crushed into pulp as easily as an ant.
From the moment Faustus launched his assault to the instant Elysi died, everything had happened with unbelievable speed!

chapters.title: Chapter 296 -296-Titan Body
paragraphs: "Elysi... to think she ended up in such a miserable state, without even a scrap of her remains left behind."
"By the Creator God, was that the beginning and end of the battle? I didn’t even see what happened on the arena before everything was already settled."
"Faustus smashed Elysi apart with a single palm strike! That speed, that explosive power—it was terrifying!"
"That guy is practically a demon god descended into the world!"
Cold Star’s eyes widened. An uncontrollable shiver ran through his entire body, as if that colossal palm had been coming down toward him instead.
"Too brutal... simply enough to make one’s skin crawl."
Silas shook his head, feeling a chill run down his spine.
Just now, without realizing it, he had imagined himself in Elysi’s position. That suffocating sensation in that instant had almost made him think he was already in heaven.
"Immortal Icon—this is the Divine-grade secret art passed down through generations of my Chaos Humans."
Dustin’s eyes lit up as he secretly praised it in his heart.
Not only had he mastered this secret art long ago, but the version he had studied was the complete Divine-grade art.
"Besides..."
Dustin continued analyzing in his mind. "Faustus is also proficient in the Law of Causality. He can be considered an extremely rare genius."
"With such strength, he does live up to Lord Hyman’s evaluation of him as someone with the potential of a Great Oracle-grade expert."
A strange brilliance shimmered in his eyes, but he quickly concealed it and changed the direction of his thoughts.
"However, if this is the full extent of his strength, then he still isn’t my opponent."
Dustin withdrew his gaze. His fingertips tapped lightly against the armrest of his seat as he sank into thought.
Far away on the arena, Daniel’s expression remained calm, as though what had just happened was nothing more than brushing away a speck of dust.
Between the two of them lay the roaring spectator stands, yet it was as if an invisible void separated them.
Daniel could sense the fury of the Oracle-grade expert from Samuel Starfield, but he did not care in the slightest.
A duel in the arena meant that each fighter accepted their own fate.
Besides, the Oracle-grade expert Chanelle of Canaan Starfield was present as well. Who was he supposed to be afraid of?
He could not even be bothered to acknowledge that Oracle-grade expert’s gaze.
Oracle-grade Budelica glanced toward the place where Elysi had fallen, then sighed softly and announced in a loud voice,
"The winner of Arena One—Faustus of Canaan Starfield!"
Faustus flew back to the spectator seats.
At this point, the top ten of the advancement round had finally been decided.
James, Mosi, Udi, Harris, Silas, Cold Star, Faustus, and three eight-star experts.
The ten slots were now fixed!
The second round of the advancement matches would see these ten competitors fight for the five remaining spots.
Among the many starfields in this advancement round, Samuel Starfield had undoubtedly suffered the heaviest losses.
Julian and Elysi had both died, while Flora had survived but had still been brutally eliminated.
By contrast, Canaan Starfield had become the greatest winner, with all three of its competitors advancing!
[Ding! Congratulations, you have completed the mission.]
[You have obtained one [Secret Art Chest (Divine-grade)]!]
Hmm!
Daniel’s heart trembled.
A secret art chest?
And it was a Divine-grade secret art chest!
This time, the reward was actually a Divine-grade secret art!
A bright light flashed in his eyes, and he immediately opened the chest.
[Ding! You have opened the chest.]
[You have obtained the Divine-grade secret art [Titan Body] (Divine-grade)!]
"Titan Body, huh? Not bad at all!"
Daniel was overjoyed.
This Divine-grade secret art was crude, direct, and overwhelming. It shattered techniques with pure force, making it a perfect match for his endlessly surging Strength trait.
If combined with Immortal Icon, it would be like adding wings to a tiger!
Without the slightest hesitation, he learned the Divine-grade secret art.
[Ding! You have learned the Divine-grade secret art [Titan Body]!]
Immediately afterward, another system notification rang out.
[Ding! You have received a new mission, [Starlight Tournament · 4]. Please check it.]
[Ding! A new mission has been added to your current mission list. Please view the details.]
Daniel opened his mission list.
[Starlight Tournament · 4] (Special)
Restriction: Faustus
Requirement: Participate throughout the entire event
Objective: Win the [Tournament Championship]
Description: The final step—ascend to the pinnacle of the Stellar level!
Time Limit: Long-term
Reward: [Scroll of Astral Prosperity] (Rare)
Daniel closed the mission list.
Even without the mission, he had to win the championship. The champion’s reward was far too tempting!
A Divine-grade secret treasure and a Divine-grade secret art—no matter what, he could not let them slip away.
"Harris..."
He raised his brows. If nothing unexpected happened, his greatest opponent would be Harris.
"Still, I’m guaranteed to win."
He smiled, brimming with confidence.
"The reward for this mission is rather interesting. Scroll of Astral Prosperity... I wonder what it is."
He pondered silently.
Just then, Oracle-grade Chanelle suddenly sent him a voice transmission.
"Faustus, the tournament format has changed!"
"In a short while, an expert from an outer universe will set up an arena and challenge all the advanced competitors."
Daniel froze.
Challenge everyone?
Who was arrogant enough to do that?
He blinked and asked, "An outer universe?"
Oracle-grade Chanelle said calmly, "The Chaosverse. The Chaos Humans—Dustin."
Buzz!
Daniel blinked, unable to react for a moment.
Chaos Humans...
"Humans..."
The corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
According to the origins previously explained by that human expert, the Chaos Humans were most likely a bloodline that had left Earth in an incredibly ancient era.
They had once multiplied and thrived in this universe, but because they had offended a Great Oracle-grade expert, their entire race had migrated to the Chaosverse.
If one seriously traced the lineage back, perhaps the ancestors of all humans on Earth were branch descendants of the Chaos Humans.
"Next, an expert from the Chaos Humans will set up an arena and fight all the advanced competitors..."
Daniel did not know whether to laugh or cry. "Looks like the second advancement round is probably gone."
James and Mosi soon received the news as well.
"The Chaosverse borders our universe. It is a newly born universe."
James recalled the ancient records he had read and slowly explained,

"Among the human branches of the Endless Starsea, the Chaos Humans rank in the top three. Human branch lineages are spread across many universes, and being able to rank in the top three means they are an extremely powerful existence."
Daniel nodded slightly.
"The Chaos Humans have an eighth-tier Oracle-grade expert presiding over them, so of course they’re an extraordinary race."
He said in a low voice, "But they really are too arrogant!"
"They actually dare to challenge all of our competitors alone. They truly don’t place us in their eyes at all."
"Arrogant," Mosi spat coldly.
Just then, Oracle-grade Budelica’s voice resounded across the entire arena.
"In this tournament, an expert from the Chaosverse has come to participate!"
Boom!
The spectator stands instantly erupted into an uproar.
Clearly, only a small number of people had known this news. Most of the spectators had been kept completely in the dark.
"An expert from the Chaosverse is going to participate? Weren’t they only here to watch?"
"By the Creator God! I didn’t expect the experts from other universes to be unable to hold back anymore. Now the scale of this tournament has risen to a whole new level!"
"I wonder what kind of expert the Chaosverse has sent..."
Oracle-grade Budelica continued,
"The Chaosverse has sent only one expert—the strongest prodigy of their universe!"
"Dustin of the Chaos Humans will challenge all the victorious competitors of this universe’s advancement round by himself!"

chapters.title: Chapter 297 -297-He Will Trample Everyone Underfoot
paragraphs: "Dustin of the Chaos Humans will challenge all the prodigies of this universe by himself!"
If the words just now had been a clap of thunder, then this sentence was nothing short of the collapse of heaven and earth.
It completely blasted all the spectators into a daze, and a thunderous uproar erupted throughout the entire arena.
"What? He wants to challenge all the competitors alone?"
"By the Creator God! How can he be so bold?"
"Too arrogant. I have never seen anyone this arrogant in my life!"
"Challenge all the prodigies?"
Harris sneered. Even he did not possess such courage.
Faustus alone was already someone he felt he would need to go all out against, let alone with other nine-star experts present as well.
"He’s also only at the demi-sage rank... yet he’s actually this arrogant?"
Cold Star shook his head. He had to admire this level of arrogance.
"Is he here to get beaten up? Hmph!"
Udi’s face was filled with disdain. He absolutely refused to believe that anyone could possess such strength, daring to declare war against the top demi-sage rank experts of an entire universe.
Silas could not help muttering under his breath,
"Why do I feel faintly excited...? Is something wrong with me?"
His first reaction was actually the desire to personally witness just how powerful this expert from the Chaosverse really was, and to see whether he would be taught a harsh lesson.
For a moment, he had forgotten just how arrogant the other party’s demand was.
However, Oracle-grade Budelica was still adding fuel to the fire.
He smiled and said, "Dustin of the Chaos Humans also said that the competitors of our universe are free to attack together."
"One man, against all of you!"
Boom!
The spectator stands instantly exploded. All kinds of "passionate greetings" surged toward Dustin like a tidal wave.
The victorious nine-star experts were equally furious, their anger burning hot.
After being looked down upon and disregarded to such an extent, who could possibly remain calm?
"To challenge the strongest batch of same-rank experts in an entire universe by himself—is he insane?"
Udi cursed inwardly. He secretly swore that he would teach that man a brutal lesson. Otherwise, there was no way he could swallow this anger.
"I have never been belittled like this before. This feeling is truly disgusting."
Silas’s brows were tightly furrowed, and his eyes almost seemed ready to spew fire.
"This young expert is far too arrogant. Am I the one who has fallen behind the times?"
Cold Star shook his head speechlessly.
"Then come!"
Harris’s hatred quickly shifted onto Dustin.
Dustin smiled with ease, as though everything was only natural.
"That’s right. I intend to challenge all of you—by myself, I will trample every last one of you beneath my feet!"
Dustin stood tall with his head raised, an unmatched confidence surging from every inch of his body, as though he had already grasped the scepter of fate.

"Though the Endless Starsea is boundless, supreme-grade authority and peerless treasures have always belonged only to those who dare to reach out and seize them. If you do not fight, you can only become someone else’s stepping stone. Fall one step behind, and you may never rise again!"

"We are already defying the heavens, contending against all things! Without the ambition to devour heaven and earth, without the fighting spirit that burns the soul itself, one is only worthy of crawling in the dust and looking up at another’s glory!"
"To the strong, the Endless Starsea is a hall of eternal renown. To the weak, it is an abyss of eternal damnation!"
Dustin’s eyes were as sharp as an unsheathed sword, and his voice echoed in everyone’s ears.
"I, Dustin—will be the one who fights for everything!"
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone present was shocked.
Some felt their blood boil. Some were enraged beyond measure. Others even clenched their fists in secret, wishing they could immediately rush onto the arena and fight him to the death.
However, the overwhelming dominance and confidence rushing toward them caused countless people to feel an indescribable sense of awe.
This man was not merely arrogant and conceited. He truly possessed the confidence to overturn the star sea!
Oracle-grade Budelica announced in a clear voice, "Next, let us welcome Dustin, the demi-sage from the Chaosverse, to prepare for battle!"
Whoosh!
Before his words had even faded, Dustin was already standing proudly atop Arena One.
Whoosh, whoosh!
All the spectators turned their scrutinizing, furious gazes toward that figure in unison.
Dustin was utterly fearless, allowing thousands upon thousands of blade-like gazes to fall upon him.
The long robe on his body fluttered despite the absence of wind, and his shoulder-length black hair drifted lightly in the breeze.
His eyes were brilliant, and his posture was straight and firm.
"I, Dustin, shall wait here for all of you to come and challenge me!"
Oracle-grade Budelica smiled faintly, his voice echoing throughout the entire arena.

"Dustin has crossed the starry river from afar, and his terrifying strength is enough to shake heaven and earth. He has issued a challenge to all the experts who advanced through the tournament. Therefore, this tournament will establish a special new rule—no matter who it is, as long as they can defeat Dustin, they will become the champion of this tournament!"
"Defeat Dustin, and you are the champion."
"The champion’s reward will not be reduced in the slightest."
"The match—begins!"
At Oracle-grade Budelica’s command, the experts qualified to compete all ignited with battle intent. With their gazes meeting, they quickly reached a silent understanding.
"So this is turning into a group attack."
Daniel’s eyelids twitched slightly, but he remained completely unmoved.
A siege?
He sneered inwardly.

If they defeated Dustin by relying on greater numbers, then once word spread, the world would only say that the Myriad-Star Cosmos was nothing impressive, and that it had merely won through numerical advantage.
Only defeating him openly and honorably in a one-on-one battle would be an undisputed glory.
"Let them go first."
Daniel’s expression was relaxed. "I’ll go last."
His calm gaze swept across the arena, as though everything was already within his control.
Beside him, James and Mosi exchanged a glance, their own fighting spirits surging.
Meanwhile, in the distance, powerful competitors such as Udi and Silas had long since been unable to suppress the flames of battle in their chests. They were eager to try.
The entire arena had been completely ignited by Dustin’s world-dominating aura.
Just then—whoosh!
A figure appeared on Arena One.
"James of Canaan Starfield has come to challenge you!"
James stepped onto the stage with elegance, his expression composed.
Dustin greeted him with a smile.
Boom!
James’s Divine Domain erupted open in an instant. A black hole as deep as an abyss appeared out of thin air, while countless shields surged forth around him, layer upon layer.
Those were no longer mere shields.
They were a fortress capable of resisting heavenly punishment, an airtight city wall.
A sharp gleam exploded in Dustin’s eyes. His right arm suddenly swelled, then smashed fiercely toward James like a pillar propping up the heavens.
Rumble!
The tens of millions of shield layers were swept apart by Dustin’s colossal arm, which resembled a heavenly pillar. They shattered one after another like thin sheets of paper.
His fist had not even touched James’s body. The force of the oncoming fist wind alone tore James’s puppet into fragments that filled the sky.
"One."
The corner of Dustin’s mouth lifted slightly as he spoke with casual ease.
Faustus witnessed this scene, and his pupils suddenly contracted.
"Immortal Icon!"
That was the complete version of the Divine-grade secret art!
The secret art he had previously obtained from the Godkin expert had only been supreme-grade. Only after undergoing Millionfold Boost had it truly become the complete version of the secret art.
As one of his strongest Divine-grade secret arts at present, he knew better than anyone just how terrifying this art was.
Every movement carried heaven-shaking, earth-shattering power!

sentences.text: "Dustin of the Chaos Humans will challenge all the prodigies of this universe by himself!"
If the words just now had been a clap of thunder, then this sentence was nothing short of the collapse of heaven and earth.
It completely blasted all the spectators into a daze, and a thunderous uproar erupted throughout the entire arena.
"What?
He wants to challenge all the competitors alone?"
"By the Creator God!
How can he be so bold?"
"Too arrogant.
I have never seen anyone this arrogant in my life!"
"Challenge all the prodigies?"
Harris sneered.
Even he did not possess such courage.
Faustus alone was already someone he felt he would need to go all out against, let alone with other nine-star experts present as well.
"He’s also only at the demi-sage rank... yet he’s actually this arrogant?"
Cold Star shook his head.
He had to admire this level of arrogance.
"Is he here to get beaten up?
Hmph!"
Udi’s face was filled with disdain.
He absolutely refused to believe that anyone could possess such strength, daring to declare war against the top demi-sage rank experts of an entire universe.
Silas could not help muttering under his breath,
"Why do I feel faintly excited...?
Is something wrong with me?"
His first reaction was actually the desire to personally witness just how powerful this expert from the Chaosverse really was, and to see whether he would be taught a harsh lesson.
For a moment, he had forgotten just how arrogant the other party’s demand was.
However, Oracle-grade Budelica was still adding fuel to the fire.
He smiled and said, "Dustin of the Chaos Humans also said that the competitors of our universe are free to attack together."
"One man, against all of you!"
Boom!
The spectator stands instantly exploded.
All kinds of "passionate greetings" surged toward Dustin like a tidal wave.
The victorious nine-star experts were equally furious, their anger burning hot.
After being looked down upon and disregarded to such an extent, who could possibly remain calm?
"To challenge the strongest batch of same-rank experts in an entire universe by himself—is he insane?"
Udi cursed inwardly.
He secretly swore that he would teach that man a brutal lesson.
Otherwise, there was no way he could swallow this anger.
"I have never been belittled like this before.
This feeling is truly disgusting."
Silas’s brows were tightly furrowed, and his eyes almost seemed ready to spew fire.
"This young expert is far too arrogant.
Am I the one who has fallen behind the times?"
Cold Star shook his head speechlessly.
"Then come!"
Harris’s hatred quickly shifted onto Dustin.
Dustin smiled with ease, as though everything was only natural.
"That’s right.
I intend to challenge all of you—by myself, I will trample every last one of you beneath my feet!"
Dustin stood tall with his head raised, an unmatched confidence surging from every inch of his body, as though he had already grasped the scepter of fate.
"Though the Endless Starsea is boundless, supreme-grade authority and peerless treasures have always belonged only to those who dare to reach out and seize them.
If you do not fight, you can only become someone else’s stepping stone.
Fall one step behind, and you may never rise again!"
"We are already defying the heavens, contending against all things!
Without the ambition to devour heaven and earth, without the fighting spirit that burns the soul itself, one is only worthy of crawling in the dust and looking up at another’s glory!"
"To the strong, the Endless Starsea is a hall of eternal renown.
To the weak, it is an abyss of eternal damnation!"
Dustin’s eyes were as sharp as an unsheathed sword, and his voice echoed in everyone’s ears.
"I, Dustin—will be the one who fights for everything!"
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone present was shocked.
Some felt their blood boil.
Some were enraged beyond measure.
Others even clenched their fists in secret, wishing they could immediately rush onto the arena and fight him to the death.
However, the overwhelming dominance and confidence rushing toward them caused countless people to feel an indescribable sense of awe.
This man was not merely arrogant and conceited.
He truly possessed the confidence to overturn the star sea!
Oracle-grade Budelica announced in a clear voice, "Next, let us welcome Dustin, the demi-sage from the Chaosverse, to prepare for battle!"
Whoosh!
Before his words had even faded, Dustin was already standing proudly atop Arena One.
Whoosh, whoosh!
All the spectators turned their scrutinizing, furious gazes toward that figure in unison.
Dustin was utterly fearless, allowing thousands upon thousands of blade-like gazes to fall upon him.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 -298-One Against Five, Crushing Dominance
paragraphs: "Unrivaled Strength."
A sharp gleam flashed in Igor’s eyes. The other party’s Strength was rather similar to his own.
What he pursued was precisely the path of shattering all techniques with the ultimate blade!
The instant James’s puppet clone shattered, Igor swung his blade at the same time. The blade light was like a streak of white silk, slashing straight toward Dustin.
At the same time, Cold Star and Silas both appeared.
"Life and Death Unknown!"
Silas’s Divine Domain unfolded. The longsword in his hand flew out, moving as nimbly as a serpent as it pierced through the air toward Dustin.
In an instant, the aura of life and death, intertwined in black and white, filled heaven and earth, surging over like a tide.
The moment James’s puppet shattered, it split into tens of thousands of clones once more.
Those tens of thousands of clones each unleashed their skills. Countless secret treasures poured down like a torrential rain, attacking Dustin from every direction.
As for Cold Star, he copied all of Igor’s strength. At the same time, he slashed out with that blade light capable of tearing space apart. Wherever the blade edge passed, even the void trembled.
In the blink of an eye, Dustin was facing the joint assault of four nine-star experts.
No, there was also Mosi!
Mosi had already been lying in wait within the void, silently accumulating his blade intent.
His killing intent was like a hidden dragon lurking in the abyss. Once it was nurtured to its limit, that one slash would be comparable to a full-powered strike from a high Divine-grade expert.
And what he needed was time.
What he was waiting for was the instant to unleash that thunderous blow!
Dustin’s expression was astonishingly calm.
The five fingers of his left hand danced through the air at a dazzling speed, as though weaving an invisible net of destiny.
Suddenly, his flying fingertips came to an abrupt halt.
His index finger bent, and his thumb pressed tightly over it, forming an ancient and mysterious hand seal.
"Break!"
Dustin’s lips parted slightly as he uttered a single syllable. His voice was not loud, yet it seemed to rumble up from an ancient abyss.
Buzz!
An invisible, intangible, transparent ripple spread rapidly in all directions with Dustin’s body as its center.
Wherever the ripple passed, space became like the surface of a lake into which a stone had been thrown, sending out layer upon layer of tremors.
Silas’s power of the Law of Life and Death, that nimble flying sword, the fierce blade energy unleashed by Igor and Cold Star, James’s overwhelming clones and poison attacks...
Everything, absolutely everything, silently melted away into nothingness the instant it touched that ripple, like accumulated snow meeting the sun.

The four nine-star experts simultaneously felt the immense pressure contained within that ripple. It was as though an invisible mountain had pressed down upon their chests. Their expressions changed drastically, and they all retreated frantically at almost the same time.
And that strange ripple was actually able to penetrate through layer upon layer of spatial barriers, reaching deep into the innermost depths of the void.
Mosi, who had been hiding within an alternate dimension, was focused on nurturing his blade intent while waiting for the chance to deliver a fatal blow.
He stared in astonishment as that invisible ripple penetrated the void and surged toward him. Unable to continue gathering momentum, he had no choice but to hastily slash out with his blade.
However, that blade energy, which had condensed the greater half of his effort and will, was likewise silently annihilated beneath the spreading ripple.
"What... what kind of secret art is that?"
Udi’s mouth fell open, his face filled with disbelief.
"Strength of this level..."
Harris’s voice was low, and his eyes were filled with gravity. "Even I would find it difficult to confront head-on."
In the spectator stands, the many experts looked at one another in dismay.
At first, everything had seemed to be under control. James had made the first move, and the other experts had followed one after another.
But why had all of their attacks been dissolved into nothingness in the blink of an eye?
Just what kind of Strength had they encountered to be forced into such a sorry retreat?
"The clan-guarding sacred art of the Chaos Humans."
Oracle-grade Chanelle suddenly spoke, her voice clearly entering the ears of every expert present.
"The tenth-ranked Great Sacred Art—the Sacred Seal of Revelation!"
The universes were not isolated from one another. In the Endless Starsea, exchanges and slaughter were common.
Oracle-grade experts roamed the star sea all year round, so they had naturally heard more or less about the hidden secrets of outer universes.
What Dustin had just displayed was one of the hundred secret arts of the Chaos Humans, the tenth-ranked Great Sacred Art—the Sacred Seal of Revelation.
By combining curse seals with techniques, its power could shift through countless variations, profound and endlessly mysterious.
Dustin had relied on only one of its transformations to casually neutralize the joint assault of five nine-star experts.
Although the spectators had received Chanelle’s explanation, they were still somewhat dazed.
"In the Lord’s name, that Dustin is absurdly powerful."
"To hold the upper hand while fighting five alone... with strength like that, even Oracle-grade experts would have to look at him differently!"
"What kind of joke is this... Is our universe really going to bow before an outsider today?"
"What are you panicking for? Didn’t you see that Harris still hasn’t made a move? Besides, Faustus is still sitting there steadily. He’s our final trump card."
"That’s right. Even if Dustin has heaven-piercing, earth-shaking ability, he may not be able to cross those two hurdles."
"Just watch calmly. The outcome still hasn’t been decided."
The spectators forced themselves to sound confident, but in their hearts, they were gradually losing certainty.
At first, they had not known Dustin’s true depth. The ignorant were fearless.
But now that they had personally witnessed those ghostly, unfathomable methods, they had no choice but to believe it.
This man was a genuine prodigy through and through!
Arena One.
"Your sword..."
Dustin grinned, his gaze landing on Silas, who had managed to steady himself in the distance.
"Forget it. I’ll open your eyes and let you witness the sword array of the Chaos Humans!"
He suddenly waved his hand, flinging out a beam of light, which split into four in the blink of an eye.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
Four cold, gleaming longswords hovered in the void, sealing off the entire surrounding space completely.
At the same time, Dustin’s fingers changed rapidly, continuously forming sacred seals.
Buzz!
A complex sword array diagram shot into the sky from his body, swiftly spreading across the firmament and resonating with the four longswords from afar.
All of this happened in the time it took to snap a finger.
"Not good! It’s a sword array!"
James’s face turned pale.
"Dangerous."
Mosi coldly spat out a single word.
"Attack together!"
Igor gritted his teeth and charged toward Dustin, with Cold Star following closely behind.
"Chaos Humans..."
Silas felt that entirely different sword intent, and his mind shook violently. Not daring to wait any longer, he raised his sword again and stabbed toward Dustin.
"Ring of Protection!"
James shouted loudly. Countless golden rings of light surged out from his body, firmly protecting him.
At the same time, Silas, Igor, Cold Star, and Mosi were also covered in a layer of golden light.
"We can’t wait any longer."
Harris and Udi exchanged a glance, then disappeared from where they stood at the same time with tacit understanding.
The corners of Dustin’s mouth slowly rose, forming a faint arc.
"This sword array is called the Micro-Energy Judgment Sword Array."
"Activate!"
The sword array thunderously came to life!
Countless sharp and peerless sword lights poured down like a violent storm, filling the entire space.
Those sword lights were incomparably sharp, as if they could cut apart all things in the world.
James and the other four experts were trapped within the sword array, as though standing naked in a bitter, freezing wind.
The only difference was that this "freezing wind" could kill them!
Even Igor, who possessed top-grade Constitution and specialized in extreme close-combat techniques, was cut with countless tiny wounds across his body when facing the all-pervasive sword light.
Although James’s Ring of Protection was resilient, it rapidly dimmed under the erosion of the sword light and looked as though it would soon fall apart.
At this point, forget taking the initiative to attack.
Simply staying alive under the sword array was already extremely difficult!
The five nine-star experts suddenly fell into an unprecedented desperate situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 299 -299-The Absolute Prodigy Who Created a Divine-grade Secret Art
paragraphs: "To think I would have a day like this!"
Silas felt a deep sense of powerlessness.
They were both demi-sages, yet Dustin of the Chaos Humans could fight one against five and leave them with no strength to resist.
"By the Creator God..."

James was in a slightly better state at this moment. New protective secret treasures and secret arts were constantly emerging around his body. What he excelled at most was defense, but even he had completely lost the chance to attack.
"Dustin... is actually this terrifying!"
Cold Star sucked in a breath of cold air. "Faustus... can he still fight him?"
"What I’m facing doesn’t feel like a single enemy. It feels like an army of thousands!"
Igor specialized in offense, but he was not good at defense, so he was struggling the most.
Mosi said nothing. He was silent as a mountain, yet the aura around him grew deeper and heavier.
His resilience was the strongest. The heavier his injuries became, the more violently he could erupt.
At this moment, he was actually deliberately enduring more damage, all for the sake of building up the foundation for that heaven-shaking strike.
As soon as Dustin’s sword array appeared, the spectator stands instantly erupted.
The two methods he had revealed earlier had already been stunning beyond compare, yet compared to the sword array before them now, they seemed almost insignificant.
"Dustin is fighting one against five, and he’s still suppressing them!"
"What kind of monster is this? He’s absurdly powerful!"
"It’s over, it’s over. I have a bad feeling about this..."
"Harris and the others have made their move."
Daniel silently watched the changes on the battlefield, his expression no longer as relaxed as before.
Dustin was far stronger than he had imagined!
Harris and Udi charged forcefully into the battlefield.
Udi’s aura surged wildly. His Divine Domain expanded with a thunderous roar, then actually fused with his body in an instant.
Profound and complex battle runes appeared across his skin, ancient and mysterious.
At the same time, Udi’s momentum soared like an erupting volcano.
Without the slightest fear, he charged into the sword array. Countless sword lights swept across his body, yet they only left faint white marks behind.
"Quite decent battle runes."
Dustin chuckled softly. "However, although battle runes are powerful, they are ultimately still an unorthodox path..."
A hazy halo suddenly appeared in his eyes.
Deep within his pupils, two Sanctum Sigils actually emerged!
Sanctum Sigils!
There was one Sanctum Sigil in each of Dustin’s eyes.

At first, the Sanctum Sigils were as tiny as specks of dust. But within his pupils, they rapidly expanded, finally rushing out from his eyes and transforming into two enormous Sanctum Sigils that blotted out the sky and covered the sun, hovering in the void.
Whoosh!
An ancient Sanctum Sigil condensed in the void, transforming into a colossal totem pillar that seemed to connect heaven and earth.
Upon the pillar were engraved a vast Star Chart and a boundless star sea—epochs, eras, years, days and nights, hours, minutes, and seconds...
Every ripple of the river of time flowed quietly within it, as though the pulse of the universe had been carved upon its surface.
At the same time, the other Sanctum Sigil manifested with a thunderous roar, transforming into a towering sacred monument of mysteries.

Upon the monument, mountains and rivers, the earth, the sun, the moon, the stars, flowers, birds, fish, insects, flying creatures, beasts, cities, and nations all appeared vividly alive, emanating a pressure that stretched across eternity.
The instant the two Sanctum Sigils manifested, the Oracle-grade experts in the stands all sucked in a breath of cold air!
"This is the law of the Sanctum Sigil Universe!"
"Dustin is actually this terrifying. He has obtained the law doctrine of the Sanctum Sigil Universe!"
"He combined the law inheritance of the Sanctum Sigil Universe with the law inheritance of the Chaosverse. Truly remarkable."
Oracle-grade Chanelle cried out in shock, "He created his own Divine-grade secret art!"
He created his own Divine-grade secret art!
Whoosh!
Every expert present, Daniel included, was stunned.

Daniel remembered that James had once said this: if one could create a Divine-grade secret art by oneself, then once that person advanced to sage, they would become one of the strongest beings at the peak of the Divine-grade level, nearly invincible even among that tier.
Dustin had not yet stepped into the Divine-grade level, but as long as he took that step, he would directly reach an invincible realm at the peak of Divine-grade!
"Terrifying indeed."
Daniel raised his brows, and a scorching battle intent erupted from his body.
In the spectator stands, cries of amazement rose and fell one after another.
"By the Creator God! Creating a Divine-grade secret art by himself—even if I were allowed to live another life, I would never be able to do that!"

"Forget living another life. Even if someone personally explained it to me, I might still not be able to do it. You have to understand, this is the perfect fusion of the law inheritances of two great universes. The difficulty is comparable to surviving an Oracle-grade tribulation!"
"Harris is still summoning his natal phantom. Don’t panic. There’s still a turning point..."
Within the arena space.
The giant monument and the totem pillar formed from the Sanctum Sigils were like the wheels of fate, crushing down toward Udi with a thunderous momentum.
Relying on the battle runes covering his body, Udi charged forward with overwhelming force.
He clenched both fists and smashed them fiercely toward the towering pillar that connected heaven and earth.
Dong!
The giant pillar was struck with a heaven-shaking rumble.
The patterns on the pillar suddenly changed. Galaxies shifted, and the scales of time spun wildly.
Udi’s body trembled violently. He only felt as though his Strength had been emptied by an invisible hand.
The battle runes flickered frantically, restoring his physical strength in an instant, but they were clearly much dimmer than before.
Whoosh!
The giant monument suddenly appeared behind Udi and smashed down onto the back of his head with a clang.
Udi’s vision went black, and stars burst before his eyes.
Dong!
The totem pillar rang out on its own, then in the blink of an eye, it suppressed Udi beneath its base!
Dong!
Dong! Dong!
No one knew whether it was the pillar ringing on its own or Udi struggling beneath it, but the giant pillar trembled again and again, its sound booming like thunder.
"Udi has been suppressed."
James grew anxious inside.
"Sanctum Sigils are actually this terrifying..."

The major universes were not isolated from one another. There were also races from the Sanctum Sigil Universe that had wandered into this universe, so living beings here were not completely unfamiliar with the path of Sanctum Sigils.
However, they had truly never heard of a Divine-grade secret art born from the fusion of the law inheritances of the Sanctum Sigil Universe and the Chaosverse.
Now that they were seeing it with their own eyes, they only felt a suffocating pressure rushing toward them.
James and the other four experts were still struggling bitterly within the Micro-Energy Judgment Sword Array, completely unable to join the attack.
Udi had been suppressed and was in imminent danger.
At this moment, Harris was still brewing his final killing move, while Daniel remained motionless.
Dustin of the Chaos Humans had actually suppressed the entire battlefield by himself!
The Oracle-grade master of Starvault Sanctum silently watched the changes unfolding on the field, his brows tightly furrowed, revealing the heaviness in his heart.
"If the expert from the Chaosverse truly suppresses all the competitors of our universe, then our dignity will be thrown all the way to the farthest end of the Endless Starsea."
He could not help looking toward that figure in the Canaan Starfield spectator seats who remained as steady as a boulder. For some reason, a faint trace of hope rose in his heart.
"Faustus, you have to live up to expectations!"
Just then, Chanelle’s Oracle-grade voice transmission sounded in Faustus’s ears.
"Faustus, how confident are you?"
"One hundred percent."
Daniel chuckled softly.
Chanelle was immediately rendered speechless. "Do you not understand what humility means?"
He paused, then continued, "In that case, don’t rush onto the stage yet."
Faustus nodded, understanding clearly.
The current battle situation was so difficult. If he hastily entered the arena now, he would instead fall into an inferior position and be mocked by the other universes.
They would laugh at their universe for having no true experts, and for only being able to rely on a war of attrition.
Since Faustus was confident that he could defeat Dustin, then waiting a little longer—waiting for the opportunity for a one-on-one fight—would be the most advantageous situation!
In fact, the stronger Dustin appeared, the more beneficial it would be for Faustus.
Only by stepping over such a powerful expert to reach the top would that glory be dazzling enough.
Secondly, Canaan Starfield would also bask in that glory!
That was precisely why Chanelle had asked Faustus.

chapters.title: Chapter 300 -300-Harris’s Defeat
paragraphs: On Arena One.
The situation had completely fallen into Dustin’s grasp.
He did not even deign to take Harris seriously, simply allowing the phantom of the Starbeast to slowly condense in the void.
Harris had his back against the wall, the pressure bearing down on him like a mountain!
If he acted even a little too late, the other nine-star experts would not be able to hold on until that moment. Dustin would complete an epic-grade feat—suppressing the entire battlefield alone!
Boom!
Behind Harris, the phantom of the Starbeast manifested with a thunderous roar, blotting out the sky and covering the sun, as though the entire firmament had been shrouded beneath its body.
In the spectator stands, all the experts held their breath and stared fixedly at this scene.
If Dustin could even suppress Harris with ease, then the experts of this universe would lose all face.
Awooo!
The Starbeast raised its head and let out a long cry, its voice shaking the heavens.
Everything in the space—dust, light, and even the air itself—was madly devoured by the giant beast’s enormous mouth.
The entire arena space trembled violently, as though it were undergoing an apocalyptic calamity.
"Roar!"

Harris opened his mouth and roared furiously. A berserk and matchless aura erupted from his body, making him seem like an ancient ferocious beast that had broken free from its shackles as he pounced toward Dustin.
At that very instant, the devouring power of the Starbeast swept forth.
The Micro-Energy Judgment Sword Array shattered with a boom. The totem pillar and sacred monument vanished like smoke.
Udi had already fallen unconscious.
James, Mosi, Cold Star, Silas, Igor, and the others carried Udi with them as they flew out of the arena space with all their strength.
The battle here was no longer something they could interfere in!
They had given up on continuing to try.
With his full power unleashed, Harris’s combat strength was terrifying beyond measure.
He forcefully crushed through all of Dustin’s methods and launched a storm-like assault.
Especially at this moment, the Starbeast phantom could not only tear space apart, but could also continuously replenish Harris’s Strength.
If Harris’s combat power before had been one hundred, then at this moment, it had already skyrocketed to ten thousand!
This was Harris in his complete form!
"How will Dustin deal with this?"
Daniel’s gaze burned brightly.
If it were him, he would definitely answer violence with violence!
The foundation granted to him by Millionfold Boost was simply too profound. His combat style had always been simple and brutal.
"Dustin also has Immortal Icon. His foundation is similarly deep."
Daniel wanted to see exactly how Dustin would deal with Harris.
The spectators and Oracle-grade experts were also watching with bated breath.
"Harris’s combat power is unparalleled. As expected of the strongest lifeform in the star sea!"
"Face the abyss head-on!"
Harris roared as he charged over like a bolt of狂 thunder.
Dustin’s ten fingers moved rapidly, leaving behind streaks of afterimages before suddenly coming to a halt.
"Petty tricks!"
Dustin shouted.
In the void, a golden giant palm suddenly appeared, large enough to rival the Starbeast. The lines on its palm were as clear as if they had been carved there.
At the center of the palm, a sacred cross-shaped rune flickered with dazzling light.
That cross-shaped rune shot out a beam of golden light, striking the Starbeast phantom directly.
The giant beast trembled violently. Immediately afterward, the rune branded itself all over its body.
At the same time, the Starbeast seemed to be completely severed from this space, unable to absorb any more energy.
The Sacred Seal of Revelation!
One of the ten great sacred arts of the Chaos Humans.
Just then, Dustin chuckled softly.
"Immortal Icon!"
His body rapidly expanded, transforming into a giant ten thousand meters tall. His enormous fist smashed toward Harris like a meteor.
"Damn it! I can’t replenish my energy anymore!"
Harris’s face darkened.
Dustin had first sealed his natal phantom, cutting off his connection to it and preventing him from replenishing his energy.
"Then come!"
Harris’s battle intent soared into the sky. With a furious roar, he raised his fist and collided head-on with Dustin’s colossal fist.
Boom!
Rumble! Rumble!
Countless deafening explosions erupted from the point where their fists met. The space that had been repeatedly reinforced by Oracle-grade experts actually shattered like thin ice.
"Roar!"
Harris let out an unwilling roar at the ten-thousand-meter giant before him and continued fighting with everything he had.
He had already gone all out, but he was still being suppressed by Dustin from beginning to end.
And after activating Immortal Icon, Dustin’s attacks grew stronger with every wave.
Harris’s defeat was already beginning to show. The situation was becoming increasingly unfavorable.
The spectators did not even dare to breathe, afraid that they would miss the most spectacular instant.
"Immortal Icon really is an overbearing Divine-grade secret art!"
"Harris is in danger. I’m afraid he won’t be able to hold on for much longer."
"Even at this point, Faustus still isn’t going up?"
"What do you know? The strongest always appears last!"
"Heh, heh, heh. I’m just afraid he’s lost his nerve..."
"What do you mean by that? Are you trying to undermine our own side?"
"I’m only making a reasonable guess..."
"No. If this continues, I will undoubtedly lose!"
Harris was gradually exhausting his strength and could only barely defend.
He gritted his teeth, then suddenly took out a Holy Relic. It was a colored rope shimmering with seven-colored light.
With a whoosh, the rope expanded in the wind, stretching to a length of one hundred thousand li. Like a venomous snake, it shot toward Dustin.
"A Divine-grade secret treasure!"
James’s eyes lit up.
"Harris has already used all his trump cards."
Cold Star shook his head.
"Why is that guy so powerful?"
Silas stared fixedly at Dustin, his teeth clenched so hard they creaked.
Dustin caught sight of the flowing-light rope slicing through the air toward him, and the corners of his lips lifted slightly.
A silver ring worn on his finger whistled out, expanding violently in the wind. In an instant, it transformed into a silver ring of light the size of a millstone.
Whoosh!
A piercing hum tore through the sky.

Before Harris’s Divine-grade secret treasure could even touch the corner of Dustin’s robe, it was forcibly dragged over by the terrifying gravitational pull released by the silver ring and swallowed completely in an instant.
"No!"
Harris’s eyes nearly split apart. That colored rope was a Holy Relic personally bestowed upon him by the Oracle-grade expert of Aurora Starfield. Its value was immeasurable.
He could not help letting out a roar of utter fury.
"Take this punch!"
Dustin took a deep breath, then suddenly punched out with his right fist.
Gathered upon that fist was a destructive power far surpassing any of his previous attacks. Wherever it passed, space shattered inch by inch, revealing the pitch-black void beyond.
Blue veins bulged on Harris’s forehead. He understood that this was likely his final chance to counterattack.
Out of the corner of his eye, he glanced toward the spectator seats of Canaan Starfield.
There, Faustus still looked utterly indifferent, as though the heaven-shaking battle before his eyes had nothing to do with him.
"I thought that, in the end, I would at least be able to fight him..."
At this moment, Harris could actually choose to retreat safely.

He had already done everything he could. It was not that he himself was weak, but that Dustin, this monster who had walked out of the Chaosverse, had already reached the absolute limit of the demi-sage rank in Strength, speed, and battle awareness.
Even more terrifying was the fact that he had created his own Divine-grade secret art...
What kind of astonishing talent was that?
There was no shame in losing to someone like this.
"Faustus... just how far can you walk down this path?"
Harris sighed silently in his heart.
"Kill!"
He did not retreat. Instead, he charged straight toward that world-destroying punch.
Boom!
Dustin’s heavy fist slammed solidly into Harris’s chest, sending him flying in an instant.
Harris flew backward like a meteor. Along the path he passed, the earth split apart and the sky collapsed.
Blood gushed wildly from his mouth, and his complexion instantly withered.
At that moment, the cross-shaped divine rune on the natal phantom behind him suddenly dissipated. In its place came a surging vitality like a roaring tsunami, instantly healing his injuries.
Harris’s spirit recovered, but his battle intent had already vanished.
"I admit defeat."
A loss was a loss. He could afford to accept defeat.
"Dustin, and you too, Faustus... One day, I will challenge both of you again!"
